1.OMONENE NYASAE NAGWANCHETE, NAENDE OKOEIRE OMOROBERIO BWOGOKUMIA ASE OBOGIMA BWAO.
OBWANCHANI BWA NYASAE
Naki Nyasae ayianchete ense, goika akarua Omwana oye omomoima, erinde monto onde bwensi oyomwegenlre tasira, korende abe nobogima bwa kare na kare. Yohana 3:16
OMOROBERIO O'NYASAE ASE AYE OMONYENE
Omoibi tagocha, otatiga aibe, na konyenya, na gosaria; Inche nigo nachete erio babe nobogima, naende babe naborobwo obonge. Yohana 10:10

2. MWANYABANTO NOMONYABIBE
Ebibe biaye biagerire bweatananire korwa ase Nayasae, ase igo tamanyeti obwanchani na omoroberio O'Nayasae ase obogima bwaye.
MWANYABANTO NOMONYABIBE
Ekiagera bonsi bakorire ebibe, na baremeirwe nobonene bwa Nyasae. Abarumi 3:23
Mwanyabanto igo atongetwe abe omosani O'Nyasae, korende ere akarigia enchera yokogenda kobwaye na obosani bwaye na Nyasae bokabutoka. Eke nakio Ebibilia ekoroka ebibe. Ase omogwekano...
- Ekero mwanyabanto akoba mamincha ya Nyasae.
- Ekero mwanyabanto atari komosika Nyasae.
- Ekero mwanyabanto atari komenya ime yechinchera ching'ikeranu chia Nyasae.
MWANYABANTO OATANANIRWE KORWA ASE NYASAE
Taibo, obobe bwaino nabwo bwabaatananire korwa ase Nyasae Oino. Ebibe biaino biagerire Omonene obisire obosio bwaye korwa asemore, ase igo tari koigwa ogosaba kwaino. Isaya 59:2
Nyasae nomochenu na mwanyabanto nomonyabibe. Mwanyabanto origirie chinchera chiokomoikera Nyasae ase chinchera ao ao: goetera ase Ekanisa, ogokora okuya, gokonya abanto bande, korende ase chinguru chiaye osinyirwe.

3. YESO KRISTO NERE ENCHERA YOKA YOKORUSIA EBIBE
Yeso Kristo agakwa ase engencho y'ebibe biaito erio mwanyabanto anyare komanya obwanchani na omoroberio o Nyasae ase obogima bwaye.
AGAKWA NAENDE AKABOKA:
Ekiagera Kristo nere agakwa ara rimo ase engencho y'ebibe. Ere oyorenge omonyene oboronge agachandwa ase engencho yabatari abaronge, erinde atorente ase Nyasae.
I Petero 3:18
YESO IMOYO ARE
Nyuma y'ogochandwa kwaye akeorokia asebare ase ebiorokererio ebinge ng'a moyo are. Akaba okobaorokera ase engaki y'amatuko emerongo ene, na gokwana nabarabwo igoro y'oboruoti bwa Nyasae.
Ogokora Kw'Abatomwa 1:3
YESO NERE ENCHERA YEKEENE YOKA
Yeso akamoiraneria, Inche ninche enchera, na ekeene, na obogima; monto onde tagocha ase Tata otatiga goetera asencle. Yohana 14:6
Goetera ase ogokwa kwa Yeso Kristo ase omosaraba mwanyabanto onyarire goika ase Nyasae.
Okomanya amachiko aya atato oka taisaini. Ogochika gwa kane nigo gogokomanyia buna oranyare komonyora Kristo ase obogima bwao...

4. NEKOGWENERETE KOMOMANYA YESO KRISTO BUNA OMOTORIA NA OMOKONYI BWOBOGIMA BWAO.
Nario oramanye obwanchani na omoroberio o'Nyasae igoro yobogima bwao.
GOIKA OMONYORE KRISTO GOETERA ASE OKWEGENA
Korende bonsi abamwanchete, akabaa okobua babe abana ba Nyasae, nabwo bariegenire erieta riaye.
Yohana 1:12
Naki mwatoorigwe ase obuya, ase enchera y'okwegena; ayio tarwete asemore abanyene, korende nekeegwa kia Nyasae gose tari ase ogokora, monto onde tacha gwetogia.
Abaebeso 2:8,9
NIGO OKOMONYORA KRISTO GOETERA ASE OKOMWARIGANIA ASOE ASE ENKORO YAO
Rigereria, ninteneine gesieri gotura; omonto karaigwe eriogi riane na koigora egesieri, ninsoe asare, nindagere amo nere, na ere amo nainche. Okomanoka 3:20
Komwanchera Yeso Kristo asoe ase enkoro yao nokomanya ng'a:
- Goonchoka gochia ase Nyasae na gotiga ebibe
- Komwegena Kristo asoe enkoro yao naende akwabere ebibe biao.
- Omwanchere aonchore obogima bwao obe buna atagete ere.
Inee bicha ki ere omoreng'anio oo?
Inee bicha ki oganetie ebe omoreng'anio bwo obogima bwao?
Ayakobwatia nomoroberio buna oramonyore Kristo ase obogima bwao.
NABO ORAMONYORE KRISTO BONO IGA
Morangerie Yesu asoe ime yobogima bwao. Mwegene Omonene anyare kogokorera kobwatekana na eira yaye. Ere Yesu bwanchire akwariganie naende naganetie komenya ime yenkoro yao. Nabo orasabe iga.
Omonene Yeso Kristo, ninkoganetie. Naigoire egesieri kiobogima bwane naende nagwanchire obe omotoria naende omonene one ekiagera inche natigire ebibe. Imbuya mono ase okonyabera ebibe biane. Kabe omonyakerogo bwobogima bwane. Onkore omonto oria otagete imbe ase obosio bwao. AMINA
Inee Ogosaba oko inkworokia kore okogania gwenkoro yao?
Onye ogosaba oko kore okogania kwomoyo oo, bono saba onyare komwanchera Kristo asoe ime yobogirna bwao.
BUNA ORAMANYE NG'A YESU OSOIRE IME YE ENKORO YAO
Bono inee? Kwamwariganeirie Yeso ime yobogima bwao? Naki omanyete? Kobwatekana na Okomanoka 3:20 Ng'ai Kristo are bono iga? Kristo otebire buna nachiche ime yobogima bwao. Inee nang'ainererie gose? Naki oramanye ng'a Nyasae okoiraneirie ogosaba kwao? (Egekogera natebete ng'a onde bwensi oranyegene amo na amariko ane nakonyeke ekiagera ariegenire erieta ri'Omwana o Nyasae!)
OYORE NA YESO NARE NOBOGIMA BWA KARE NA KARE
Naki obo nabwo oborori, ng'a Nyasae otoeire obogima bwa kare na kare, na obogima obo nigo bore ime ase Omwana oye. Ere oyore n'omwana, nare nobogima; ere oyotari n'Omwana o Nyasae, tari nobogima. Nabarikeire inwe amang'ana aya, erinde momanye ng'a more nobogima bwa kare na kare, inwe abwo mwariegenire erieta ri'Omwana o'Nyasae. 1 Yohana 5:11-13
Mwaakere Nyasae imbuya mono kera rituko kiagera Kristo nare ime yobogima bwao. "Mokoborokereria kobwata aya onsi nabachigete; na rora, inche nigo inde amo nainwe amatuko onsi goika omoerio bw'ense" (Mathayo 28:20). Okoeire obogima bwa kare na kare.
Abakristo nigo bagwenerete kwegena omonene Nyasae oito amo nering'ana riaye buna erikire ase ebibilia. Neba buna oranyare kweigwa aye omonyene, manya nga Kristo ere tari goonchoka ase obogima bwao. "Timoba abanchi chibesa, moisaneke nebi more nabio, ekiagera ere omonyene otebire, "Tinkogotiga nonya ng'ake, gose tingokoremera" (Abaiberania 13:5)
Ebigicha eye yegari igo egotworokia obomaene bwe Ebibilia. Okwegena amo na okweigwa igo bigokora emeremo ase obogima two omoknisto.
- Obomaene bwomonene igo bobwate chinguru chiogototang'ana - (Einchini)
- Igo tobwateranetigwe nechinguru chiobomaene na okwegena - (Amaguta ye ebetironi)
- Buna tokoigwera obomaene, ebirengererio biaito igo bikobwatia enchera endonge. - (Orotuba gose eturera)
- Igo tokwegena Nyasae nobomaene bwaye korende tari okweigwa gwaito Ekero twakorire ebibe nigo egwenerete twangame nere natwabere.
Ase go tonyara kwegena ebirengererio biao korende bwegene obomaene bwe ring'ana ria Nyasae.
BONO KWAMONYORIRE KRISTO
Ekero kwamonyorete Kristo ase enkoro yao ebinto ebinge igo biakoregete.
- Kristo agasoa ime yenkoro yao (Okomanoka 3:20 na Abakorosai 1:27)
- Ebibe biao bikaberwa (Abakorosai 1:14)
- Okaba omwana o Nyasae (Yohana 1:12)
- Kwanyarire konyora omoroberio omyuya noborai obuya bwa Nyasae ase obogima bwao (Yohana 10:10 na II Abakorinto 5:14, 15, 17).
Inee nonyare korengereria igoro ya kende gionsi ekiya kebuete Kristo oyore ime yenkoro yao?
Onye nabo mwaakere Nyasae imbuya mono ase ogosaba bono iga ase amaya agokoreire.
Goakera Nyasae imbuya mono igo gokworokia okwegena. Tosabe bono tosibogete.
Egento kende ninki?
BUNA ORANYARE GOKINA ASE EKEMOIKA
Buna omwana omoke agokina naboigo egwenerete omokristo nere akine ekemoika.
Amang'ana akobwatia nabo aranyare kogokonya.


EKANISA IGO ERE YENGENCHO ENENE MONO
Ekero chinko chibekire amo, igo chikoyia noborabu obonene mono. Beka oroko rokoyia ase riraba rire nobokendu nomorero oye igo okorima naende obe ekegenga, chinko chinyinge nigo chigwoka buya. Ase omobwekano oyo: igo ere obogima obokong'u mono ekero ogotema komenya obogima bwegekristo aye bweka.
Igo ere buya mono kegima ekero mokobwaterana nabakristo bande baria bamomanyete Yeso Kristo buna omotoria obo (Abaibirania 10:25)
Goika ogende ekanisa eria abanto begenete buna Ebibilia nering'ana riobomaene ria Nyasae, naende ase Yeso Kristo agotogigwa buna nomwana O Nyasae.

Onde taiyo orenge kobibeka ase ense engima
Omongina baba magokoro ominto nabwate eng'ana. Nigo ere eng'ana enke, ko n' endito. Nigo omongina baba agoteba buna gesaku kende nkeiyo ase ense eng'ima kiare kobibeka. Eee bono. Ebitinge. Ogotimigwa (okobekerwa) ebitinge nigo kiarenge egento gesaku kende gionsi ase ense engima getare gokora, otatiga Abagusii.
Mwamogusii bweka, naende bene, nere okabekire gose gotimigwa ebitinge. Omosubati Omogusii nigo arenge gotimigwa egetinge ekero are gosoka gochia bwoye, na gokorerwa enyangi y' bitinge.
Abana ba Mwanyagetinge babekire emeyabo. Kemunto, Kerubo, Moraa amo na Kwamboka nao bare ase omoyega bwe enyangi. On the far right, omongina bwe esiko ase ekenyoro, omosubati kwamboka otimigwe ebitinge. Picture na Petronillah Ogoti. Gusii.com files.
Ase boigo, nigo baba agoteba buna omoiseke orenge kobibekerwa nigo arenge omosubati bw'e esiko ase ekenyoro. Esiko eng'ana buna ki? Nigo yarenge esiko enene, mbaka omoiseke obibekeirwe nigo arenge gochora erieta ri' okwebaka!
Amarieta y' ebitinge nigo are ane oka!
Komenta nayio, nigo omongina baba agoteba buna abasubati ba Gusii nigo barenge kwebaka amarieta ane oka, ko batimigwe ebitinge. Kobwatekana na magokoro, amarieta ayio ane omoriakari o Gusii arenge kwebaka nigo are: Kemunto, Kerubo, Moraa amo na Kwamboka.
Egetinge nigo kiare kobekwa magoro, ase egeting'iro korwa igoro, asiniiini. Erieta Egetinge ndibwate omoreng'anio, "Tinga". Eng'encho ende, omosubati nigo areng'e goting'wa kogoro (obwatanigwa). Bono oyo okobekerwa (ogotimigwa) egetinge orokwa Nyagetinge, erinde egesaku eke nakio Mwanyagetinge.
Omongina baba nabo ateba buna bwatera abwo bono, ase okwegera ase twarwete. Mbuya mono and thank you for listening.

Kisii Town. Gusii.com photo file.
Kisii Municipal Council Deputy Mayor Patrick Aming'a Siro lost his seat rituko ria igoro. Kisii Resident Magistrate Njeri Thuku nigo arwete obogambi inga Siro taakeretwe kura buya na kobua korwa Nyaura Ward.
Kisii Resident Magistrate Thuku nigo arwete obogambi obwo ase ekina kiabegetwe ase ekoti no omokansora omokoro, omosike Charles Ombuna. Kansora Ombuna nigo agoteba inga amagoso narenge aroro ase chikura chio omwaka o 2007, echio chiagerete omosike Patrick Siro akaba omobui.
Resident Judge Njeri Thuku nigo atebete inga "chikura chia Nyaura Ward tichiarenge free and fair. Igo natebire inga chikura chiaakwe naende korwa Nyaura Ward". Komenta nayio, nigo Magistrate Njeri atebete inga goika The Interim Independent Electoral Commission (IIEC) ebe responsible ase ogoakia chikura chinyia.
Nonya nabo igo, Siro amo na IIEC lawyer omosike Onchari Otiso nigo batebete inga imbache babeke e appeal. "Goika to appeal ase obogambi obo bwarurwe ekiagera tibori obwe ekeene". Nabo Siro atebetie abariki abwo isiko ye Ekoti.
Nonya Siro otebete inga taetwe ribaga goteba his side of the story, Magistrate Thuku nigo atebete inga Siro did not file anything. No court briefs, did not call witnesses, naende inga ekeene nigo keratoke through probability eyio egocha koba possible through another election.
Ombuna amo na abasaidi baye nigo bagoteba inga nigo baagete chikura ase Boronyi Ward. Nigo Ombuna atebete inga tiyare konyarekana baakere ekura ase Nyaura Ward ekiagera option eyio tiyarenge on the ballot paper.
Ase application yaye gochia se Ekoti, Ombuna nigo atebete inga abaaki chiukura ba Nyaura Ward were denied a chance to vote ase engencho ye mix-up ya polling stations. Ombuna nigo agoteba inga amagoso nigo akoretwe na now defunct Electoral Commission of Kenya.

Aya amwabo aya:
Omong'ina magokoro baba ominto nantebetie buna abwo ase chingaki chia kare kare, amaiga y' omogaka narengeo. Bono amaiga y' omogaka ninki? Naende nabo oraborie. Magokoro nigo antebetie buna ase amatuko amakoro, nigo abagaka bare koriseria chiombe chiabo ase oboamo, naende nigo chiare korara ase ayamo.
Nigo baba antebetie buna nigo abagaka aba bare korosia egesa gekorokwa gesarate, erinde babera na korara aroro. Bono abaminto manya buna gesarate n' ase abagaka bare komenya, ayio arenge aare na sobo, na nigo bare kong'anya ne chiombe chiabo.
Ase boigo, nigo omong'ina antebetie buna abang'ina mbarenge kobera gesarate. Yaya. Abasae n' abagaka, nabwo boka barenge kobera aaiga gesarate. Bono ekero omong'ina arenge koigwa amaiga y' ogokwania omogaka oye, nigo omong'ina oyo are kwebwatesia, orosia endagera egotonontera, buna obokima amo n' ching'eni chiri omogaka oye ancheete.
Tingocha kona kobeera nyombaa nche bweka: Omosubati nyakieni nkorengereria are, okweboria buna n' chinyeni ki gose, agocha koiyekera omogaka oye, erinde amoirere aaria gesarate. Ase Abagusii, amaiga y' omogaka narengeo.
Korwa abwo, omanya gwetema igo, goika gesarate na kobairera endagera eyio eng'ansu. Bono omong'ina oyo gaikire abwo egesarate, nigo abagaka aba bande bare komanya buna omong'ina oyo nigo are n' amaiga y' omogaka oye, bamanya koa omogaka bw' omong'ina oyo ribaga, erinde ogenda bwoye!
Kobwatekana n' omongina magokoro baba ominto, aya naro arenge gokwanerwa buna amaiga y' omogaka, n' Abagusii abakoro. Abaminto, obo nabwo obosemi bwaito bw' Ekegusii ase rero. Monywe mache maya, and thank you for listening.

Egari yachire. Iga ninche ng'ike? Gochwata omorondo bara. Bono otigaire atari n' kiamboria. Omomura otamanyeti goteba buna "mbuya mono", nigo atigararete gatogoreti amaiso na kwebori amabori amange.
Omonyene egari akamokoba mbaka ase are goikera. Bono gaika ase arenge gochia, omomura oyo agaika korwa egari ime na kogenda rioka kebweenenu. Korora iga, omonyene egari akagechigwa kerage na komorangeria na komotebia amoiranesi gochi aria ase amobogorereti gekogera omobuko oye nao ogwerete nse.
Omomura oy' omosomu agasoa egari ime n' omonyene akarundi egari gochia ase barwete korwa. Ko baaika aria ase amonyorete, omonyene egari agatebia omomura oyo aike, erinde arigie gose narore omobuko oye.
Buna aigete iga, omonyene egari agaokia egari na koyeminyokia gochia motwe chimbero chimbariri! Omomura oyo agatigara gatogoreti amaiso na kwebori amabori amange.

Onye gokagete buna oyo no omogano igoro buna seito tware konywa erongongori etainekiri, kana koganya. Gose onye gokagete ngogotebia nde buna seito tware gokama chingoko, kana gokenderera agwo ekiiriri kio omotembe. Tindi gwatora bobisi buna seito tware gokama chingoko ekero oboremo bwabete chincherere totabwate ase nonya n’ embori okoriisia.
Oyo no omogano bw' omogaka oyomo obwate chisemi, korende ekero twarenge abana nigo tware komosekerera. Omogaka oyio nigo are korokwa Mogaka. Magoroba iga ko omobaso okendire nigo agaterekire ebusaa yo obori na abasani baye. (Tari eye ye chibando rero nonya na abaisia abasiniini bakonywa). Kobasiibire ekegara ne chinkore bakonakoererania buna abana ba ng’ina omo, nigo bagaterire emeino emiya. Oyo nanchente ginkonakobategerera nigo orenge korokwa “Mosaiga.”
Gaki tiga mbatebie buna Abamerika nigo banchete chisese ne ebimoni mono. Okonyora ekemoni keroseirie nyomba kemenyete buya, nonya mbeba nchiyo kebwenerete goita. Endagera nigo gekogorerwa enga ebisuguti kiabekerwa na amabere. Nonya nase gekobeka echabu go kiabutiarire nigo kebwate abanyene bana goitora.
Ne esese nero nigo yanchire mono. Emenyete nyomba, egoikaransa esoba seti igoro yarigereria etelebiseni na abanyene. Esese ya Amerika oise konyereta seito Kenya nigo erakwe bwango mono. Nyama mbese sese ya Amerika terikoria. Tenga buna Ondieki yaito yakaminyokirie egesusu gose egechure yabwata twaria, twanyea amauga. Buna ekemoni kia Amerika, esese ya Amerika nigo ekoroserigwa endagera special ekogorwa korwa etuka.
Tiga bono naende, Omogusii ominto, ngotebie egento kende kiamaseko. Abamerika naende nkoratwara bare amasindano korora buna ning’o obwate esese gose ekemoni egeseera. Amasindano ayio ataraika nigo bakoira chisese ne ebimoni baakana chibesa biasibigwa na konintwa chinchara. Omobui bwa amasindano nigo akoegwa egekombe buna keria abagosoria bakoeegwa.
Maene pi ndie esese, tindigokong’aina, Nyaituga o baba. Boria onde bwensi omenyete mache ng’umbu.
Chisese ne ebimoni kobiarwarire Abamerika tibari gotiga bikwe. Nigo bakobiira chinyagetari chi ebimoni ne chisese. Nimanyete Omoamerika oyomo oakanete $4,000 (Ksh. 300,000) kobaara esese endwaire.
Esese koyangire kobwena nigo bagokora egento gekorokwa, “Putting it to sleep” – bakonyebeta esindani yakwa ng’ooora. Koyakuure, banyeira ase akorokwa, Pet Cemetery, ase chimbeera chie chisese, ebimoni, ne ching’iti chinde Abamerika batugete nyomba chigotindekwa. Kobanyetindekire nigo bachachana na gwechwanachania buna omoibori okwereirwe no omwana.
Esese isiko, ekemoni nyomba.

Aya amwabo aya:
Abwo kare kare, ase ekenyoro kia Nyanchwa, ebigoro mbiarenge aroro. Bono ebigoro ebi nigo biagiteire ime y’emete emenge, eyio yameete naende yarenge kororekana buya. Abamenyi be ebigoro ebi nigo bamenyete n’ omogoko amo n’omorembe omonene.
Emaambia eyemo, abanto be ekegoro ekemo bagakumia ase aya baroche. Ase ekegoro ekemo, omote norenge oyomo bwamete na koba omotambe kobua emete yonsi pi ase ebigoro ebi bionsi biabebekaine aaiga.
Omote oyo ogakina okaba swanya
Ebisabo bi’ omote oyo nigo biasabogete, goikera bikaama na koba ebitambe mono ase chinsemo chionsi pi. Chinsagi chi’ omote oyo nigo chiarenge buna emete ende, eri yamete aiga ase ekegoro eke gose ebigoro biri binde biabebekaine aiga.
Ase boigo, amato y’ omote oyo akaama na koba amanene kegima, goikera agatanga omogaso togoika ase amaraba gose obonyansi. Omote oyo okairera ekiriri ekenene gocha aiga, goikera ekegoro ekegima omosunte okabwata omonene.
Bono ebimeri ao ao bikaba mbiri komera na koama ase eng’encho mbiare konyora omogaso erinde obimente chinguru biame ase botoereru. Ebimeri ebinge bigakwa, goikera egeateko gi' enchara gekarorekana koba ang’e.
Nonya nabo igo, ching’iti chi’ orosana chirochio nchibwate obosubore n’ omogoko ekiagera nigo chiare koria amato aya, ayio arenge gosaboka bogakia. Bono Abanto ba Nyanchwa bagatwara obwoba n’ omote oyo.
Bakanya korigia chinchera ao ao barayogechere, ekiagera omote oyo konye obeire omonene kerage. Abamenyi aba bakaigwana bayogeche gose mbache gokonyeka, nyuma enchara etarabaita korwa ase ekegoro eke.
Bono emaambia eyemo, bagaturana, na gochaka koyogecha. Bakayogecha bokaira na koirana riakagororoba chinsobo, ase baragerete na gotimoka korwa ase emeremo emekong’u bakorete rituko rigima.
Kai! Mote oyo tori kororekana gose nogechetwe.
Aankio yaye, bakairana kogenderera kogecha omote oyo korende bagakumia ekiagera banyorete omote oyo naende bwamire torikororekana gose nogechetwe rituko ria igoro yaye! Bagaichana korende bagachaka koyogecha.
Abamenyi ba Nyanchwa Hill: Ntwe nigo totagete kobutora omote oyo, erinde toagache chinyomba ase tokomenya. Korigereria korwa Kisii Town gochia aaria beautiful Nyanchwa Hill. Picture na Petronillah Ogoti, Gusii.com files.
Bono ekero bwairete aba bakairana chinsobo buna yarenge botambe, bakaboka rituko rinde na kogenda ase omote oyo na konyora naende bwamire anene kobua buna bayotigete! Bagakumia na goichana mono kerage.
Aya akaba kagokorekana ase amatuko atari make, goikera engaki baruseti moyo buna omote oyo tobwenereti gokunwa. Bagateba buna nigo ogotigwa igo, bwame goikera kaa ase oratigere kwama. Bono buna babwatete amakere na gotenena bayosonchete, Okanyoni oyomo akairuruka goocha ase barenge.
Okanyoni nabwate eng'ana
Okanyoni oyo nigo arenge omosiniini mono batare koyemanya buna n' Oknyoni ki orenge. Okanyoni oyo akabakwanera korende as’ eng’encho aba barenge n’ obororo obonge, tibachia komokwanera ekiagera nigo bayechayete buna tayarenge n’amang’ana arabakonye nonya n’ asinini.
Korende Okanyoni ere tachieti korusia moyo kobakwanera. Akagenderera kobatebia buna "Timoseka. Aya nkobatebia nigo are y’e ng’encho na nigo arabakonye ase anene kegima motaregokagera. Nche ninde n’ obokonyi n’ obobisi bw’ omote oyo obanchandire emiaka emenge"
Bono abanto aba bagakumia na gokira erinde bategerere aya Okanyoni oyo abwate. "Okaobori nere obanchandire ase amatuko aya onsi. Ekero mogokora kogecha nigo Okaobiri arenge gocha, omena ase mware gwatia erinde omote oyo osaboka obotuko obogima! Nigo Okaobiri atagete omote oyo onyakoba aroro ekiagera nigo okomokonya kwebisera ababisa baye erinde obatwara na konyora endagera yaye yak era rituko"
Okanyoni akagenderera okobatebia abamenyi b' Nyanchwa buna "Ekero mwainokire, nere buya mwatiga ebisire aroro na nigo mogwatia mwatiga aria ase atieriri arori igoro, erinde kogocha komena omote egesire kenyenye oromeme rwaye"
Ekero Okanyoni akoora goteeba amangana aya, abanto ba Nyanchwa bakaigwa buya na koirana chinsobo. Kobwakia emaambia yaye, bagacha n’ ebisire bitieriri bigaika na bagachaka goatia omote oyo ong’ana swanya.
Amamocho mono ase Okaobiri komena omote. Bono onyenyire oromeme rwaye rwensi pi!
Ekero riagororobete, aba bagatiga ebisire ase omote naaria ase atieriri akaroria igoro erinde bakagenda chinsobo. Buna botambe ere, Okaobiri agacha na kong’ea komena omote oyo. Keri keri, Okaobiri agachacka komena buna botambe na konyenya oromeme rwaye na korobutora!
Okaobiri akaigwa obororo, n' amanyinga agaiteka atari make. Okaobiri korora iga, agatiachoria n' chimbero chimbariri, tachia koirana rinde aiga. Korwa abwo, mote oyo tochieti gosaboka. Abamenyi b' Nyanchwa bakayogecha igo, goikera okagwa nse, n omogoko ogaichora ase abanto abwo bachagete gosimeka chindagera chikaama.

Chimengere chiasomoiri, na koba chintambe

Endemero y' omogaka. Omogondo aaria Botabori, Magombo, Nyamira County. Photo na Petronillah Ogoti, Gusii.com files.
Kare ang'e gosoka korwa mogondo, agaaka ebando eyemo konye yaberekire na ekagwa inse, n' ebando yonsi nyakeemba. Bono kiyagwa inse, Osoro akaigwa bobe mono ase ogosaria ebando eye. Akabogoria ebando eye erinde achie koyesamba kagoika inka sobo ayerie, korende akanyora nigo ere endere.
Akaruo akayeruta gochia ase obonyansi ime ekiagera konye teraba ekoriegwa. Nigo yarenge endere kegima. Keri keri, omonyaroka oyomo orenge korokwa Nyanchera agaeta mbarabare, gakorwa rinani ime gotenya.
Nyanchera nere bwetwekire chiinko, na gochaka kobongorora chinyeke korwa ase ekeemba
Bono Nyanchera nigo etwegete chinko na konye orosire. Gaaika aiga ang'e nase chibando chiasimekire, agatora chinko erinde atimoke, amanye kogenda mwabo. Akarora ebando egwete obonyansi ime na akayeimokia.
Akanya kobongorora chinyeke na gochiruta gochia are korwa ase ateneine. Ekeemba kegatigara kebwate chinyeke nkeigo, na kerokio agakeruta gochia ase obonyasi bwameete obotambe. Korwa abwo, akaruo akaimokia chinko chiaye na koayerera gochia sobo ase amenyete na sokoro yaye.
Bono chinyoni chiachakire korigia ganto chibeke mboto
Emagoroba eyio, chinyoni gichikoiruruka kwerigeria ganto chibeke mboto, chikanyora chinyeke chigwete na chigatocha chinyeke chiri Nyanchera arutete inse korende chinyoni echi tichiaroche ase ekeemba kiare.
Rituko riare kobwati ebikondo bikarwa rinani ime na gosoa ase ebitii biare. Egekondo ekemo gekarora ekeemba na gekaimokia ekeemba ekio na gegachaka koria achinyeke chie chibando chiria chiatigarete ase ekeemba eke.
Korora iga, ebikondo binde bikarora eke kegakare koria chinyeke gioka na gotema koura egekondo kiamwabo ekeemba eke. Korende egekondo eke gekaminchoka na korina omote igoro nyuma y' ebikondo binde komoikera.
N' ebikondo nabirobio mbitagete ganto kobeka mboto
Egekondo eke gekaruta chinyeke inke gochia igoro, echio chiachite chikagwa kw'omogaka oyomo konye ogotire. Chinyeke echi chikamera na kwama. Aiga ase omogondo bw'omogaka oyo nigo orenge omotobu na chinyeke echi chikaama buuya, mogaka oyo nigo amenyete bweka igo endagera nigo yaichire kiage kiaye.
Ase boigo, omogondo oye nigo omosinyete koburuga. Nonya nabo, tachiete komanya gose chinyeke chiamete kwaye chitari inke. Engaki yare kobwatia ye risimeka, omorakera okaba omonene ase ekenyoro eke.
Abanto abange bagatara gochia ase chinse chiare erinde banyore endagera bache koria ne chiamate chiabo. Ase egonga y'abanto aba bare kogenda korigia endagera omochokoro bw'omogaka oyo nere nao arenge.
Omochokoro oyo agatara, na goika ase omogaka oyo konye ogotire. Bono oogaka oyo nigo arenge kobagera abanto endagera yaye erinde baria amo ase obwanchani n'obwororo. Engaki eyemo omoiri bw'omogaka oyo akamotarera.
Omogaka oyo nigo atigaretie endagera enke mono korende akabwata akamoa endagera eri yonsi yatigarete ase ekiage kiaye, na agatebia omochokoro oye buna, "Genda orosie omogondo oo buuya erinde ocha gosimeka ekiagera gochia amatuko are motwe egiateko gi'enchara nkebe"
Bono emaambia yare kobwatia, omochokoro oyo akaboka akagenda mogondo ekiagera nigo atagete kogokia sokoro yaye. Kagasaine korema ase endemero, akarora chibando chiamete aiga ase orosana konye rwamerire omogondo oyo ang'e bwensi.
Omochokoro bw' omogaka oyo akaburuga aiga buuya, na akarangeria sokoro yaye ache kweenekeria endagera buna yaamete buuya ase omogondo oyo. Sokoro yaye akagoka korora endagera yameete enyinge atamanyete.
Bono omogaka oyo okung'untire endagera yaye yonsi pi, na koyea abaamate kobeka mboto
Ekero basamorete, buna yare botambe omogaka oyo akaa eamate yaye yonsi endagera eye na gosanga ase oboamo. Nyuma y'engaki etari ntambe, embura egachaka gotwa.
Bono bari bonsi bang'anyete gochia chinse chi'are bakairana nchisobo, korende nyuma batarairana omogaka oyo akabarangeria na kobasesenia aba bonsi na akabaa kera omonto chinyeke erinde bachie gosimike chinsobo. Omochokoro oyo ere agatigara na sokoro yaye erinde amorende na komoroseria endagera na kera risimeko na risamora korwa ase omogondo bw'omogaka oyo nigo riare rinyinge.
Bono kera omonto ase ekenyoro, agaancha omogaka oyo.

Response to Typepad Downtime this week
April 20, 2014
First, let us say how much we appreciate all members of the Typepad community. We know the last few days have been trying and stressful to you all and us. Please know you have a team of people who love Typepad who have been working and continue to work to keep Typepad up 24/7.
What happened?
Beginning Thursday evening, Typepad was hit with a distributed denial of service (DDoS) off and on through today. A DDoS attack is an attempt to make services unavailable, but in no way was your Typepad account compromised.
All information in your Typepad account is secure, including billing information. The attack on Typepad was similar to an attack on Basecamp which you can read about here. The Typepad blogs and application have been restored.
We put in place some roadblocks to mitigate the attack, but we are on high alert as attackers change their tactics regularly. We really appreciate all members of the Typepad community and your patience during this time.
We're here to answer any questions you may have about the attack.

Abwo kare kare ase ekenyoro kia Matongo, nigo Basweti amo n' Okangoko barenge abasani b' ogokumia. Ebitongwa ebi nigo bianchaine ekianda gia ikomi, na nigo abana babo bare gotiena aamo. Okangoko nigo amenyete egesera ime, korende Basweti ere ekamenya engoro ime.
Bono Basweti amo n' Okang'oko nigo barenge gochia barigeria abana babo endagera korwa chinsana ime. Okang'oko nigo arenge kobiara amagena. Oomoerio oye oturagia ebichuchu. Nere Basweti nigo arenge kobiara amagena, ko oturagia chimanu chi' ebasweti.
Okare gosegasega na koayerera, Okang'oko oyio kwagachia gochia korora buna erino riachandire omosani oye
Engaki eyemo buna yare botambe, Basweti amo n' Okang'oko bakamanora gochia korigeria amage abo endagera. Bono ebichuchu amo n' ebimanwa bigatigara bigotiena. Aaiga, ebimwana ebi mbiarenge n' ekioge ki' orwembe.
Takari gwansa! Ebimwana b' Basweti nkomena bire amanyinga
Keri keri buna bakonya gotiena, emanu y' Basweti ekanyenya egechuchu gi' Okang'oko mobasokano. Korwa abwo, amanyinga agaiteka atari make, korwa ase ebigoti aria ase egechuchu kianyenyetu. Ebimanu ebi bikaoboa kerage korende bigatema chinchera ao ao erinde amanyinga gose natige goiteka, goikera bagakorera komena egechuchu eke aiga ebigoti. Bakamena egechuchu eke igo, goikera manyinga agatiga goiteka.
Nonya nabo igo, nabo kware korora ase egechuchu eke kianyenyetu. Maiso a' bakungu igoro igoro, abaibori babo bagacha bare n' endagera. Kibaiika iga, ebichuchu bikare goteba ritangani buna ekiamwabo kianyenyetu kibagotiena, korende omwana bw' Basweti agakonya gotanga amanyinga goiteka.
Ebimwana mbitagete goteba egento gete, korende biasinyirwe
Koigwa iga, Okangoko akairaneria ebimanwa bi 'Basweti mbuya mono ase ogokonya egechuchu kiaye. Nonya nabo igo, ebimanu bi' Basweti korwa aare nabo biare kororekana buna mbiare n' eng'ana biatagete gotebia eng'ina ko bisinywa buna bigoteba.
Kera oyomo akaayerera gochia ase are korara. Amatuko akanya goeta amange n'obosani bwabo bokaba bore obuya buna bware korende enchara egacha na ekaba akang'u ase Basweti konyora endagera. Amatuko amange, Basweti n'ebimanwa biaye nigo bare korara nchara.
Endagera y 'Basweti nigo yare ching'iti chiri chinsinini korende eye Okang'oko nigo yare bwango konyora. Eke nakio kiagerete Okangoko ere atarenge korarera nchara. Ebimanwa bi 'Basweti omoerio oye bakarora mbuya batige kobisa eng'ina na komotebia buna amanyinga y' egechuchu gi Okang'oko nigo agotononta buya kerage ekiagera ekero erwembe yanyenyete egechuchu ebigoti igoro, nabo bayamenete bakaigwa buna agwansa.
Bono Basweti eere tachia koegena ebimanwa ebi amang'ana aya y' amanyinga y'ebichuchu buna agwansa korende enchara ekaba entindi mono, goikera ebimanwa b' Basweti gokwa bitari bike. Aiga nario bono Basweti abangete aite Okang'oko, erinde anyu amanyinga aye. Baswetu agaekora buna erino riamorire, na gotoma emanwa enkogoti echi korangeria Okangoko.
Emwana Enkogoti yatomirwe. Bono Okang'oko oyio okare koayerera na gosegasega, gochia gokonya Basweti
Emanwa eye ekaayerera na korangeria Okang'oko. Bono Okang'oko koigwa iga, okare koayerera na gosegasega bwango, na goika ase Basweti araire. Basweti agatebia Okangoko buna amorigerie monwa oye ime arore ndino ki eri rikomwatia botuko bogakia!
Basweti agaasama n' Okang'oko agatema gose narore erino erio riachandete omosani oyo oye. Nonya nabo, Okang'oko akanyora buna tari konyara korora nonya n' erino erimo. Bono Okang'oko agasoi omotwe oye ase omonwa o Basweti ime.
Nare N' egesio. Kai! Kagendererete kogekeria, Okang'oko okare kominchoria na gotiga amarionya ime y' omonwa o Basweti!
Kai! Basweti akagoka kerage na kobwatania omonwa oye na kong'usa ebigoti bi' Okang'oko mono. Okang'oko akang'usa na kogekeria kerage. Amanyinga agaiteka korende Basweti tachia kobutora omotwe ekiagera Okang'oko oyo nigo aminchoreti, agatiga amarionya aye ime y' monwa o' Basweti!
Bono eke nakio kiagerete Okang'oko nyagotichanga atatwarereti amarionya ase ebigoti biaye, nonya ngoikera rero.

Nigo atebete buna chinchera chiato chi' ogotwara ebirero ase amatuko a Tichi Gatano, chiagerire, gati ye ebinto binde ebinge, koiyeria amasomo ase chisukuru. Esirori yasingisirie omotwe, na kogenda kobwaye
Koigwa iga, Esirori egasingisia omotwe, na kogenda kobwaye, tiyamoiraneria. Keri keri, omwana oyo agachia akanyora Okaobiria na komoboria buna naki akorete agatwara amagunchara atato. Abwo abwo bono nario Nyamira County Women's Representative Mhe Alice Chae aimogete na goteba buna ere nachiete magotwa motwe.
Ase boigo, nigo Mhe Chae atebete buna ekemira eke nigo kere ekebe, naende giateire amatuko aye. "Nigo ngosaba buna nanga Mhe Angwenyi nigo are omosubati buna inche, oyio ochiete maguta motwe, korende ore moyo. Ase boigo, tiga Mhe Angwenyi atoenekerie buna abasacha bagototama, erinde bagenda konywoma abakungu korwa chinsemo chiria chitari kogenda maguta motwe" Nabo Mhe Chae amentete.
Mhe. Angwenyi, oyio ogendererete gwekwania, nigo atugutetwe isiko ya Parliament. Ababunge nigo baboretie buna tiga richiko rikong'igwe, ase ogosiria egekoro eke, ekio kere mamincha y' richiko ria Kenya, Prohibition of FGM Act of 2011 and the The Children's Act of 2001.

Chingingiti echi nigo chiarenge buna ebikondo, chinyang’au, ebiobiri, amo n' chingabi. Nchire chiare koria amato, nchire chiamenyete amache ime, na nchire chiamenyete ebiswa ime.
Engaki eyemo, omorakera omotindi ogaateka ase rinani eri ime. Riberera rigaichora mono, goikera amache akaba botu boke. Endo nero yatenenerete ching’iti echi chionsi aiga Bondonya. Bono Endo ekarangeria omosangererekano bwe ching’iti echi chionsi.
Ase omosangererekano oyo, ching’iti echi chikaigwana chireme egesima, erinde gose nchinyore amache chinywe. Obwango obwo obwo, ching’iti echi chikaigwana buna nigo chiare kobwaterana, erinde chireme egesima eke n' oboamo.
Bono Ogasusu otameire buna onyorire orogendo gochia mache ng'umbu !!
Ching’iti echi chigakunama gokunya egesima. Nonya nabo igo, Ogasusu ere taikerana ekiagera nigo atebete buna nigo anyorete esabari ya mobasokano, kogenda mache ng’umbu. Obwango obwo, chingiti echi tichieegena Ogasusu nonya.
Bono chigatebi Ogankuru akore obotuki bw’ Ogasusu erinde bamanye ase achiete. Ogankuru agatwara engaki enkong’u gokora obotuki bw’ okomanya ase Ogasusu arenge koreng’ana nase engaki eye ching’iti chinde chiare gokunya egesima gose mbanyore amache nonya n’ amasinini.
Chingaki echi chionsi, Ogasusu nigo ebisete mbarabare nase egesima eke kiare gokunywa, korende Ogankuru tamanya. Ogankuru akairana agatebia ching’iti chinde buna taigeti konyora ase Ogasusu aberete.
Bono ekero egiateko ekene giachicha aaria Bondonya, chingiti chinyinge chiagatwara erango y' amache enene na korea mono. Ogakondo ogatengerete korwa mbarabare y' egesima aaria Bondonya, Bomachoge Chache yaito, Kisii County. Mwanyagetinge.com/2014
Keri keri, amache agatoka n' ching’iti echi chikaigwa buya na gotiana buna Ogasusu tabaisa koyanywa. Gotanga Ogasusu tanywa amache aya, ching’iti echi chigatebania buna nere buya bebange erinde barende amache aya. Oganchogu akaba eng’iti entang’ani koyarenda erinde Ogasusu tabaisa koyanywa ekero bataiyo aang’e.
Chintunde nke igo, Ogasusu okare komingiriara goikera aiga ase egesima. Ekero aaika mbarabare n' egesima, Ogasusu agachaka goseka na goaka omonu gakomena oboke na goteba buna bokomwansera mono. Ogasusu agateba buna ere tarenge na botonu bw’okonywa amache, korende agatebia Oganchogu nere aigwe buna oboke obo bware gotonontera monu.
Bono Oganchogu osibirwe ase omote
Oganchogu akarusia oboke nakomena na agataka arie obonge !! Aaiga nario Ogasusu amotebetie buna tiga amosibe ase ekiiriri kere, erinde amene oboke obo obwansu, goikera bomoisane. Oganchogu agasibwa ase omote n' Ogasusu akanyora ribaga akarindoka gochia ase egesima eke na konywa amache, na gwesibia akaraba se !! Korwa abwo, akarwoo akagenda bwoye ase arenge koebisa.
Bono ching’iti ekero chiairanete konywa amache chikanyora amache taiyo n' Oganchogu nigo asibire na tare konyara gwesibora. Chingiti echi chikaigwa bobe pi. Rituko riare kobwatia, bakabeka Emamba erende amache aya erinde Ogasusu tabaisa koyanywa na koyaesiberia.
Ogasusu agasoa ekebuyu ime na gochaka goturungana kagokwana na goseka gochia ase Emamba yarenge. Bono Emamba korora aya, ekarora nebikone na gotama egatiga Ogasusu okonywa amache na gwesibia.
Ching’iti chionsi ekero chiairanete chikanyora Emamba nigo yatamete ekero yaroche ekebuyu kegoturungana na gokwana na goseka mono. Ebioto bionsi bikanyorera ribaga na gosoa amache aya ime na gochaka kwoga na goaka ontimbu.
Endo ekaigwa bobe na gotogonya ase eriogi rinene. Ching’iti chionsi chikaondoka kerage ekiagera Endo nigo yagechetigwe mono. Ogakondo agaesokia na goteba buna tiga ateme nabo arabwate Ogasusu oyo obachandire ase a matuko atari make.
Ogakondo agaancherwa korenda egesima eke kiabo erinde Ogasusu tabaisa goika konywa amache gose koyatumia gwesibia omobere oye naende. Ogakondo akarosia omobwekano bw’ omorabera omuuya omonyakieni kerage.
Ching’iti chikagokigwa ne ekebwekane eke. Ogankondo akabeka ekenanti erinde onde aise koyebwata nigo kware konanterera. Omobwekano oyo okabekwa aang’e ne egesima n' Ogankuru akeebisa erinde tarorekana n' Ogasusu ase aberete.
Bono Ogasusu okare kwerindori gocha buna botambe !!
Ogasusu agacha buna botambe korende tarora onde orendete egesima eke. Kai !! Ogasusu akagenda rioka korende amaiso aye akagokigwa n’ omorabera oteneine aang’e n’ egesima eke korende otarenge gokwana na Ogasusu.
Ogasusu akaruo agakuna omorabera oyo. Bono buna amokunete okoboko kwaye gokananta na akaira okoboko koria gwatigarete erinde ang’use oko konde. Naboigo oko gokananta na agasinywa buna are gokora !! Agachia gotema igo, ekaba akong’u.
Chingaki echi chionsi, Ogakondo nigo amotengerete korwa egetutu kiare mbarabare ne egesima eke. Ake ake, Ogankondo akarangeria ching’iti chiamwabo. Chingiti echi chikaminyoka gocha na konyora Ogasusu nigo anantete ase ekebwekane eke ki’ omorabera. Bono ching’iti echi chigachaka koa Ogasusu ebinyerere.
Ogasusu akarera igo, korende onde taiyo omorocherete amabera. Bono bagateba buna nigo bare gwokia omorero eriinde basambe Ogasusu oyo obachandete ase amatuko atari amake. Omorero okabekwa n' Endo ekanantoria Ogasusu na komobwata amorute riiko. Riria Endo yamobwata iga, Ogasusu akaminchoria na koniantoka ne chimbero chimbariri. Ching’iti echi chigachia komominyoki igo, tichiamoikera.
Korwa erio, Ogasusu karorire ching’iti chi’ orosana, nigo agotama.

Aya amwabo aya:
Omongina magokoro Moraa ominto nantagete gontebia engana. Baba nigo atagete gonsemia igoro y' ogosira kw' omogaka oria obwate abakung'u abange. Ekero omogaka ore n’ abarugi abange akuure, Ekegusii gete ki' eng’encho nkiagakorirwe, buna omong’ina magokoro Moraa agoteba.
Ogokobani nkwarengeo ase Ekegusii
Bono buna omogaka oyo atweka mo iga, nigo kera omokung'u oye, arenge kominyoka gochia mwaye ogokobani. Inee, bono ogokobani ninki? Nabo oraborie.
Eee abakungu abange mbakanywomirwe n' omogaka oyomo ase chingaki echio chi kare. Ebitega mbiakaarekirwe, n' ebinto biaturekwa, naende biagororokigwa, ko omogaka bw' omochie asirire. Below: Nka Gusii
Omong’ina Moraa nigo agoteba buna ogokobani n’ ogoonchora chianga, omong’ina akobeka. Nigo omong'ina nyene nyagosira arenge kobeka chianga chia ime, maonchorerane. Korwa abwo, omanya kobeka chianga chia nyagosira korwa igoro, nachirochio maonchorane!
Naende omong'ina nyene nigo arenge kweyaka riibu, ko omogaka oye asirire
Tari igo rioka. Kera omong’ina nigo arenge koeyaka riibu, buna omware. Komenta nayio, kera omong'ina tarenge gwesibia. Yaya. Aase engaki eye yonsi y' ebirero ekero omogaka oyo akuure, omong'ina oyo tarenge gokwanigwa n' okoboko, goikera ebirero biaerire.
Nigo baba Moraa akomenta buna mong'ina oyo tarenge koererigwa endagera koboko. Nigo endagera yarenge goterekwa nse, omong'ina oyo omanya koyeimokia korwa nse. Emorogoba y' omogaka oyo gosira, kera omokung'u nigo arenge kobera mwaye.
Nigo omogaka nyagosira arenge kobekwa mw' mosera ibu omonene ritang'ani
Korwa abwo, omobere bw’ omogaka oyo orentwa na gosoigwa mw’ mosera ibu [ omokung'u ] omonene ritangani. Korende onye mosera ibu tari moyo, omokung'u o kabere ori ore moyo nao omobere orenge koirwa.
Kera mosera ibu nigo arenge kobera mwaye, orara goikera rituko riria ri' ogotindekwa. Emaambia yaye ase rituko erio ri' ogotindekwa, omobere nigo orenge gosokigwa. Korwa abwo, embera yaremwa. Magega y' embera koremwa, omomura omonene bw’ enyomba enene nere orenge goaka egekamago ki' oboina.
Onye omomura omonene bw' enyomba enene taiiyo, omochokoro bw’ omomura omonene bwe enyomba enene nere orenge goaka egekamago ekio ki' oboina. Ekero engaki y’ ogotindekwa yaikire, abang’ina b' omogaka oyo bonsi nigo bare koruta amaraba gochia ase embera.
Mosera ibu omonene nere orenge gochaka koyaruta amaroba aya, abande babwatia korwa magega. Omobere gotubereirwe, kera oyomo omanya kogenda mwaye. Emorogoba oyio ko omogaka atindekirwe, kera omong’ina nigo arenge konyenya eming'ichi y’ ogokendi enyomba.
Abakiare ba nyagosira mbange koria emingichi eye. Yaya.
Eming'inchi eye nigo yare koriegwa n' onde bwensi ase eamate, otatiga abakiare ba nyagosira. Emaambia yaye bogokiamoka, abang’ina b' omogaka oyo bonsi nigo barenge kogingerana etuki, aase oboina igoro. Ase boigo, abangina aba nigo barenge kobutorwa ebitinge, bamanya kobibeka ase embera igoro.
Ko babekire ebitinge ebi aase embera igoro, kera omongina nigo arenge koirana mwaye. Korwa abwo, egoree yanyenywa, erinde ebitega biaarekwe. Ekero ebitega biakorire koarekwa, ebinto bi' omogaka nyagosira nigo biarenge goturekwa.
Bono ogoturekwa ninki? Naende nabo oraborie. Oko n' ogotureka ebinto ebinene b' nyagosira kwoorokia gose koba ekemanyererio ki' ogosira kwaye. Ritangani, ritimo rio omogaka nyagosira nigo riarenge goturekwa, riarigereria gochia nse. Korwa abwo, ekerogo kiaye nyamagoro atato, nakerokio nigo kiarenge goturekwa !!
Okogororokigwa nkwarengeo ase Ekegusii
Ko ogotureka kwaerire, amarwa nigo arenge kwengerwa egetera ime, akora amatuko atano n' abere. Omongina magokoro Moraa nigo akomenta buna korwa abwo, ebinto nigo biare kogororokigwa. Bono okogorokigwa ninki? Naende nabo oratware riborio riinde. Ritimo n’ ekerogo kia nyagosira, nigo biarenge gotenenegiwa buya, ase engencho bono ebirero biaerire.
Aya gakorirwe, abang’ina aba bamanya kobeka chianga buya bono, na gwesibia omobere erinde abaamate bonsi, goikera aaria ase abasubati basogete, bacha bakora omoyega omonene. Omong'ina magokoro Moraa ominto nao akorera abwo na goteba buna monywe mache maya goikera chingaki chiinde.
Mbuya mono and thank you for listening.

Ntwe ntomanyeti buna ninki kiagerete bagateba amangana aya na koyaereria korwa ekegori ekemo, gochia aase ekegori kende. Aya na amang'ana gete y' Abagusii, ayio eise koba buna kwayakorire, nigo arenge koba mamincha y' Ekegusii. Emegiro.Abagusii nigo babagete amang'ana ayio, emegiro aase eng'encho arenge koba mamincha y' oboseera bw' Omogusii. Tari igo rioka. Abagusii nigo beegenete buna oise koyakora, n' chimuuma. Nigo ebinto, gose chinkore gete chiimbe, chiare gocha koba, gose kogokorekanera.
Aya amwabo aya:
Abagusii Culture And Customs XXVII: Emegiro Y' Ekegusii [ I ]
Abagusii Culture And Customs XXXIX: Emeyega Ao Ao Y' E Ekegusii
Abagusii Culture And Customs LXXI: "Okwo N' Ogoturutumba Ekegusii" Omogaka Sokoro Ominto
Aase amatuko amake aerire, ntwasomete igoro y' emegiro y' Ekegusii, etano n' ebere, aase Emegiro y' Ekegusii [ I ]. Ase okoinyora, nigo omongina magokoro baba ominto atebete buna kera egesaku aase ense eye nkiabwate emegiro.
Ase boigo, nigo baba atebete buna kobwatekana n' abagaka n' abangina abakoro, gokora amang'ana ayio nigo yarenge koba mamincha y' Ekegusii. Ase rituko ria rero, magokoro nigo atagete kogenderera n' enkwana eyio. Kobwatekana na baba ominto, emegiro ende y' Ekegusii nigo ere buna iga:
8. Mosacha mogima bori: Aase Ekegusii, monto mosacha mogima tarenge gosoa irongo. Yaya. Nigo yare koba chimuuma, aise korina engasi kwagachia gose gosoa irongo riinde rionsi. Ase boigo, inyora buna chimuma chia Abagusii nigo chiare gocha n’ amaakwa amanene.
Amasikani aase iso biara. Obori bori bogocha gosiegwa ,erinde sokoro aroiseririgwe erongori nao bore irongo. Sokoro tagosoa irongo ime. Yaya. Irongo n' ya magokoro. Kona gotakuna obori aange na iso biara nkwarengeo. Below: Ekee k' obokima bw' Omogusii.
9. Ebimwana ebike: Omwana omoke tarenge koegwa enyama y' riini erinde arie. Yaya. Gaise koegwa riini, aye rirorio nario okwerorera. Nigo akamwana buna akwo karenge koba agatamu, naende akamwenu ekianda gia ikomi! Omwana buna oyio, nkware komotoma gose komoboria akore kende.
10. Abasacha baria banchete kona gotirigoyia na kona goita abakungu babo bokaira: Ekero omosacha are goita omokungu oye bw’ enywomo, omokungu oyo nigo arenge gotama gochia irongo, gose nyaaro. Tari igo rioka Bosibori ominto.
Omokungu oyo okona goitwa aaise koba buna okunire chimbere chiaye, omosacha oyo oye tarenge komoaka. Yaya. Eye nigo yarenge kobwekana buna ogosaba amabera. Omosacha oyo nyagotwanga mokaye arenge goaka omokungu oyo naende gakunire chimbere, echio n' chimuuma aase Ekegusii!
Komenta nayio, omokungu oyo nyagotwangwa arenge kobwata omwana kwaa, ekero agoitwa, nigo are gotiga goitwa ekiagera okwo nakwo okwoorikia buna osabire okwabera.
11. Nyomenda nkobugia are omorori: Korwa bokoro ase Ekegusii, mokungu tarenge kobugia morori. Aaise gokora igo, omokungu oyo nigo arenge kogera omosacha oye aanse koema, na gokwa!
12. Moka momura ngotakuna are endagera: Moka momura tatakeire gotakuna obori aase ise biara are. Yaya nonya. Okwo nigo kwarenge ogosaria Ekegusii. Eng’encho ende, omokungu buna oyio, nigo arenge kong’ong’ori ise biara. Amasikani aera. Bobe mono.
Omongina magokoro nao akorera abwo aase rero. Ntooche togenderere n' emegiro eende, chingaki chiinde. Korwa ase baba ominto, mbuya mono, and thank you for listening.

Nigo anywometwe ase enyangi ye Ekegusii na kobekerwa ebitinge. Tari igo rioka. Nigo abegete ebitinge mbaka ekero abatisetwe ase the SDA Church aaria Nyanchwa. Omongina Paulina Bosibori Nyandusi.

Ntotagete obochege!
Enywomo nigo yasikire na abakoro. Ase chingaki chia kare enyangi ye ebitinge nigo yagakorirwe ekero gio okonywomana. Ritangani, esigani nigo yare gotomwa gochia sobo enyaroka yaira eng'ana egoteba buna imbatagete kobanywomera (ntotagete obochege!).
Togende ase ekerorano
Korwa aiga rituko rie ekerorano nigo riare kobekwa. Yaani ekerorano ninki? Nabo oraborie. Ase ekerorano nario omosubati no omomura bare kororana ritangani. Omomura na abasani baye nigo bare gochikwa gochicha sobo omosubati erinde barorane no omoiseke.
Omosubati onye tatageti momura oyo, nigo are kwabusa risiko riabo baroo. Ase ki? Erinde bamanye inga ere tatageti gose tancheti momura oyio. Yaani eyio nigo yarenge enchera yo okobaseria in a polite way. Egere kobaseri aba.
Korende onye bwanchire, tare kwabusa. Ekeriboko ekero kiaariganigwe, ogotera nigo kware goterwa abanto batwara omogoko. Bono korwa aaiga chiombe chio okonywoma omoiseke oyo, nigo chiare gokwanerwa.
Abamura abangaini nigo bare koba na riso rimo ase omoiseke!
Ritangani, embori amo n' eeri y' egesicho amo ne chiombe nigo chiare korwegwa. Abanyene omosubati amo no omomura nigo bare koigwana. Ekero kio ogoakana chiombe, esira ngotigara yare. Korwa abwo, abamura bono nigo bare gochikwa bagenda sobo omoiseke. Abwo sobo omoiseke, nigo barenge gotenga bwakia, korende bare na riso rimo ase omoiseke !
Nigo bare korenda erinde omoiseke oyio tatama gochia bongina rome. Omoiseke oyio aise gocha gotama na kobasireria, nigo bare goakwa a fine ye embori eyemo. Abamura batamanyeti gasi. Oigwe bono. Ko bakorire gotenga ase rimaambia, nigo bare kogenda no omoiseke oyio korwa aiga mpaka sobo omomura.
Ebinto mbuya bire. Taraire mosisi!
Korende bado. Mangana taraera. Amatuko atato kaerire, obokima n' embori nigo bware koirwa ase omosubati oyo osogete egere bamanyigwe gose mbaigwananete no omogaka oyo oye, gose nigo ararete mosisi !
Bakonyora ng'a amangana mbuya are (yaani omomura no omoiseke mbakorete egasi buya), na bonsi mbaisanegete, omoiseke oteba atimigwe ebitinge. Manya ng'a omoiseke arenge gokana inga binto tibiarenge buya, hakuna ebitinge!
Bono korwa abwo, enyangi yaariganigwa ekorwe, n' omosubati oirana sobo. Abamura n' abasubati baba tayare na amakano. Omonyakiore n' esumati amo n' omoimari n' abamura nao bare koba aaiga. Bado maneno si rahisi hivyo. Enyameni nigo yare kobekwa.
Oyo okobua ase enyameni eye nere ore koegwa ritana rie engombe. Ekondo nero yarenge aroro, eyio omoimari are gotanganigwa no omonyakeore. korwa ensemo ya abamura nigo tware gotwara, omonyakeore ore gotangana motwe, omongwasi, nere omonywomi nakorwa ase omosubati no omoimari, omoriakari, agasagane ko obosi ne enyaroka ya amaguta.
Emanwa ye embori nigo yare komosinyorera amagoro!
Nyangi chia kare nchiare koumerana nchera. Mbobe pi ase Abagusii. Omokundekane bono nere ore gotimi ebitinge. Omoriakari nigo are korambora amagoro, emanu ye embori yamoetanana round and round yamanya komosinyorera amagoro !
Bamanya konyenya akamanwa aka kwamanya kobekerwa ebitinge. Oko nakwo ogotimigwa egetinge. Enyangi yamanya gotererwa gochia sobo omomura. Eye nero enyangi ye ebitinge .

"Nintagete kogenda bware" Ebimura binde can't wait kogenda iburu.
Iburu, maguta motwe no okwaroka na amarieta ye Ekegusii yo ogosara. Abaisia ki baikire emiaka ikomi mbaka ikomi ne ebere nigo bare goisanera kogenda iburu. Mara enyinge, iburu nigo yare gochiegwa ase engaki yo omotienyi bwe Egesunte kende (December) ase kera omwaka.
Abaisia nigo bare kwearigania ase omoyega oyo buna ekobwatia. Nigo bare korigia chingoko bagochia konyenya ne ebitugi bio ogouta omorero ekero bare nyomba. Inyora inga morero bwo omware tonya korima.
Omosari nigo arenge koba oyomo ase ekenyoro ekegima na abasae bataranywoma nabwo bare kobira abaisia ekero bare gochia iburu. Obotuko bwo ogokiera rituko rie enyangi ya iburu, aba be enyangi nigo bare korara na abamura barie bachiete iburu banyenya chingoko.
Mambia maaambia, nigo abaisia aba bare koirwa roche gwesibia amache amakendu na korurwa ne chinyanduri ne risa egere beariganie ase enyangi eye. Abasegi nigo bare kobogoria amatimo na kweboyia amayo.
Egetono nigo kiare korosigwa kiamanya koruma buna endo. Aaiga, nigo bare gotebigwa buna endo igo yare kobamera nande yabaroka. Ekero kio ogosarwa gwaikire nigo oyo ore kogenda iburu are gotarera omote gochia magega egere tarora amanyinga buna agoiteka.
Korwa aiga amatera yo obware aterwa kwagachia ase omware are koirwa. Omorero nigo ore gosegeswa bwoka amatuko onsi pi omware are nyomba. Ki yare komochani orime, nigo yare koba chimuma naende yare kobetereria okorerane chisokoro.
Omware nigo are gosoa saiga na korwa gesieri korende tare koirorera goeta gesieri eke. Korwa bono, nigo are gotumia etirisa. Omware nao agasokeire etirisa ochia gwota ensakia korende kera rituko nigo are kweyaka ribu.
Mware tare korora gose gwesibia mache mpaka arwe nyomba. Abare nigo bare kobeka egesena. Abwo nyomba, nigo bare gokora emekubio ene. Engaki eyio ye emekubio ene kiyaerire, nigo yare gokagerwa buna omware obwenire na korwa nyomba.
Ekero akorwa nyomba, mware tare gweeta gesierie keri asoerete. Nigo are kogenda roche bwesibia na kweboyia buya. Korwa aiga mware tare korara saiga aria ase arenge nyomba. Nigo are korara ase eamate amatuko abere omanya koirana sobo.
Goansera aiga omware bono nigo are no obosiborwe bwo ogotumia gesieri kende gionsi gia saiga. Bono gochakera engaki eye, momura bwarogete tare gosoa ase abaibori bare korara. Echio ne chimuma. Inee rero enyangi eye nereo?

Omogaka sokoro ominto nantebetie buna Mwanyagetinge ominto omokoro naegenete ebinto gete, ebio ekero biakorekanire, egento gete nigo kegokorekana. Nabo kerabe ekiya gose ekebe. Ase rituko ria rero, tiga ingo toyakwanere amang'ana aria abakoro baito babegete okwegena ase are buna ekobwatia:
1. Ekiegesa: Ekero ekiegesa kiarenge koria omonto, nigo yarenge gotebekana ng'a aande aake omonto nare okare kogokwana. Na kogesiria, nigo kwarenge gotebigwa obare abana bamino ase omoyo ime, otari gokwana oigwekane !!
2. Gotamboka ebite bie ching'eni: Oise gotora ching'eni ebite erinde obitige inse omonto ache abitamboke, nigo ebianda bigokoria na ochake kominyoka ekero kwabekire ching'eni echi riiko, goikera gwachiyekire erinde gwachirire.
3. Naiguure bwatiokire: Oise kogenda mw' omwamate oo, omanye konyora buna okorire koragera naende n' ebinto bakoenia korwa emesa, nigo yarenge gotebekana buna aye nigo okare gokwana omoamate oyo oo bobe. Korende oise goika onyore nigo bagotereka endagera emesa baragere gose mbagasaine koragera, nigo egotebekana buna nigo ogokwana omwamate oyo buuya.
4. Oyo tata nakamura aranyore: Omosacha mokaye ebwateranetie n' egioto geise komocharoka okogoro, nigo yarenge gotebekana buna omorugie oye nigo agocha koibora omwana omomura.
Kai tata !! Egioto giacharokire amagoro y' omogaka Simba Ndemo aaria Kisii Town, Kisii County. Tokare goika n' magokoro baba ominto aaria Barclays Bank, Kisii Town. Mwanyagetinge.com/2015
5. Endoto embe: Oise korota omonto orwarete buna ogwenire na konora nigo egotebekana ng'a endoto eye n' embe na nigo oyo arakwe.
6. Omwana ngoseka are: Omwana omoke ekero araire aise goseka, igo nigo yarenge kororekana buna nigo arota buna ise okuure.
7. Omwana nkorera are: Omwana omoke ekero araire aise korera karaire, nigo yarenge gotebekana buna nigo arota buna ng'ina okuure.
8. Oyo tata nigo arabe oundu: Oise gotamboka omwana nigo egotebekana buna omwana oyo tagokina atambee gochia igoro.
9. Oyo n' omogworu: Ekero omonto akorota oyomwabo buna okure nigo egotebekana buna nigo aragerete obotuko obuo akaigota kerage.
10. Eye yabeire ekeriero: Etwani iese kobuga chinsa chiri etabwenereti kobuga buna botuko gati, igo mbobe. Nigo yarenge gotebekana buna omonto bw' eamate eye nache atwe ekamo. Etwani buna eye nigo yarenge konyenywa ase obwango na koba ekeriero.
Koru ase omogaka sokoro ominto, mbuya mono and thank you for listening.

Abagusii: Ingai Twarwete?
The First Gusii.com Blog Post On February 22, 2009.
"Bono Ninki Mokonya Korikera Igoro Y' Outdated Customs And Traditions?" Omongina Clemencia Mokeira
Emegano y' ororeri rwaito ntwe Abagusii n' emenge. Nigo togotebigwa buna ntwe Abagusii twensi nigo twarwete aaria Misri. Kobwatekana n' omogano oyomo, ororeri rwaito nigo rore iga:
Omonto akaibora Enonko. Enonko akaibora Ribiaka. Ribiaka akaibora Magoma. Magoma akaibora Osogo. Bono Osogo nere akaibora Mogusii. Bono sokoro yaito Mogusii, akamanya koibora Mogusero, Mochorwa, Mobasi, Nyaribari, Mogirango, Mogetutu, Monchari, na Momachoge.
Okonywoma n' okonywomwa gochia ase ebisaku binde nkare gwaansete: Aaiga Transmara nao omosubati oyomo o Gusii orenge korokwa Koinania anywometwe n' Omomanyi na gotigara. Gatigara oo, ntwe tokagenderera n' orogendo rwaito gochia Botende. Ase igo, twensi n' abamo n' Abamanyi egekogera mbabwate amanyinga aito.
Abangina b' omogaka Mogusii
Mogusii nanywomete abakungu batano buna ekobwatia:
1. Moguche Ibu ore korokwa Kemunto akaegwa erieta rie ebitinge akarokwa Bonareri.
2. Nyamisanchu ore korokwa Kwamboka oetwe Nyaboke, koba erieta rie ebitinge.
3. Bosibori nere obwate omomura okorokwa Mocharwa.
4. Bwari nere oiborete omomura okorokwa Omache, o Monchari. Omache nere naende orogetwe Onchari Omache, Chindiba Chia Bokendu.
5. Mokeira, oyio oiborete Sereti ore Omogusero.
Emegano yo ogocha n' okonganya kwa Abagusii nigo ere emenge. Ase boigo, emegano eye tiyarigetwe aande. Ntwe nigo tokoyerika bono buna togotebigwa. Ase boigo, nigo togotebigwa buna ase chingaki echio chionsi , eganga ya Abagusii nigo yarenge konganya ase okorigia ense entobu ase ebimeri.
Gotenena nkwarengeo. Onye ememiso gose mesabakwa tiyarengeo, abagaka nigo barenge goteba nga "Togenderere gochia motwe".
Ase okonganya kwabo, nigo barenge korigia ase ememiso amo n' emesabakwa ere emenge. Ebi nabio biare kobaorokia buna ase ayio natobu. Omogano omotangani nigo ore iga:
Omogano oyo nigo ogoteba buna Omogusii nigo arwete korwa chinsemo chia Irianyi gose ensemo ya Mombasa, mbaka agacha goika aiga nka Gusii. Ase Abagusii, Mombasa eyio, nigo naende yare yare korokwa Mokendo o' Iruma.
Nigo togotebigwa buna Mogusii narenge na momura omwabo ore korokwa Otere oyio onaende ore korokwa Mogikoyo. Abamura aba babere nabwo batirete korwa Irianyi ya Mokendo o Iruma (Mombasa) na gocha gatigati ya Kenya.
Aiga gatigati ya Kenya, Otere nao atigarete. Mogusii amo na basubati bamwabo bakanyora buna ememiso amo n' emesabakwa tiyarenge aaiga gatigati ya kenya. Korende Mogusii, kare na abasubati bamwabo bakagenderera ase okong'anya ko batiga Otere aaira gatigati ya Kenya.
Omosubati oyomo ore korokwa Moragori, nigo atigarete aaria aange na Mt Elgon (Boruya) ase okonganya, akaba ngina Abamaragoli. Omosubati onde, Mosoba agatigarera igaaria Suba. Ase boigo, omosubati onde omwabo Mogusii, ore korokwa Mokogoti, naende gose Mokoro, nigo achiete agatigara aaria Botende (kuria).
Korwa gatigati ya Kenya, Mogusii nigo atorete aaria Boruya. Nonya nabo igo, nigo banganyete naende korwa Boruya na komotiga Moragori aroro. Korwa abwo, bagatirimboka gochia chinsemo chia Irianyi ya Boruya na goika Egesumu (kisumu).
Below: Beautiful Mokendo O' Iruma: Omogano onde bw' Abagusii nigo ogoteba buna Mogusii amo na abamura babwabo abwo barenge Otere [Mogikoyo], Momeru, Mokamba, Moragori amo na Moembu nigo baimogete ase orogendo korwa aaria Mokendo O' Iruma [Mombasa]. Ntomanyeti buna ninki kiagerete Mogikoyo, Momeru Mokamba, amo na Moembu bagatigarera aaria Central kenya, korende Moragori amo na Mogusii barabwo bakagenderera n' orogendo.
Aaiga ase ensemo ya Egesumu, bakaagacha egesarate gio okomenya (ebisumu) abwo Egesumu (Kisumu), korende chimori chikaagacherwa ebisumu ebinge. Mogusii akaroka asaya, Egesumu (Kisumu) korwa ase ebisumu ebi baroseti.
Buna togotebigwa, aaiga Kisumu nao omomura oyomo orenge korokwa Orechi [Enswe ase Ekegere] aiboreretwe. Ase boigo, aaiga nao omoiseke orenge korokwa Kemunto (gulf ase Ekenyamorero) aiboreretwe.
Mogusii tachieti komenya abwo Kisumu ase amatuko amange. Ogocha kwa Abagere amo n' riroba gotaba riitobu gokagera Abagusii naende bakanganya korwa Egesumu kogenda ase akorokwa Gwasi. Aaiga Gwasi, riroba itobu ndiarenge aroro nonya.
Ase engencho eyio, Abagusii amo na abande naende bakanganya na gotiga Mosoba (Abasuba) aroro. Aaiga Bosoba nao omwana omomura orenge korokwa Mosoba aiboreretwe. Korwa Kisumu, Mogusii bagaeta na gotamboka ase Ekemunto (gulf) na kwamboka gochia ase ebitunwa bia Gusii.
Ko baika Gusii, bagaatanekana. Mokoro akagenda Botende (kuria) na Mosoba akamboka kogenda Bosoba (Suba). Nonya nabo igo, Mogusii ere agatigara Gusii na mbaka rero nao are Gusii. Oyo noro omogano bw' okonganya gwaito omotangani.
Aba bonsi n' abaminto. Omokamba, Omoragori, Omogikoyo, Omoembu, Omomeru, Omotende, Omosoba: Nigo tokona goitana bosa. Aba mbamura n' baiseke baminto.
Omogano onde bw' omochakano bwo Omogusii nigo ogoteba buna Abagusii nigo barwete Misri (Egypt ase rero). Ritangani, nigo togotebigwa ng'a Mogusii, oyio ore ise bw' Abagusii bonsi, narenge amo na bamura babwabo abwo barenge Moragori, Mokamba, Mogikoyo, Moembu, amo na Momeru.
Baminto ng'ai twarwete?
Nigo togotebigwa buna Mogusii, kare na bamura bamwabo, nigo atirimbogete ase chingegu chi' oroche rwa River Nile na goeta gati gati y ense ya Ethiopia. Korwa abwo, akagenda Sudan na gosokera aaria Uganda. Korwa Uganda (Boganda), Mogusii nigo agendererete n' orogendo mbaka agaika aange na Mt. Elgon.
Nigo togototebigwa aaiga Mt. Elgon, nao Mogusii aatananakenate amo na abamwabo, na kogenda kobwaye. Moragori ere agatigara aaria ange na Mt Elgon, na koba ase egesaku kia Abaluhya. Gatiga abamwabo, Mogusii akang'anya na kogenda komenya aaria aange na Siaya, eyio ere Bogere ase rero.
Ntomanyeti buna ninki kiagerete Mogusii agatiga abawabo ase okonganya oko. Ase engencho y' chisegi korwa ase Abagere be ense eyio ya Siaya, Mogusii akang'anya naende, korwa abwo na kogenda komenya aaria Egesumu (Kisumu).
Erieta "Kisumu" n' rie Ekegusii
Aaiga, Egesumu, nigo Abagusii baagachete ebisumu ebinge bie chiombe, ekagera bakayaroka (Gesumu) Kisumu. Nigo togotebigwa buna aaiga Gesumu nao Mogusii amo na ng'ina, oyio ore korokwa Nyakomogendi basirerete na gotindekwa.
Nonya nabo igo, chiombe chigaansa gokwa n' enchara enene ekaba abwo Egesumu. Ge enchara yaba, abana ba Mogusii tibachieti komenya igaa ase amatuko amange. Ase engencho y enchara eye, abagaka abanene b' egesaku giaito ase engaki eyio, abwo barenge Mobasi, Oibabe, Mochorwa na Mogusero bakaroberia okonganya kwa Abagusii korwa Egesumu, kogenda gochia ase ebitunwa bia Gusii ya rero.
Ke emeroberio eye y' okonganya yaera, bagatamboka ase ekemunto (gulf) na goika ase ebitunwa bia Gusii ya rero. Korwa ase ebitunwa bia Gusii, bakagenderera konganya mbaka bagaika Kericho [eye nero naende ekorokwa Kabianga].
Ko baika Kabianga, obokongu bokaba. Ndagera tiyare kwama. Tari igo rioka. Esegi korwa ase Abamanyi amo no Abasigisi ekaba entindi. Komenta nayio, oborwaire obonge ase etugo amo na abanto bokabucha. Bono emechando eye yonsi ekagera Abagusii bakaroka ase aya, Kabianga.
Ke emechando emenge yaba aaiga Kabianga, Abagusii bakanganya naende na koirana bagotirimboka gochia Sotik, Gelegele, Ikorongo, Trans Mara [ Emara gose Transmara, Mara Motobo, Igena ria Gamba].
Naende nigo tokona goitana bosa. Abamanyi mbabwate amanyinga aito ntwe Abagusii.
Aaiga Emara Motobo nao omosubati oyomo bwa Abagusii orenge korokwa Nyakoinania anywometwe amo na Abamanyi na gotigara Bomanyi. Korwa abwo, Abagusii bakagenderera ase okonganya gochia Migori (Botende), Nyangarora, Nyakoe, Getembe [ ange na Marani], Manga Isecha (Emanga y' Ogeto, na Monyerero) ime ya Central kitutu, amo na aaria Emanga nse ya Ikuruma.
Egesaku getabwati abarai nigo kegotagoka. Abarai mbakabeiroo korwa kare
Abwo ase obomenyi n' okonganya gwaito gwensi korwa Egesumu, Abagusii ntwabwate abagaka abanene abwo barenge korwa oborai amo n' obosemia. Gati y' abagaka abwo ase chingaki echio nigo barenge koraa chinyomba chia Abagusii nigo barenge buna ekobwatia:
[I]. Abanchari [Omogaka Oisukia nere orenge omorai].
[II]. Ababasi [Mogichoncho, oyio orenge omomura omonene o Mobasi nere orenge omorai].
[II]. Abasweta [ Omogaka Manyanta nere orenge omorai]. Ka moranche inyora buna Abanyaribari amo na Abamachoge nabwo Abasweta. Abagusii mbebagete amarieta gete ye chingiti ao ao, amarieta ayio akabwata. Omogaka Manyanta nigo arenge koraaa Abanyaribari amo na Abamachoge bonsi.
[IV]. Abagetutu [ Omobani Sakawa nere orenge omorai]. Ase okoinyora naende, Omobani Sakawa nigo arwete ase enyomba ya Abageka aaria Bogetutu. Abageka nabwo barenge enyomba enchorwa ya ababani ase Abagusii. Tochiesera Abageka.

Abagusii Culture And Customs XXXVIII: Konywoma Omoiseke Otaarogeti
Inee, aye tata Omogusii ominto n' omanyete buna amarieta nare togokorekania ekero tokoyakwanera? Inche namanyete buna kogenda bware, gosarwa, gochia iburu, gochia nyangi, kwaroka ,gochia maguta motwe nigo atabwekaini. Nonya nabo igo, omongina magokoro baba Nyareso ominto nigo antebetie buna amarieta aya tabwekaini buna ekobwatia:
1. Ogochia bware: Eke nakio egekamago, ogosomigwa buna obwenerete koba otarakorerwa egetambokero kende gionsi ki' omokebi gose omosari. Nigo abamura gose abanyaroka barenge kobekwa aamo basomigwa aya bagwenerete komanyigwa erinde banya korema.
Amachiko buna aya naro aregotebwa ase bari barenge koirwa bware: Obe omoremu, torigereria omokebi ekero ogosarwa, tobaisa kobwata omosari okoboko kwaye ekero akogosara, bakungu mbarenge konacha egonde ekero omware arenge koirwa inka, abamura nigo barenge korusia esimbore batari gokira goikera inka, ekero baisire goika inka abamura aba nigo barenge kobisa omware ase egetutu goikera marogoba eike ekiagera tatakeire kororwa n' onde. Ase boigo, omoyega nigo orenge kwariganigwa aare mono korwa ase omware ekiagera abanto mbaganeiri korora mware ekiagera tare gocha kogwena.
Omokuuri nigo arenge gokoreranwa !!
2. Ogosarwa: Aya nari enyaroka gose omomura are gokorerwa n' omokebi gose omosari. Oboremi nao aiga bwatakeire na tatakeire gokuura gose kwegosa. Omwana aise gokuura oyio nigo arenge koramwa buna Enkuuri korende nigo arenge gokoreranwa ekiagera are koba takoreranigwa, nigo kaa enywomo yaye yarekoba n' obokong'u obonene !!
3. Gochia iburu: Inyora buna ekero omware ataraikigwa sobo, nigo arenge kobiswa. Aaiga, abamura baganya egesunte kebe erinde bamoira sobo. Ritangani, nigo nigo abagaka barenge goikaransa bweri erinde omware oirwa nyomba. Nyuma ya amatuko atato, nigo omware arenge koroserigwa riburu. Bono riburu ninki? Riburu n' egento kebwekaine egesumu, ekio kiarenge korosigwa saiga nyomba giasimekwa esuguta erinde omware orara aroro.
Esuguta tiyatakeire kwoma !!
Esuguta eye nigo yare korendwa ase ogosiarerwa amache tebaisa kwoma. Abaminto inyora buna omware nigo arenge gouterwa omorero ase ogosegeswa na nigo orenge korendwa torima, goikera rituko omware are korwa nyomba. Omosegi nigo are koba n' omware onya komokonya esuguta tebaisa kwoma gose omorero korima.
4. Gochia nyangi: Eke nakio ke' eng'encho ase omware. Obotuko bw' okorwera nyomba, omware nigo arenge gokorerwa ebinto gente erinde koenekia gose obeire omomura. Nigo atakeire gosimora ebiundi korwa ase amakara arenge gwooka. Korwa abwo, nigo arenge koegwa emeri amo na amatunda amaororo erinde atakune.
Amang'ana taraera.
Korwa abwo, omware oyo omanya korurigwa chinyanduri. Ase boigo, nigo arenge kobugerigwa chinyabubu buna enyang'au !! Oboremereria: Nigo omware arenge gosomigwa ekero akoirwa bware erinde oboremereria bwaye bwatemwa, aiga ekero eke gie chinyangi.
Oboamate obuya - omosacha okoreire enyangi tatakeire koibera abamwabo !!
5. Okwaroka: Nyuma y' ogoetera enyangi ekong'u, nigo omware arenge koirwa ase abaibori erinde bamosesenie. Ise omwana nigo arenge korwa gesarate gose saiga erinde ogenda mwaye baba n' omorugi oye kemobere !! Inyora omosacha okoreire chinyangi chia bware tatakeire koibera eamate yaye gose egesaku kiaye etugo.
Bono emaambia yaye, nigo omosegi amo n' omware baregotenena isiko mwa abaibori b' omware erinde omanya kobora "Ee borania ngo" Ise oiraneria "Ea borania chiombe n' abana" Omware oboria "Baba borania ango" ng'ina oiraneria "Ee tata borania chiombe n' abana" Aiga baruo bairana saiga kwarigania gochia roche gwesibia na kwearigania kobekerwa amaguta. Okoborania oko nakuo kwarenge koba ogosesenia kwa abaibori.
Onye omware oyo tarenge na ise, nigo arenge gochia oise moke.
6. Kogenda maguta motwe: Eye nero enchera y' omoerio omware arenge goetera erinde orwera nyomba. Amarwa nigo arenge gosiikwa ase egetera na koengwa. Korwa abwo, amabere nigo arenge kororanigwa n' abagaka abanene baturwa na gochikwa erinde omware oretwa ase bare erinde ache goakwa maguta motwe.
Ise nigo arenge gosiberia amarwa, osiarera omwana oye !! Eriakabere nigo arenge gosiba amabere naro oyamosiarera. Nigo omware arenge gosiarerwa obosio igoro. Korwa abwo, Ise nigo arenge kobwata amaguta, omoaka omotonyeria omotwe igoro. Eye nero yare koorokia buna oyo obeire omomura oisaneire.
Bono emogoroba eye, oyo orure bware tarenge koirana ase aaramerete. Yaya. Nigo arenge kogenda sobo omosegi oye orara, erinde bogokia mambia yaye, baumerana na abande barure nyomba. Korwa bono, omomura oyo nigo arenge kobwatia amachiko aetwe buna:
[ I ]. Tagosoa mwa ng'ina goikera oite eng'iti gose arigie embori aitere abagaka amanye gosoa mwa ng'ina !!
[ II ]. Tare gosoa mwa ng'ina goetera egesieri kia borenge korende kia gesaku.
[ III ]. Tancheire gosoa ase ng'ina na ise bare korara !!
[ IV ]. Tancheire gosia, gotenya, koruga, gochia roche, kwaga enchagu, gosonga, gochia etinga gose gokora chigasi chiri chinyaroka chiare gokora.
[ V ]. Taganeiri konya kobera ase abanyaroka bare. Nigo aganeiri gosika abaibori baye, abanene baye gose bari ba nsoni.
Tokare gochengera omoyega o Maguta Motwe na magokoro baba Nyareso ominto. Mwanyagetinge.com/2015

Nigo barwete Bongeresa chitariki 6, omotienyi o Kianda (Tureti ya Kebaki), omwaka 1620. Bagatara ase enyancha ase emetienyi ebere. Bagaika Massachusetts omoerio bwo omotienyi o ikomi na rimo (Egesunte). Nonya nabo igo, ase tarenge aroro agiya ase obwato bwarenge kobekwa. Rakini ase chitariki 11 chio omotienyi o ikomi na kabere (Egesunte Kende), bakanyora ase agiya aaria Plymouth Rock. Nonya banyorete ase bakobeka obwato, emechando ya abanganyi aba 102 korwa Bongeresa konyora teraera. Amarwaire. Chisegi na Abaindi. Enchara. Nigo baigete Amerika engaki yo obokendu. Ekero omotienyi o Kane (Rigwata) omwaka 1607 ochiete goika, konyora enusu ya abanganyi aba 102 bakure. Buna Nyasae abangete, bagasimeka endagera engaki eyio ye Rigwata. Endagera ekama buya. Ase ogoakera Nyase inga imbuya mono, abanganyi aba amo na Abaindi bari barenge abasani bagateba inga tiga omoyega obe aroro bwo ogoakera Nyasae asante. Rituko rio ogoaka inga imbuya mono rikaiborwa. Omwaka o 1789, Omogambi George Washington agateba inga tiga rituko rio ogoaka imbuya mono ribekwe. Rakini nigo yairete impaka omwaka o 1941 ekero Bunge yaetetie inga kera Tichi Kane yo omoerio bwe Egesunte obe eholidei enene Amerika.
Inche nigo ingoaka inga imbuya mono ase obomoyo korwa ase Nyasae. Nigo ingoaka inga imbuya mono ase ebisio nanyorire ase omwaka oyo. Amaridadi ya amaiso: Gusii.com at home aaria Nyabitunwa Bine, South Mugirango, Kisii County. Mwanyagetinge.com/2014
Bono ebioto binde ekero biachiete korora ebi biamwabo bibere bigwete engoro ime bikabisekerera na kobitebia buna mbigosoka korwa engoro eyio ime bire moyo. Aaiga nario ebioto ebi bibere biekorete buna mbigweti aya yokobisekereria na gotema buna biare konyara erinde birwe engoro eye ime. Ebioto ebi biagwete engoro ime mbiakwete moyo, ekiagera nigo bierwete kerage, gosoka korwa engoro eye yarenge etambe mono.
Egioto ekemo gekarosa na goaka inse na gokwa, abuo abuo.
Egioto keri giatigarete engoro ime kegatema gocharoka gose ngesoke korwa engoro eye ime, korende gekaba kegosinywa. Erio erio, ebioto biri binde nigo biare goseka na goita egioto kiamwabo omoyo, bigoteba buna egioto ekio nagetiga gwechanda ekiagera ngokwera kere engoro eye ime.
Bono ebioto ebi biamwabo, biagokire buna egioto eke tikiaigwete buna biagetakerete amabe !!
Bono egioto eke kegatema igo, goikera kegasoka korwa engoro eye ime. Biri binde kibiachia korora aya bikamoboria buna gose nkoigwa arenge buna biare gokwana. Egioto eke gekabatebia buna ime y' engoro eyio ime, nigo amato atinete !! Ebioto ebio bikagoka buna taigwete buna biamotakerete amabe.
Egioto eke korwa erio, gekamanya buna Bwanchi Mbwa Maiso, Mioyo Etamanyaini.

Bagoteba ng'a "Rero mochokoro goika tokoire e field trip", sokoro amo na magokoro nigo bangira aaria ase The Otenyo Omogusii Cultural Festival, Keroka Town, recently. Initially, nigo narutete chintacho, korende ki naika aroro, nigo nabete no omogoko ase ogosomigwa na kwoorokigwa buna Abagusii twakabeire, ne ebinto twagatumiire.
Unless twaagachire e museum yaito ekogacha our artifacts amo no omogano oito bwa Abagusii, eye nero the best repository we have for now, with The Otenyo Cultural Group, and others scattered online buna eye. It is possible nga artifacts chio Omogusii ne chinyinge, and they are scattered in many places. Korende we have no central repository. We hope that things will change in the next few years with the establishment of the Omogusii Museum and Cultural Center.
Ase boigo, mbuya mono to the Otenyo Omogusii Cultural Troupe ase efforts babwate to preserve the few artifacts that are left with us. In addition, the Otenyo Troupe has been instrumental in teaching us our history and traditions which are being forgotten fast. Thank you for your selfless efforts.
