Enywomo yo Omogusii tiyare koera onye bitinge tibiyo. Without ebitinge, igo nywomo teraba. Omosubati o Gusii nigo arenge gotimigwa ebitinge ase ekero kie enyangi. Ebitinge nabio biare koba buna chibeta echi chie ekerero.
Inaki ebitinge biare koroisigwa? Chintere chie etarimbo nigo chiare kobutorwa ebing'ese ebingese. Omosubati obwate okogoro okogare nigo are konacherwa ebing'ese bitano na kemo. Oyo obwate okogoro ogosiniini nigo are are konachera ebing'ese bitano.
Kwamanya korambora okogoro, bia bekwa. Korwa abwo, risangwa rie eng'ombe rianachwa. Barietanani ase okogoro ime. Onye ebibao bigotigara, nigo bare kobeka emurwa yaticha. Mangana taraera. Korwa abwo, bamanya koyeaka egetinya egere kiororobe.
Ase omoerio, nigo bare goaka etago kiamanya koba egetinge na koba ekieni.
Below, egetinge kio Omogusii buna kiarenge kororekana.
Ebibekerero Ao Ao
Omogusii nigo arenge koroisia ebibekero ebinge kobwatekana buna okogania ne egasi yabo. Let us see a few, starting with the picture below. Gochakera ase okobee motwe: Oroteru. Oroteru narwo rware koirura obori, amaemba, ching'ende gose chibando.
Komenta nayio, oroteru nabo rware gotumeka ase okogachera endagera temporarily. Ime yo oroteru oro nigo toroche ensio. Ekero obori gose amaemba arenge gosiegwa, ensio, together with orogena nabio biare gotumeka ase ogosia.
Orogena amo ne ensio nigo are koiywa korwa ase egetare gose rigena ritari koburoka riamanya goturwa. Abasacha nabwo bare gokora aya. Onye aye ki bwanchete ributi, manya ng'a orogena narwo rware gosia obori ne ememera, yamanya koroisia ributi rigwansa.
Behind oroteru to the left ne egekabu. Egekabu nakio kiare kobeka endagera buna chinyeni ekero chikwau korwa mogondo. Komenta nayio, egekabu nabo kiarenge gotumeka kobeka kende gionsi kiarenge koirwa ase obogeni gose echiro.
Riroba rie ebundo
Magega ye egekabu on the left ne enyongo. Enyongo nigo yare koroisigwa korwa ase riroba rie ebundo, riamanya gosambwa. Enyongo nigo yare gotumeka kogacha amache, amarwa, ributi....
Immediately behind oroteru nigo tobwate ekebari. Emeremo ye ekebari no okogacha endagera. Buna bono ekero endagera yagesirwe, nigo yare kobekwa ekebari ime korwa mogondo. Ekebari amo ne egetonga (not pictured) nabio biare korusia endagera mogondo.
Right behind ekebari gochia center left ,ne ebirandi. E discussion ye ebirandi is further down in this article. Magega ye ebirandi, we have chinyakaruga. Enyakaruga nero yarenge gokora egasi yo okoiyeka endagera. Endagera eng'asu buna enyama ya nda, obokima bwo obori, erongori yo obori..... ebitoche ebi bionsi nigo biakaiyekeirwe ime ye enyakaruga. There is more discussion ye enyakaruga further down.
Ase okorigereria, nabo okorora nga, abamagokoro amo ne chisokoro chiato nabo chiaroisetie ebinto bio okwerenda buya egere togaika igaa.
Orogena Ne Ensio ya Mwamogusii
Obokima bwo obori, ememera ya amarwa, obosie bwe erongori.....Ebi bionsi tibiare koba without orogena ne ensio. Eye nero etinga entangani naende original yo Omogusii. Abasubati nabwo bagasire obosie. It was backbreaking work korende at the time, abasubati tibare gokumia. Below, orogena amo ne ensio yo Omogusii buna biare kororekana.
Obokano Bwo Omogusii
Nabwo bakairirwe ase kera enyangi. Kera ase omoyega omuya bwo Omogusii. Abana nkogenda bare iburu gose kobekerwa maguta motwe? Renta obokano. Enyaroka Sarange nkoywomwa ekare? Sokoro renta obokano. Ntwaigwete ng'a omogeni natogete aaria bwo omogaka Obinge? Tata ominto tera omoino na kobugia obokano.
Nigo bwakaroserigwe korwa ase omote bwo omotembe, risangwa amo no obongori botano na botato. Why obongori botano na botato? Ntoranyora ichibu korende nkoririgia tore. Below, Obokano bwo Omogusii buna bwakabeire. On the right, omosubati Gesare nkonyegeria are amareko.
Abande ntwanyorete e chance yo okoiyekerwa enyama ya nda ase enyakaruga. Ase boigo, tokaiyekerwa engoko no omosori. Baminto gento tikeri ekiya buna ogosenyenta endagera eiyekire ime ye enyakaruga! Onye gotagete koragera buya pi, you should try it some time.
Enyakaruga nero yakinetie Abagusii abakoro ekagera togaika igaa. Below, buna yakarorekanire, enyakaruga yo Omogusii amo ne ekeburugo, biganyete enyama ya nda ebekwe ime.
Ko obori gose amaemba amire na kwoma, goika arenge korusigwa echafu yonsi magega yo ogosiegwa. Ase okorusia obori gose amaemba echafu, nigo Abagusii barenge gotumia ekonu. Nigo obori bwakabekirwe ekonu ime, bwamanya gosunyuntwa.
Korwa abwo, bwamanya koirurwa no oroteru. Ekonu nigo yare koroisigwa na abasacha. Ase okoroisia ekonu, abasacha nigo barenge gotumia omote bwo omotembe. Timanyeti gose emetembe netigarete Gusii. Right nse ye ekonu, nigo toroche egesero.
Bono egesero ninki? Egesero ne risangwa rie embori, engombe gose engondi. Ge etugo yanyenyirwe, kende gionsi tikiare gotugutwa. This includes risankwa. Risangwa nabo riarenge gotumeka buna oboraro, kobekerera endagera ase ekeoreri ekero ekwoma gose teiteka gochia riroba nse. Below, ekonu eyio on top of egesero to the left.
Ekero endagera yarosigwe ne ekonu, nigo yare koirurwa no oroteru erinde yamanya kogachwa irongo. Konyora etarairwa irongo, endagera nigo yare kobekwa ime yo omonyoncho ime yamanya kogachwa. Bono rende omonyoncho ninki?
Omonyoncho nigo orenge koroisigwa buna ekebari korende nigo orenge omonene. Ebirundu nabio biare gokorekanigwa, mbaka omonyoncho omanya koba. Ningo orenge koroisia omonyoncho? Abasacha nabwo bakarosirie emenyoncho. Ko oroisirie buya, omonyoncho nigo orenge kogacha obori ase amatuko amange.
Enduruche y' Mwamogusii
Because Abagusii twabebekaine ne ebisaku binde ebitindi, naende biatagete gotoita, goika twarenge koroisia ebibekerero bio okorwana. Titware gokira igo. Omogusii nigo abwate amatimo, chinsara, chinguba, chinungu, amo ne ebinde buna chinduruche.
Enduruche nigo yarenge gotumeka koruta ebinto buna amagena gochia ase ababisa. Kende gionsi kiare korutwa ne enduruche nigo kiarenge kominyoka ne chimbero chimbariri! Below, enduruche yo Omogusii buna yarenge kororekana.
Obokombe
It is hard to imagine how ororeri rwo Omogusii survived ase emiaka eye yonsi kobwatekana ne ebibekeroro twabwate. Temanyekaneti nga Abagusii twabeire abaremi ase emiaka erenga. Korende nonya nabo igo, nao tore igaa ase engencho abangina na abagaka abakoro barigetie chinchera chio ogotorageria.
Omogusii no omong'aini.
Ase oboremi, Omogusii nigo aroisetie obokombe bwe rigena. Amakombe aya naro arenge gotumeka ase oboremi bwe chibando, amatoke, obori, amaemba, chinsaga....kera egento. Below, obokombe bwo Omogusii buna bwakabeire.
Nigo Mwanyagetinge twarenge surrounded by enemies. Nigo twabwate abanto bande babebekaine naintwe buna Abamanyi, Abagere, Abamansae amo na Abasigisi. Abanto aba be ebisaku ebi binde bionsi nigo barenge gotorwania ntwe, erinde baire etugo gose amaremo aito.
Ntwarenge kwegembera.
Together with ebirwanero binde, this is where enguba y' Mwanyagetinge came in. Abamura ebisora korwa Gusii nigo bagatumiire chinguba ase esegi. Nigo enguba yare korosigwa korwa ase risangu rie engombe.
Below, enguba ya abamura ebisore korwa Gusii.
Abagaka amo na abangina abakoro tibare kobekerwa bokima ande onsi otatiga ase ekee. Kobeka obokima ase ekebekerero kende gionsi nigo yare koba amachayo. Ekee nakio kiare gotumeka ase okobeka obokima, especially obokima bwo obori.
Nigo ekeee gekorosigwa korwa ase chimboba chio obori ne emegoye. Abasubati nabwo bare koroisia ebiee. Go keroisirie buya, ekee tikiare gokendia ndagera. Yaya. Ekee nigo kiare kogacha riberera rio obokima bwo obori for a long time. Below, ekee kio Omogusii buna kiare kororekana.
Ekerandi Kio Omogusii
Omogusii nigo anchete amabere. Eee bono. Amabere ye eng'ombe amaroranu abekire ekerandi ime Mose ominto. Ekerenadi nigo kiare korosigwa korwa ase risosa rie ekerandi. Ge ekerandi giakong'ire, nigo kiare kogeswa.
Giatigwa kioma na gosatwa amo na abasubati. Nigo abakungu bare gotumia ekebeya gosata ekerandi erinde kiaba amaridadi bori. Below, ekerandi kio Omogusii with ekemumeko gie ekeemba.
Eee gaki amache ang'usirwe in some places. Chigari nchiroo. Komenta nayio, ntobwate chibodaboda amo na mkokoteni. Korende, it was not always this way. Nigo Omogusii arenge kobogira kera egento gagokebeka motwe!
Amache nigo arenge kobuchwa korwa rooche abekwa omotwe igoro. Chinko, amatoke, obori...ndagera ende yonsi. Nonya nabo igo, Omogusii deviced a way to lessen pain yo okobogoria ebinto ase omotwe.
Engata.
Engata nero yare kobekwa gati yo omotwe oo amo ne egento keri obogoretie. Engata eye nero yare kobekwa motwe ekero ogwetweka. Nigo engata yare korosigwa korwa ase emegombo ya amatoke. Below. engata yo Omogusii buna yakabeire.
Ntwarora above buna abasubati bare kobeka ebitinge ase enyangi ye enywomo. Enyangi yo Omogusii omokoro tiyare koba onye amaino ye embeche taratoka erinde omoywomi abekerwe motwe.
Ntoramanya exactly the purpose chisokoro amo na abamagokoro baito bateberete nga goika omonywomi abeke amaino ye embeche motwe oye. Buna tokona koboria chisokoro amo na abamagokoro baria baito batigarete, we will know more. Kabekire aamo iga, amaino aya nigo arenge korokwa ebibaga. Below, amaino ye embeche (ebibaga) yo omonywomi buna arenge kororekana.
Ekiore Kia Mwanyagetinge
In addition yo okobeka amaino ye embeche (ebibaga) ase omotwe oye, Omogusii omoywomi o kare nigo atakeire kobeka ekiore motwe oye. Ekiore nigo kiarenge koroisigwa korwa ase risankwa. Below, ekiore kio Omogusii buna giakarorekanire.
Ritimo Rio Omogusii
Buna twarorire, segi tiyare koba onye birwanero tibiyo. Ntwarora buna Omogusii abwate chinguba, chinsara amo na amatimo. Ase baria mogokina bono, tiga mbamanyie n'ga kera omogaka bwo omochie nigo abwate ritimo riaye. This is in addition to chinsara, enguba etc. Kera omogaka o Gusii amo na abamura be emechie bonsi, were standing armies.
Baganyete ekero ekurate ekoba.
Below, omomura egesora oyomo o Gusii kare ne ritimo riaye. Behind him is the Assistant Minister for Culture and MP for North Mugirango Borabu, Mhe. Wilfred Ombui and others aaria Keroka Cooperative Union Grounds recently during the Otenyo Omogusii Cultural Festival.
Ekerangesa gia Sokoro
Onye gokoigwa ekero sokoro agoasimora rimaambia, there is a reason why. Ekerangesa. Abagaka abanene ba kare nigo barenge konywa etumbato ye ekerangesa. Etumbato nigo yare kobekwa ase ekerangesa ime na gosunyuntwa. Korwa abwo, abagaka bamanya kobeka etumbato eyio ase chimioro. Basi bono tiga ogoasimora goanse.
What followed from there was ogoasimora kore successive. Amato ye etumbato arenge kobekwa ase ekerangesa ime nigo arenge koba amabese. Ogoasimora okonene nigo kwaminetie buna etumbato eyio n' engiya !!
Ekerangesa nigo kiare koroisugwa korwa ase omote bwo omotembe. As you can see, omotembe nigo orenge important ase carpentry amo na arts and crafts yo Omogusii. Below, ekerangesa kio Omogusii buna giakarorekanire.
Omogusii tarenge gokira igo ka amarwaire achire. Ase ki? Omogusii nigo arenge omonyagitari. Abarwaria mbarengeo. Komenta nayio, abarwaria abwo mbabwate ebinto barenge gotumia ase okorwaria abarwaire. Ekemo kie ebibekerero bia abarwaria ba Gusii ne ekebwe.
Bono ekebwe ninki?
Onye amanyinga akwereire emeki ime, gose omonto nigo aagetwe ase gete akabimba na amanyinga gokwera ime, abarwaria nigo barenge gotumia ekebwe koyang'usa. Ko omonto ang'usirwe amanyina ayio ne ekebwe, ensemo eyio yarwarete nigo yarenge gosusana.
Korwa abwo, omonto obwena. Ekebwe nigo kiare koroisigwa korwa ase orogunchara. Abaminto, below ne ekebwe buna giakarorekanire.
Bono Mwanyagetinge ominto, e field trip nao yaereire igaa. Ntobatebie when the next trip comes. For now, magokoro nigo ateba ng'a enyama ya nda netigarete enyakaruga ime aaria nka. Bono tiga toraayerera gochia ase enka.
Mbuya mono and thank you for listening.

Mosamba Mwaye
Mosamba Mwaye. "Nche ntige ndare. Esabari amo nase narwete na atambe".
Omwana ekengw'erere nere okorokwa mosamba mwaye. Inee ninki gose kegerete omwana oyo orokwa erieta eri? Aaiga, nigo agosamba enda ya ng'ina, oiborwa. Korwa aaiga, naende takoirana aroro eria kabere. Yaani igo bakoranire pi ne enda ya ngina.
That is it. Done.
Nakio ekio gekogerea otebwa inga osambire mwaye. Abagusii bateba buna oyio mosamba mwaye.
Ase omobwekano, nigo togoteba inga "Banchiri nanyorete mosamba mwaye, tiga aratoa echae tomwasimori". Igwa bono.
Enyangi ya Mosamba Mwaye: "Rioba nderere"
Mosamba mwaye ekero atokire, enyangi yaye neroo yo okomwarigania gocha ase ense eye. Ritangani, omwana nigo are gosokigwa isiko nyuma ye emekubio ebere. Ngina omanya korigia egesero obeka omwana kebeko.
Omanya kobeka egesero motwe oteba iga, "Rioba ndererere". Okwo no ogosaba Nyasae amokinerie omwana. Ekegeni kiamanya koariganigwa. Amaru nigo are koengwa. Obosie bwabekwa egetonga, enyama yaiyekwa, ne ekeundi giatongwa ase obosie erinde omwana aasimorigwe.
Goika ng'ina omosubati aiche
Ngina omosubati nigo are gocha ase enka yo mosubati oye, kare no obosi ase egetonga, otorera obosi obo mwa korera yaye! Ase ki? Ase Ekegusii, moibori tarenge korara ase enyomba ya mwana oye. Komenta nayio, chikorera usually nigo chianchaine sana.
Mwa korera nao nonya ne ekenyenga kiare kobekwa bana gosiberia ngora ngora. This is one of the reasons why chikorera chiarenge important. Gokongia oboiri.
Tari igo rioka. Naboigo mama omwabo omosubati nkobogoria are amaru ne enyama. Omomura oyo omonywomerete otaori obosie bwe egechuri ogacha mwaye. Omanya kobutora obokima bwa igoro mwaye.
korwa aa bono nigo bare gotwara omoyega omuya ase ngina omosubati are koa omochokoro oyo erieta ria bonginarome.
Omwana nigo arenge koegwa erieta ri' sobo, amo n' ri' bong'inarome [ bomame ]
Goika kera omwana aegewe erieta ria bongina rome. Omwana nigo arenge koegwa amarieta abere: eria aiga sobo na korwa sobo ngina. Nabo Ekegusii kiare igo. Ekero omoyega oerire egetonga nkianya koirana bosa! Yaya.
Nigo bare kobeka chibando gose obori baa ngina omosubati oyo ore korera yo omochie oyo. Eke nakio ekegeni kio omwana omomura gose omoiseke. Karibuni mosamba mwaye.

Emebayeno Ya Mwanyagetinge: Abande Namokwanwa, Timonga Chinkore Chia Maeba, Chigocha Chiaichora Enyongo!
Abaminto omorabaro oyo okobwatia nigo ore oyomo ase emebayeno eri yainto ntwe Mwanyagetinge, eri yateretwe ase enchera y' omoino amo na abagaka baito abakoro: Petronilla Ogoti, Gusii.com
Aya amwabo aya:
Omogaso oyomo tokare koria ritoke omogoye, omogaka sokoro ominto nigo antebetie buna Abande Namokwanwa Timonga Chinkore Chia Maeba, Chigocha Chiaichora enyongo. Bono ninki eng'encho y' omorabaro oyo o Mwamogusii?
Amaridadi a Gusii: Baminto motakomenta echae n' amandasi naende? Kobweria endagera ase enka y' omogaka Maeba, aaria Kebura Nchogu, South Mugirango, Kisii County. Picture na Petronillah Ogoti, Gusii.com files.
Aaiga, ritangani, sokoro nigo antebetie buna omogano bw' omorabaro yo nore aroro. Nigo sokoro antebetie buna abwo kare kare, omogaka gete narengeo orenge korokwa Maeba. Bono omogaka oyo nigo amanyekanete koba omuya ase ekenyoro kiaye, naende nigo arenge omogaka bw' amasikani ase eng'encho arenge korwa obokonyi bonde bwensi gocha ase ekenyoro eke kiaye. Ase boigo, omogaka oyo nigo ekiage kiaye giachire kera engaki, naende endagera tiyarenge kobora ase enka yaye.
Omogaka Maeba nigo achiete nguma
Bono Maeba nigo anchete korageria na koa abaamate baye ebinyugwa. Abaamate baye ekero baigotire, nigo barenge komotera n' omoino bakomotogia, ase eng'encho onde taiyo orenge kobakonya na kobarageria buna Maeba. Omoyega oyo oye nigo orenge korenta abanto oroche, gocha bwoye ekiagera nigo bare koragera na konywa ebinto ao ao.
Abanto kibaikire bwoye, nigo enyongo yarenge goterekwa n' amarwa, kere ne chinkore erinde abanto banya gosiberia n' omogoko. Bono ekero abaamate barageire na konywa buya, nigo barenge gotera omoino bagoteba buna Abande Namokwanwa Timonga Chinkore Chia Maeba, Chigocha Chiaichora Enyongo !!
Gochakera abwo, omobayeno oyo okaba ogotebwa! Koru ase omogaka sokoro ominto, oyo noro omobayeno oito for this week. Mbuya mono and thank you for listening.

Abagusii Culture And Customs XCVIII: Onye Eeri Eye Tiyarenge Goika Chiombe Chiinde Aange, Eyio Mbosa
Aya amwabo aya:
Buna chingaki chigendererete goonchoreria, naintwe Abagusii twagendereire goonchoreria. Ebinto bike bi' ekemira amo n' Ekegusii giaito mbigendererete gosira. Ase amatuko aetire, omogaka sokoro omointo nantebetie buna Abagusii ntwagatwarire ekemira ki' ebingwanso ao ao, ase amatuko amange. Ebingwanso ebi nigo biare gokorwa ase ogoikerania Ekegusii. Ase ogokora ebingwanso ebi, etugo nero yare gokorerwa ekeng’wanso.
Etugo emwamu tiyarenge gokorerwa Ekegusii nonya
Ase boigo, tari etugo ende yonsi yange gokorerwa Ekegusii. Yaya. Chitugo chionsi chie chirangi ao ao nigo chiare gokora ekemira, otatiga etugo eri ere emwamu. Etugo emwamu nigo yare gokorerana n’ Abaromenta, Abasigisi, gose Abagere.
Kobwatekana n' omogaka sokoro, gati y' chitugo chiagakorire Ekegusii giaoto nigo chire:
Embori y' Sokoro: Ase chingaki chiaetire, chisokoro chiato nigo chiare gotwara ebing’wanso ao ao. Ebing’wanso ebi nigo bare goita etugo erinde bakorerana chisokoro. Inee bono mbori ki gose yare gokorerwa ase ekeng’wanso gia sokoro? Naende nabo oraborie.
Tari mbori ende yonsi. Yaya. Nigo embori yare korigigwa, eri y’ ekeng’wanso. Embori eye nigo yare koba egoree yooka. Ase boigo, nigo embori eye yare koba egoree ebegete ekobia. Egoree eye gose nereri? Egoree nyagobia neri emerete amarionya gochia motwe y’obosio, akororekana buya, buna ekobia.
Goika egoree eye yarenge gotwara egesinge
Komenta nayio, embori eye nigo yare gotwara ching’unchara. Naboigo, embori eye goikera yare gotwara egesinge. Bono egesinge ninki? Naende nabo oraborie. Egesinge n’ amarionya ayio are kobera mbarabare n’ amakere. Eng’encho ende, embori eye nere n’omobere omuya. Manya buna onye tebwati
egesinge, igo keng’wanso ekio tikegokorwa!
Emingichi y' Sokoro: Tari embori yooka yarenge gokorerwa ase Ekegusii gi' chisokoro. Emingichi nero nigo yare kong’wanswa n' chisokoro chiato ase engaki yaetire. Bono emingichi yarenge kong’wansu nero tiyare koba mingichi ende yonsi. Emingichi eye nigo yare koba ebutoire omokera! komenta nayio, emingichi eye nigo yare gotwara ching’unchara.
Onye eeri eye tiyarenge goika chiombe chiinde aange na gochiaa chimori, eyio mbosa
Eeri y' Geita: Eeri ya geita nigo yare koba neri ekonyori chiombe chinde chimori. Onye eeri eye tiyana goika ng’ombe ang’e erinde eyee erieme, eyio mbosa! Bure kabisa. Eeri buna eyio tiyarenge gotakerwa gokorerwa ekemira ki’Abagusii.
Ase boigo, eeri eye nigo yare gotwara amagunchara, naende goika ebe eeri entangana. Eeri entang’ana neri yaakire amagasi [castrated], ekiagera nigo yare gotiokerera eng’ombe eyaberi korwa aare, yagenda koyerigia, erinde eyee erieme. Eye nigo yare gotindia na koenena, yagera yaakwa amagasi.
Bono ningo orenge gokorerwa Ekegusii? Ekemira tikerigokorwa getabwati omonyene. Buna twarorire, chisokoro nchiagakoreirwe Ekegusii. Ase boigo, Onye n’omoiseke otebigwe akorerwe ekemira, nigo agokorera embori etaranyora emanwa ekiagera nere tabwati mwana.
Onye n’ omongina omogotu ogokorerwa ekemira, nigo agokorerwa n’ embori rikongo, ekiagera ogotire! Onye n’omosubati ore bwoye, nigo embori egendererete konyora chimanu yarenge goitwa, erinde ekemira gekorwe. Nabo sokoro antebetie buna nabo twakamenyire igo. Mbuya mono and thank you for listening.

Omoriki ne Edwin bw’ Okong’o, Omwana Oito o Mache Ng’umbu
Kero kende konde Nairobi togaikaransa emesa koragera no omosani one okorokwa Motanya na momura oye Mogeni. Omong’ina oye Nyakerario konye ominire obokima bw’ obori ne enyama ye embori, chinsaga na amabere amaruranu amaroro se abwate amakombi amanene ndagoake bwateke erogoma.
Tokaigatera bono obokima egesamaro, no omong’ina Nyakerario okona gototiotereria.
Omong’ina agatotebia, “Bobege moigote kegima. Ninwe abamura mogokiina.”
Motanya akamotebia, “Omwanchi, gaki inche no omogaka omogotu tari bono ngokina. Nche nigo nkoria bosiniini.”
Intwe abamura tokagenderera. Tokabosimbaga buna abana be esekenderi enchara eitete ekero abarimu barire chibesa chibwenerete kogorera abana endagera eisaine. Nainche buna konye narure Mache Ng’umbu ase ntari konyora bosie bwa bori, nkaigatera. Mbwata obokima, mbobata ekegusii, mbwaterania enyama ne chinsaga, mbeka gochia monwa. Kobogotirimboka, ng’iyereria na amabere amaruranu.
Ekero twakoora bwonsi korwa ekee omong’ina akarangeria omosubati ore komokonya koruga arete obonde.
Nkamokania, “Yaya, Mami, inche naigotire.”
Omong’ina agatebia omosubati, “Retera Mogeni bono Omoamerika ere tiga ange onarire ebitoche bia Mache Ng’umbu.”
Mogeni nere agakana, “Mami, yaya. Nabeire buna riria nabete.”
Ngachia koigwa igo, ngaseka, ngaseka, ngaseka, mbaka ngaturungana. Naende ngaseka, ngaseka mbaka nkarera. Naende ngaseka, ngaseka, yaani ngaseka mbaka bagakaga nabeire richara. Chimbaru chikang’atia.
Konakora goseka kamoboria, “Mogeni, ng’ai omanyerete omogano oyio?”
Mogeni akaboria, “Mogano ki?”
O Motanya na Abanyaribari, no omogano oyio no oyoseito, aria Nyamira, Bogirango Bosongo.
Seito Makairo omogaka oyomo narenge ore korokwa Gesokera Nyandagesera bwanchete enyama mono. Rituko erimo omogaka onde ore korokwa Nyakundi akamochiika ekegeni komana chiombe. Ekero baika aroro, Gesokera agasokera endagera mbaka agasinywa koimoka. Endagera eyio aigaterete egachaka komobeta korwa nda. Agachaka gokema na kwana buna emori yarire chibando chinyinge ekooreka. Abamura makamobogoria gochia sukunyoma bakamwengera esabuni aroka endagera abanto batano bararie baigote.
Abagaka ba seito bagasoka ase ogochika omonto okobasareria obogeni. Kobairana nka Makairo bagatiana buna onde tabase gochika omogaka Gesokera gochia kegeni kende.
Naende rinde bono Makairo gekirete tokoigwa buna omogaka onde okorokwa Ndemo nere orangerigwe ekegeni. Agaetia abagaka bande tachiika Gesokera. Korende buna seito Makairo totari gokiria ng’ana, omonto akamonyerera Gesokera. Gesokera akagenda bw’ omogaka Ndemo akanyora abande no bare bakobanga esabaria. Akababoria gose mbamoire obogeni nere.
Ndemo kamokania, “Yaya, Gesokera, nkwaretete obosoku obonene o mosubati o Nyakundi. Aye ne esese embe etari bogeni.”
Gesokera agachaka gosorora buna omwana obwatirwe na amamocho ogosorora taitwa, “Yaya, gaki Tingonkora bo kabere, Ndemo.”
Ndemo akanga pi, “Yaya! Orabaise gochia gokwera aria oboko otoreterere.”
Gesokera agatugama nse na gosorora mono, “Gaki, gaki, gaki, abagaka baminto timontiga.”
Seito Gusii monto mosacha gocha gotugama nse na gosorora buna omwana nabo ogokaga buna na amaene agoteba. Abagaka bagancherana komoira oboko bwa Ndemo aaria Nyamusi Etari Bitutu, Bigirango Irianyi.
Ekero baigete ekegeni endagera ekarosigwa enyinge. Kobakona koragera botuko rende seito Gusii sitima etaiyo mono ne ebibeya togwokia. Bakaragera igo onde tachia korora Gesokera gagosokera naende.
Akaigatera bono naende mbaka enda ekaba buna omonyocho. Ekero yachaka komoresania Gesokera akaimoka korwa nyomba akagenda gochia gesona. Agetoora ebwobi okonagokema.
Omosae oyomo bw’ ekenyoro ekio okorokwa Momanyi akamorora. Akamoboria, “Omogaka, naki imbuya okare bori?”
Gesokera akamotebia, ogotogota but ekeragita, “Nabeire buna riria nabete.”
Momanyi akamoboria, “Naki kwabete?”
“Nabeire buna riria nabete.”
Momanyi agakaga Gesokera no oborwaire akabwate. Akaminyoka gochia eero ase abanto bare kona gosiba ekegara na gotengera chisani chia Christopher Monyoncho omwana bw’ Araka, riyo ri ebasweti.
Momanyi gateba, “Mochumbe, kararimia ekenada.”
“Yaa, Momanyi bono ne ebirecha bikoriete? Ndimie ekenanda abageni bagotenga? Tiga esani eye eraera.”
“Yaya, yaa, Mochumbe, oMogeni orwarire.”
Mochumbe akarimia ekenanda.
Momanyi akaboria, “OMogeni orwarire aa ogoteba buna obeire buna riria abete. Ng’o obwate eriogo riaye?”
Omogaka Ndemo akaminyoka gochia isiko ogoteba, “Obe! Obe! Obe! Oyio eriogo riaye ntomanyete. Mwengere esabuni Omo.”
Bakengera Gesokera esabuni. Bakamobetereria keero buna omwana ekengwerere bwangire konya erongori. Akaroka chinyama echinde chingima atatakuneti akamanya gocha koba buya.
Korwa erio onde tachia komochika Gesokera gochia bogeni bonde. Ekero seito Makairo twaigwete omogano oyio, togaseka. Gatwarageire twaigotire togachaka togoteba, “Nabeire buna riria nabete.”
Tomanya goseka bono buna amachore arorire chibando. “Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha! Nabeire buna riria nabete.”
Na seito Gusii bono buna tonarete goakaakania amang’ana buna embori ekonia egesero, ani amang’ana aikire Nyaribari sobo Mogeni.

Minto. Mwanyagetinge. Nyaituga, omwana o baba. Tegerera ngotebie rero amang'ana araa amakong'u pa!
Kare, kare riria chingoko chiagakamirwe omogaka narenge seito Makairo, aria amaninko Gusii, ang'e ne echiro eria yakumete mono Gusii ekorokwa Kebirigo.
Onye gokagete buna oyo no omogano igoro buna seito tware konywa erongongori etainekiri, kana koganya. Gose onye gokagete ngogotebia nde buna seito tware gokama chingoko, kana gokenderera agwo ekiiriri kio omotembe. Tindi gwatora bobisi buna seito tware gokama chingoko ekero oboremo bwabete chincherere totabwate ase nonya n’ embori okoriisia.
Oyo no omogano bw' omogaka oyomo obwate chisemi, korende ekero twarenge abana nigo tware komosekerera. Omogaka oyio nigo are korokwa Mogaka. Magoroba iga ko omobaso okendire nigo agaterekire ebusaa yo obori na abasani baye. (Tari eye ye chibando rero nonya na abaisia abasiniini bakonywa). Kobasiibire ekegara ne chinkore bakonakoererania buna abana ba ng’ina omo, nigo bagaterire emeino emiya. Oyo nanchente ginkonakobategerera nigo orenge korokwa “Mosaiga.”

Kobasiibire bono Mogaka orangeria omong’ina oye ore korokwa Mong’ina. Korende tare komoroka Mong’ina. Nigo akamorangeirie na amasikani.
“Aye, baba yane, mosubati on Bosire,” Mogaka arangeria.
“Ee!”
“Gaki tomentere a mache a morero.”
Mong’ina nere okonyora erio konye orasiibire ekemite na abang’ina abaamate kobakona kogosoria na goteera.

Echae ya morero toe
“Mosubati o Bosire naye gaki,” Mogaka omotebia kagoseka. “Ntomanyete buna tari chae ya morero mokonywa agwo chikoni.”
“Nyakerario,” Mong’ina arangeria mosubati oye. “Ereria iso amache gose natotigane tonywe echae eye Kemuma arosia.”
Abang’ina na abagaka bonsi baseka mono mbaka baturungana. Mong’ina nigo arenge omong’ina bwamaseko mono.
Nyakerario kabamenteire amache, abagaka basiiba ake igo. Nabo rinde kware konyoora abasae bande buna oyomo ore korokwa Mong’are bakonywa bwango, bwango ne endamwamu.
“Aye omoisia oyo Ratemo gwatindire,” omogaka onde ore korokwa Nyambati amotebia.
“Ee, tiga agende,” abagaka bonsi bancherana.
Mong’are o Ratemo gachiire bachaka kogamba buna are omonywa bobe.
“Mbuya twamoseria,” Mogaka ateba. “Mwaigwa bono buna rinde anywa akooga bogakia?”
“Ayio na amake,” Nyambati ateba. “Rinde momura one Momanyi taigwa ‘esagasaga’ botuko agachia gosoka akamonyora araire omochachaku ime?”
“Naki amokorete?” omogaka onde akaboria.
“Gaki Momanyi one ne emechando. Nigo amokururete akamobeka as konye arorire chinsanako magoroba.”
Bonsi, abagaka, abang’ina, na abana bagaseka mbaka bagaturungana. Omomura oyomo ekegara gekamotokeria. Tamanyete buna ka abagaka bakogamba nigo okoratiga konywa gwategerera.
“Yaa naye karwe aa tonara egento eke kia abagaka,” Nyambati akamotebia.
“Tiga bagende bonsi,” Mogaka ateba.
“Ee, tiga Mochumbe ache atwaterie chinko botaraira,” Mong’ina akabatebia.
“Yaya,” Mogaka agakana. “Tumia ebiemba. Egento eke Mochumbe asiiba kiamokorire richara arabaise gweaka egesire.”
Mochumbe na bagisangio baye bakagenda gochia saiga gotegerera eretio “BPC Swaeri Sabesi” (BBC Swahili Service).
Abagaka bakorora buna abasae bachiire bagatoma Nyakerario gochia kiage abaretere ebuga. Bagatiera na konywa. Mogaka agaansa go kwana amang’ana onde ataare komanya engencho yaye.
“Esese isiko, ekemoni nyomba! Esese isiko, ekemoni nyomba!”
Inche erio nigo narenge omwana omosiniini. Tinamanyete eng’encho ye, “Esese isiko, ekemoni nyomba.” Korende ngakina, ngakora esekenderi ngacha mache ng’umbu, Amerika.
Gaki tiga mbatebie buna Abamerika nigo banchete chisese ne ebimoni mono. Okonyora ekemoni keroseirie nyomba kemenyete buya, nonya mbeba nchiyo kebwenerete goita. Endagera nigo gekogorerwa enga ebisuguti kiabekerwa na amabere. Nonya nase gekobeka echabu go kiabutiarire nigo kebwate abanyene bana goitora.
Ne esese nero nigo yanchire mono. Emenyete nyomba, egoikaransa esoba seti igoro yarigereria etelebiseni na abanyene. Esese ya Amerika oise konyereta seito Kenya nigo erakwe bwango mono. Nyama mbese sese ya Amerika terikoria. Tenga buna Ondieki yaito yakaminyokirie egesusu gose egechure yabwata twaria, twanyea amauga. Buna ekemoni kia Amerika, esese ya Amerika nigo ekoroserigwa endagera special ekogorwa korwa etuka.
Tiga bono naende, Omogusii ominto, ngotebie egento kende kiamaseko. Abamerika naende nkoratwara bare amasindano korora buna ning’o obwate esese gose ekemoni egeseera. Amasindano ayio ataraika nigo bakoira chisese ne ebimoni baakana chibesa biasibigwa na konintwa chinchara. Omobui bwa amasindano nigo akoegwa egekombe buna keria abagosoria bakoeegwa.
Nimanyete ngoteba ore buna, “Etwini gaki naye! Esese eegwe egekombe kiamaminyoko?”
Maene pi ndie esese, tindigokong’aina, Nyaituga o baba. Boria onde bwensi omenyete mache ng’umbu.
Chisese ne ebimoni kobiarwarire Abamerika tibari gotiga bikwe. Nigo bakobiira chinyagetari chi ebimoni ne chisese. Nimanyete Omoamerika oyomo oakanete $4,000 (Ksh. 300,000) kobaara esese endwaire.
Esese koyangire kobwena nigo bagokora egento gekorokwa, “Putting it to sleep” – bakonyebeta esindani yakwa ng’ooora. Koyakuure, banyeira ase akorokwa, Pet Cemetery, ase chimbeera chie chisese, ebimoni, ne ching’iti chinde Abamerika batugete nyomba chigotindekwa. Kobanyetindekire nigo bachachana na gwechwanachania buna omoibori okwereirwe no omwana.
Esese isiko, ekemoni nyomba.

Abagusii Culture And Customs CIV: Omongina Bathseba Birundu Ateya "Obokima Bw' Obori Tibwarenge Koguunda Nonya"
Aya amwabo aya:
Jared Nyaberi: Mbuya omono omongina Birundu ase ogotwara chingaki erinde otoe obosemia. Ase ogochakera, inee, noinyore buna omwaka norori ekero kwaiboretwe?
Omongina Bathseba Birundu Ateya: Ekero naiboretwe, nario konyora Abacheremani bachakire esegi korwa aaria Tanganyika. Nche nabo imanyete igo. Engaki eyio nario ebirwanero bia amasasi biaigete Gusii.
Jared Nyaberi: Esegi eyio igo mwaka ki torayebekere gose?
Omongina Bathseba Birundu Ateya: Mochokoro ntwe ntware kobara miaka engaki eyio. Abagusii nigo twarenge komanya emiaka, kobwatekana ne ebinto biarenge gokorekana.
Jared Nyaberi: Igo gaki tiga totebe buna nigo kwaiboretwe ase omwaka 1914.
Omongina Bathseba Birundu Ateya: Eee igo mbuya mochokoro.
Jared Nyaberi: Bono omongina karantebia igoro y' endagera y Abagusii. Ninki twakarire ase chingaki echio ekero kwaiboreretwe?
Omongina Bathseba Birundu Ateya: Obokima bw' obori nabwo bwarenge endagera enene y' Omogusii. Korwa kare, Obori nabwo bwarenge endagera enene, naende nero yatokinetie. Chibando tichiarenge ekemeri ki' Omogusii. Yaya.
Chibando niigo chiarentetwe n' Omosongo. Niigo chiaigete Gusii bono ekero nabeire enyaroka. Aange nase emiaka 1930. Bono ase ritangani, chibando nigo chiagasimekirwe ase chingito goeta. Magega yaye, chigaansa gosimekwa ase emeraba ime. Keri keri Abagusii togachaka gosimeka chibando kera aase.
Jared Nyaberi: Bono omongina, otagontebia buna obori bwagasimekirwe?
Enchagwa tiyakabeire Gusii. Nigo enchagwa yachagete gocha ekero amaremo akaera. Jared Nyaberi ngotegerwa are omogano n' omongina Bathseba Birundu Ateya, aaria Bomorenda, Bonchari, Kisii County. Photo na Abner Nyaberi, Gusii.com files.
Omongina Bathseba Birundu Ateya: Mochokoro abwo kare, nigo chiinsana chiarenge kera aase. Bono nigo abamura be ekenyoro bakaimokire ekero ki' omorakera, basamba rinani. Engatiato [ January ] amo na Monuguna O Barema [ February ] nario chiinsana chiagasambirwe.
Mochokoro tiga ngotebie buna engaki eyio nigo omogaso okarorire se. Nabo kware korigereria ekeng'umbu, go kwaora buna ense ekomakameka na koyia ase omogaso. Omogaso tari bono ochaka. Ritangani, nigo orosana rwagatongiigwe na koyia.
Korwa abwo, obori bwamanya kobusurwa. Ase boigo, obori nigo bwarenge kobusurerwa aase aare. Bwamanya komera na gokonga bobwate ebigara ebinene kegima.
Jared Nyaberi: Bono inee omongina, enchagwa ndiriri yarenge koba?
Omongina Bathseba Birundu Ateya: Ntwe Abagusii ntwagatwarire enchagwa. Nigo obori bwarenge kobusurerwa aare aare. Bwamanya gokina na kogeswa. Ko chinsana chiasambirwe, eubi ende nyinge tiyarenge komera, otatiga obori bwoka. Kwagera obori nkwarengeo. Enchagwa nigo yacha gochicha rero ekero amaremo akaera, n' obori kobusurerwa aamo.
Jared Nyaberi: Bono magokoro, karantebia igoro y' okogesa obori.
Omongina Bathseba Birundu Ateya: Ekero obori obo bwamire, nigo bwarenge kogeswa, bwabongororwa, na goserwa na amagoko. Chitinga chi ogosia tichiarenge aroro. Nonya n' chitinga chia amache, nigo chiachete gocha ekero omosongo aikire nka Gusii.
Ekero obori bwamire na kogeswa, ogochengerwa nkwarengeo. Ritangani nigo amarwa arenge gosikwa ase ebiteera ime. Amarwa nabo arenge gosiikwa ase emekubio ene emegima! Aye tiga amarwa aya arero agosikwa ase rituko erimo.
Bono amarwa amanya koengwa. Kayiire, amanya goterekwa na konywegwa. Amarwa tarenge goterekwa nonde bwensi. Yaya. Amarwa nigo arenge goterekwa no omongina oria onywometwe ase enyangi na kobekerwa ebitinge!
Onye tikwabekeretwe ebitinge, nkwarenge gotereka amarwa. Korwa abwo, chimbori chianyenywa, n' abanto koragera. Nigo abanto barenge koragera goika obokima bonde bwatigara! Obokima bw' obori nabo bwarenge kobera ase ekeee ase omokubio omogima, botari koguunda! Mbwarenge gosareka noonya.
Jared Nyaberi: Bono abwo kare onye amaremo arenge amanene, nigo abanto bakaagachire are are gose nigo barenge komenya aamo?
Omongina Bathseba Birundu Ateya: Mochokoro mbono amaremo aerire. Chingaki echio, abanto nigo bamenyete ase oboare mono. Nonya n' ekero omoiri asirire, nigo arenge gotindekwa ase obwango, erinde abamwabo bamanya komanyigwa magega yaye. Nonya nabo igo emeyega yo ogosira ero nigo yarenge kogenderera.
Jared Nyaberi: Mbuya mono magokoro ase ogotwara engaki gotoa obomanyi buna twakamenyire. Bono inee, ninki oratebie abasae b' ekegori egeke ba Gusii?
Omongina Bathseba Birundu Ateya: Amasikani. Mochokoro amasikani n' egento ekiya. Korende naende, ka moranche timokweba ase morwete. Inyora ase morwete, na baria mwatigete magega. Mbuya mono.

Buna Twakabeire Na Petronillah Ogoti. Gusii.com Proverbs, Culture And Customs Editor. Engoromoni (July) 18, 2011.
Aya amwabo aya:
Oyo obibwate, nabo akororekanera aare. Nigo akogora kende gionsi atagete. Nigo akoagacha enyomba engiya. Nabo obonda bwaye bokororekana kobwatekana ne ebinto abwate. Ase boigo, oyore n' oboiseru, nabo nere akororekanera aare.

Eee omosacha nare ase omochio 'yo. Nabo omogaka Omambia agitete obweri bwaye buya.
Baba ominto nigo atebete buna omokungu omotakanwa nabo okomomanya ekero gwachire bwoye. Korwa aare, nabo okorora buna mosacha tari ase omochie oyio. Nigo okonyora omochi otarabiri. Mosacha taiyo okorabia obonyansi gose kogita chimbago.
Komenta nayio, obweri bwe chiombe chiaye tibogitiri ekiagera tabwati mogaka ogokora aya onsi. Tari igo rioka. Nonya na abaamate ababe nigo bagosukia chimbago chiaye ase engencho atabwati omosacha oye.
Baba nigo agoteba buna eee abasacha bande mbaroo batari korabia bonyansi, kogita chimbago, gose gokora kende gionsi ase chinka chiabo, korende omobayeno oyo nigo orwete omobwekano bwe enka etabwati omosacha pi.
Buna baba agoteba, oboremeru, gose obonda bwo omonto nigo bokororekana ekagera Abagusii ba kare bagateba buna Omokungu omotakanwa mororere bweri. Omongina baba nao akorera abwo ase emebayeno yaito for today. Mbuya mono and thank you for listening.

Abagusii Culture And Customs CXIX: Bono Petronillah Inee, Omokungu Ngosereta Arenge Na Kobuna Enyomba?
Aya amwabo aya:
Mwanyagetinge.com ntwaborigwa riborio. Bono nigo twaborigwa gose omokungu Omogusii ngosereta arenge enyomba. Bono riborio eri kiriaba riikongu, nche nigo naimogete nkagenda o sokoro, koboria. Kinaboria, nigo omogaka sokoro ominto antebetie buna Gusii yaito amang'ana y' egekoro narengeo, ayio arenge ay' eng'encho mono.
Amaridadi y' amaiso: Gusii.com at home aaria Menyinkwa Market, Nyaribari Chache, Kisii County. Picture na Petronillah Ogoti, Mwanyagetinge.com files.
Omokungu komumekeria egechuuri nigo yarenge chimuuma!
Bono onye amang'ana aya tare koba takorwa, nigo ebinto gete ebibe, biare koba. Ase omobwekano, ekero omokungu akoagacha enyomba ebe, naende aseerete obonyansi, tarenge komumekeri enyomba igoro. Yaya. Okomumekeria nigo kwarenge kw' omogaka bw' enyomba.
Naboigo, inyora buna omogaka gakuure, nigo egechuri kiarenge kobunwa! Bono omosacha nyene enyomba, nere orenge komumekeri egechuuri, enyomba keyakorirwe goseretwa. Bono ko onye taiyo, nigo omosereti akoyemumekeri. Korwa abwo, etwani yanyenywa, abanto baragera.
Nigo omogaka akaganyirwe, goikera ekero akoirana bwoye, neba n' emiaka ikomi!
Ase boigo, nabo yarenge koba buna omogaka nyene tari aange, gose nigo akameneyete aare. Aaiga, onye omogaka oyo tari aang'e, nigo akoganywa, goikera kaa ekero akworoka bwoye, neba n' emiaka ikomi!
Komenta nayio omosereti enyomba tarenge gosereta enyomba akore, tatigari orogoma (ensemo gotira y' enyomba ekona ). Aise gokora igo, nigo yarenge boba buna nigo omokungu oyio akoima omosacha oye, eng'encho ende, atagete akwe. Omosacha nyene enyomba nere orenge gosereta na gokora orogoma rwe enyomba!

Aya amwabo aya:
Kera egento nao kere ase Facebook
"Timogotiga kera egento kebe ase Facebook?" Omogaka Okioma ominto, riborio erio ne rigiya mono. Ee bono omogaka. Nao tore ase Facebook. Intobwate nonya na abasani ase Facebook.
"Bono rende ewebu saiti eye ne eyaki? Intori korora kera egento mokorika ase Facebook?"
Omogaka ekio ne ekeene pi pi pi. Abagusii nigo batebete buna, "Eya bande, morogoba egoosia".
Ntwe ntomanyeti buna Facebook na amatuko arenga eragenderere koba. Titomanyeti eki kegocha koba gochia motwe. Nabo barayesieke tomanye gotigara bosa. Eroro igoro.
"Inee, gete Facebook nigo ere free. Tari bo? Ninki gekogera motagete gotuguta chibesa ase chiwebu saiti chinde bosa, mokona korera buna ebesa yakongire?
Abwo omogaka ekio ne ekeene. Onde tari goakanera besa ase Facebook.
Nabo bakobichoka omotwe!
Korende kende gionsi okorika ase Facebook, tikeri kiao. Nigo gekoba eki' Facebook. Nabo baratake gokora kende gionsi na amariko ao kwarikire aroro. Komenta nayio, baise kobichoka omotwe, nabo bagosieka eakounti yao bira riborio! Omanye gotigara otari na kiamboria.
"Bono igo nainwe nigo motagete koba buna Facebook?" Aa! omogaka rero nabo okamineti. Abasomi ba Gusii.com nigo bare kera ase. Nigo bare ase Facebook, Twitter, Yahoogroups.... Kera ase. Naintwe nigo togosiomeria aroro ase Facebook, erinde kobatebia buna nao tore. Batoinyore. Erinde batorotote ekero banyorire ribaga.
Omogaka Okioma, ekio nakio gekogera tokona gotumbaga aaiga ase ewebusaiti eye.

Emebayeno Y' Abagusii: Mokungu Obande Nyabarati Ere Bweri, Torusia Mokorogoto Oagage Nsoni, Chitamere Magaachi, Otang'ang'e Tureti Binyunso Bire Mioro!
Aya amwabo aya:
Tata rero ayaiga n' amakong'u pa pa pa. Nonya amang'ana aya are amarito bori, omogaka sokoro ominto nigo agoteba ng'a goika ekegori eke giato egeke keyamanye. Bono gaki mang'ana ki aya? Aye nabo oratware riborio.
Sokoro nigo agoteba buna amangana aya na y' chinsoni. Nigo omogaka sokoro agoteba buna Mokungu Obande Nyabarati E' Bweri Torusia Mokorogoto Oagage Nsoni Chitamere Magachi, Otang'ang'e Tureti Binyunsa Bire Mioro.
Ebina bia mpango wa kando mbiakagambirwe aaria ase Etureti. Obosoku mono, naende wachilia mbali. Nigo abagaka barenge kobeka ebinyunso ase chimioro, bamanya kogayana ekina eke ki' omosacha oyo omonyaka. Below: Abakungu ba bande baikire echiro koonia endagera.
Yaani gwaa!
Nonye niche nigo neyagia omotwe ekero omogaka antebia omobayeno oyo. Bono nche nigo naboria sokoro angoorobererie aake, erinde nario ndamanye eng'encho y' omobayeno oyo bwa Abagusii. Bono omogaka nigo ateba buna korwa kare kare, omokungu obande nigo arenge kobwekanigwa n' eng'ombe nyabarati.
Bono ase ki? Ekiagera omokung'u oyo nigo are oyo bw' omosacha oye oyomo bweka. Bono omosacha aise gokora obonyaka n' omokungu obande ( yaani korusia omokorogoto ), nigo arenge gosiria amasikani gochia ase enywomo eye. Ekero akobekwa ase Etureti y' ekenyoro, nigo arenge gotang'ang'a.
Atari n' kiamboria ( gotang'ang'a magachi ).
Kibagendererete kogayana, abagaka nigo barenge kobeka ebinyunso ase chimioro!!
Bono omosacha oyo omonyaka nigo arenge korobekanigwa, na kogambigwa n' abagaka aba b' Etureti, abwo ase chingaki echio chinkoro. Gaikigwe ase Etureti, nigo abagaka aba barenge kobeka ebinyuso ase chimioro chiabo, erinde bagamba ekina eke ki' obonyaka!
Bono ebinyunso n' ebiaki tata? Ase omorabaro oyo, okobeka ebinyunso chimioro nigo ere omobwekano bw' ogwetanga koru ase obotioku obo bwabeire ase ekenyoro, kobwatekana n' obonyaka bwo omosacha oyo. Kobwatekana n' omogaka sokoro, eng'encho enene y omobayeno oyo n' ogoteba buna obonyaka nigo bokorenta obosoku ase omonto amo n' ase ebinyoro.
Bono eke nakio kiagerete Omogusii agateba buna Mokungu Obande Nyabarati E' Bweri Torusia Mokorogoto Oagage Nsoni Chitamere Magachi, Otang'ang'e Tureti Binyunsa Bire Mioro.

Abagusii Culture And Customs CXXXIII: Bono Omokungu Kanywomirwe Ngokora Arenge Kende Gionsi Buna Eeigwete?
Na PETRONILLAH OGOTI, Gusii.com Proverbs, Culture and Customs Editor. Tureti Ya Kebaki [ September ] 4, 2015.
Aya amwabo aya:
Tokare konywa rikairo bono emorogoba, omongina magokoro Binsari ominto nigo antebia buna amang'ana nare akanire, atarenge gokorwa n' ebigori gete. Nigo magokoro antebia buna amang'ana aya nigo arenge koenanwa korwa gochia ase ekegori ekenene, gochia ase ekegori egeke. Ase omobwekano, ekero enyangi yarenge koba, aba banywomanire nkoegwa barenge amachiko.
Omosacha nkoegwa arenge amachiko y' enywomo. Ase boigo omokung'u nere nkoegwa arenge amachiko buna abwenerete kwebwata bono kanywomirwe. Ase rituko ria rero, magokoro Binsari ominto nigo atagete gotosemia igoro y' amachiko aria arenge korenga abakung'u baria banywomire.
Ritangani, magokoro nigo antebetie buna onye omosubati ochire bwoye nigo agwenerete koba omwegenwa gochia ase omogaka oye. Nigo yarenge bobe naende chimuma, ase omosubati gosanga kemobere n' omosacha omoao, otari oye bw' enywomo.
Eriakabere, omokung'u oyo tarenge konywomwa na koruga mwaye obwango obwo obwo. Yaya. Nigo omosubati oyo arenge koragera na koruga mwa ng'ina biara ase amatuko atari make. Korwa abwo, ng'ina biara omanya komoarekera mwaye.
Eriagatato, omokung'u bono kanywomirwe, tancheire koria amagena gose enyama y' engoko !! Koigwa iga, nche bono naboretie magokoro Binsari ominto erinde antebie buna ninki kiarenge kogera omokung'u akanigwe erinde taria chindagera echi.
Baba ominto nigo antebetie buna tari kera egekoro giaito kebwate eng'encho yaye. "Ase okoba abaigweri, ntwe nigo twarenge kobwata Ekegusii giaito buna twarenge gotebigwa korwa ase ekegori egekoro, gochia ase ekegori egeke na gokora buna kegoteba" Magokoro nabo amentete ogoteba buna karanyore richibu rie ribori eri ase obwango, natotebie.
Ekero bokorugwa, onde bwensi tarenge kobooncha !!
Eriakane, magokoro nigo antebetie buna ekero obori bwamire na kogeswa, obokima bori obotongore nigo bwarenge koba obwa ise biara. Kibokorugwa, nonya n' omogango torenge gokombwa n' omoyio. Egete gioka kiarenge kobokomba !! Ase boigo, onde tancheire kobooncha nonya. Ise biara kaboonchire na koragera, abande nabarabwo bamanya kobega.
Magokoro nigo antebetie buna Abagusii abakoro mbanchete korwa amasikani gochia ase abanto abanene. Aaiga, magokoro nigo abetebetie buna Ekegusii eke nigo kiarenge gokorwa ase okwoorokia amasikani gochia ase omogaka bw' omochie.
Tiga kong'ong'oria iso biara
Eriagatano, baba nigo antebetie buna omokung'u ore bwoye tancheire gotakuna obori ase ise biara. Ase boigo, aaiga n' okwoorokia amasikani gochia ase ise biara. Gotakuna obori nigo yarenge kororekana buna nigo arenge kong'ong'oria ise biara !!
Eriagatano na rimo, omokung'u orenge koba bwoye tatakeire gosereta nyomba. Ase ki? Koru Omogusii omokoro, emeremo y' okoagacha chinyomba nigo yarenge koba ey' abasacha. Nonya yarenge koba buna omosacha bw' omokung'u oyo taiyo, abasacha abaamate, gose bagisangio b' omosacha oyo nabwo barenge komoagachera enyomba.
Kai tata !! Omokungu gokuna chinsemo chia nsoni igo mbobe
Eriagatano na kabere, omokung'u taganeiri gokuna chinsemo chia nsoni chi' omogaka oye. Bono nonya rero ebinto bianchokire, omokungu gokuna chinsemo chia nsoni ch' omogaka oye nigo yarenge koba chimuma. Magokoro baba ominto nigo antebetie buna ase chingaki echio chinkoro, nonya omokung'u barenge komanyana kemobere n' omogaka oye, nigo arenge gosika chinsemo echi chia nsoni chi' omogaka oyo oye.
Bono tinkoria amagena y' engoko buna inyeigwete? Omokung'u nigo arenge gwesika.
Eriagatano na gatato, amaru nigo arenge kwengwa na konywegwa ase emeyega ao ao. Ekero endagera yagesirwe, amaru nigo arenge gosikwa ase egetera, aengwa na konywegwa. Omwana gaachiire iburu, amaru nkonywegwa arenge. Nonya nabo igo, omokung'u taganeiri kobera eero ekero abagaka bakonywa amarwa. Yaya. Nigo omokung'u arenge kobamentera amaru gose amache a morero, erinde oirana chikoni ase abakung'u bande.
Omokung'u taganeiri koereria omosacha oye egento n' okoboko okobee. Gokora igo, nigo yarenge kororekana buna ayio n' amachayo. Aaiga ase eriakianda, omokung'u bw' amasikani nigo arenge koereria omosacha oye egento, goetera ase okoboko gw' okorio.
Koru ase omong'ina magokoro baba ominto, mbuya mono and thank you for listening. Chingaki chingiya ase Mwamogusii ominto abeta. This series will continue next week.

Emegano Ya Abagusii XV: "Nigo Iso Ateba, Oire Omogeni Nka, Nyoko Amonyenyere Etwani Eria Enene" Ogasusu
Na Petronillah Ogoti. Gusii.com Proverbs, Culture And Customs Editor. Ebwagi (June) 22, 2011.
Aya amwabo aya:
Gosenyenta ebitoche. Ogasusu obekire endagera emesa.
Abwo kare kare, emiaka ne emiaka, omogaka oyomo narengeo aroro ore korokwa Ratemo. Bono Ratemo nabwate endemero enene mono. Abwo ase endemero eyio, omogaka oyo nigo asimegete emesi emenge kegima.
Simbiri nyamoibi oyio!
Bono Ogasusu nigo arenge gokemba ekero Ratemo atari aange na kwaye, omanya koba emesi ime na koyeria abwo mogondo ime. Ratemo akagechigwa n' Ogasusu oyo, simbiri nyamoibi. Omogaka oyo akaroisia omogwekano o mwanyabanto na koyoaka egamu na koyobeka mogondo gatigati.
Korwa abwo akaganya.
Aye Ogasusu, amamocho mono kegima koruta chitege
Ogasusu agacha buna botambe na goansa gosenyenta emesie. Korende kagendererete koria emesie eye, akarora omonto oteneine omosonchete. Obe! obe! Agakumia kegima korende tamanya buna oyo no omobwekano. Ogasusu agasuka ange na goansa goita omobwekano oyo chitege.
Amamocho amanene.
Buna aansa koyoaka chitege iga, Ogasusu akananterera ase omobwekano oyo. Bono tiga achake goaka ekurate. Ogasusu agakuura na goichana mono na gwekora buna nigo akwete. Omogaka Ratemo kagocha kwaye, akanyora Ogasusu onantererete ase omobwekano oyo !!

Nyoko amonyenyere etwani eria enene!

Egesaku Omogati bw’amatunda ebwate ang’e chimbego 60 chi’emete machani ye chitropiki korwa ase omochia o Moraceae (omochie o mulberry gose chifigi). Nigo chigotoka ase Asia n’ebisinga bi’enyancha ya pacific. Omogati bw’amatunda nigo ore ang’e kobwakana chifigi. Omogati bwe ritunda osimekire mono nigo ore Artocarpus altilis. Artocarpus integer (Cempedak), Artocarpus heterophyllus (Jackfruit, Nangka) amo amo na Artocarpus odoratissimus (Marang) chionsi echire ase omochie bw’omogati bwa amatunda.
Parajubaea torallyi n’omote omuya korwa Amerika ya maate. Korende, tori gosimekwa mono isiko y’ase yachakerete na abaremi, Bolivia, esengencho y’echintetere chiaye chinene, eyio emoneti rigori rinene ase ogoetigwa enyancha.
Oiboreire Bolivia, igo okwama ase aome naende are n’ebuse , emetaroekorakwa Inter-Andean chire n’oboigoro bwe chimita 2700–3400 igoro ya nyancha; aseigo, epamu eye nero eimogete igoro ase chikabira chionsi ense engima. Iberera ndiri goetania chidigiri 20 n’obokendu bwa botuko mbioyo. Reberera ngogenda rire inse gioka chidigiri 7 are emetienyi y’obokendu (omotienyi ogatano na kabere na omotienyi o gatano na gatato) n’embura egotwa omwaka omogima nigo ere chi mirimita 550 chioka.
Welwitscha (Welwitscha mirabilis) nigo kere ekemeri kiamete amatuko amatang’ani amwanyabanto, egekwama ase asinine ase ekengeka ki’enyancha ime ya Namibia na Angola ya maate. Welwitschia maene nigo ore omote korende tori kororekana boigo ekero okororekana ritang’ani. Ekemeri ekegima nigo kebwate ritina erimo rinene ribwate amato abere amanene akwama-aya akororekana buna ebisicha ebinene bieringete bikaba ebigare. Welwitschia ndire ekororekana buna egetunwa ki’eubi.
Ekemeri giepaini ya Khasi (Pinus kesiya) korwa Asia nigo gekwama bwago mono, naende nkeri gotoka raisi isiko ya sobo. Emete nigo egoika chimita 30–35 ase obotambe n’amatina agoika emita eyemo ase obonetu. Kera egesabo ekebwate amagwa amato akobeta atato, kera erimo rire chisentimita 15 goika 20 ase abotambe. Amatunda korwa aekemeri eke nigo are chisentimita 5 goika 9 ne chintetereechire chisentimita 1,5 goika 2,5 ase abotambe.
Riembe ria Kalimantan (Mangifera casturi) rimanyire buna Kasturi srire rotunda rie chitripiki ang’e chimita 10–30 ase obotambe erigotoka ase asinine ase akorokwa Banjarmasin ase Borneo ya maate (Indonesia). Amatuko aya riasire gosira ekiagera rikonachwa mono. Korende, nabo rikonya gosimekwa aiga asengencho y’amatunda aye agwansa.

Goetania emiaka chirifu 4, chiaetire, Nyasae akamoorekera Abraham aaria Mesopotamia na komotebia, "Imoka orwe ense yao, na ase egesaku kiao, na ase enyomba ya’iso, ogende ase ense indakoorokie. Nainche ningokore egesaku ekenene." Abraham akamoigwera Omenene na kogenda ase ense ya Kaanani ase amenyete na momura’oye Isaka na mochokor’oye Yakobo, oyochete korokwa “Israeli.”
Israeli na bamura baye 12 bagatirimboka gochia ense ya Misri ase’engencho enchara yachete ase ense ya Kaanani, naabwo bakamentekana na koba egesaku ekenene mono. Kenya nigo egochia koagacha orobago orotambe gotanga ababegu korwa ase ense ya somalia gosoa kenya.
Omoriki bw’serekali oborendi bwa ime omosike Joseph Nkaissery nigo agoteba buna oyo ngati y’ emeroberio y’eserekari kobeka oborendi obonene ase ensemo ya ekaonti ya Mandera korwa ase obosagani bwa kera chingaki bwa Al-Shabaab naboigo na goteba buna nigo oboagachi obwo bogochia gochakwa korwa Mandera etaoni goika Wajir.
“Mandera na Bulahawa nigo chire ang’e kegima goikera ekerengo otanyare goatanana korwa omochie onde bono tokonyara komanya kenya ng’ai na somalia ng’ai, nabo tokorigereria CCTV na chinchera chinyinge chia oborendi. Goika tonyore chingaki komanya ning’o ogocha na gosoka boigo ning’o orendete chinsa echio.” Nkaissery ogokwana na egetaseni ekemo aaria Kenya.
Nkaissery nigo atebete buna orobago oro nigo bogochia korwa oborendi obonene ase engaki entambe bwachandire kenya ekiagera koreng’ana nere, ogosoa na gosoka korwa kenya nigo korabe goetera ase egesieri ekemo koirera komanya na gotanga ababegu ase ebirengo bia igoro.

Garar nigo arenge omokagerwa ase omwaka chilibu ibere na ngwansa ikomi na isato (2013) ase echiro ya oboonchoreria ya Westgate obwo bwairereta abanto emerongo etano nomo na batano na babere gosiria amagima abo.
Amerika nigo yegenete Garaar buna nigo arenge korigereria buna barakore obosagani na goita abanto be chinse chia bosongo. Nigo arenge omobwatani bw’ ekeombe ekio ase abwate ekerogo gio’koringoria buna inaki obogima bwabo bogosereirie kobwa mono n’ chinguru cha isiko koreng’ana na Pentagon.
Aya onsi nigo akorekana ang’e chimaeli rigana n’emerongo etano gose (240 KM) bosongo ya Mogadishu ang’e n’omochie omonene Dinsoor.

Ensemo y’ oborendi ya Amerika nigo yateba buna ogokwa kwa Garar’ nokwengencho enene kobua buna kwaretige eriansa rinene ase ekeombe ekio kia ababegu ba alshaabab aaria Somalia.
Ekero egeke magega ya Pentagon koyaenekia ayio, ogosagaana gwakorwa n’ekeombe ekio kia al-Shabab nigo kwairera ogokwa kwa abanto banne aaria sugusu-mocha ya Kenya.
Ababegu aba batianire gochanda Kenya gotatimoka ase engencho y’okoba na obomo bwe chinse chia afrika ase oborendi bogendererete ase orogongo rwa Somalia.

Ekemeri giepaini ya Khasi (Pinus kesiya) korwa Asia nigo gekwama bwago mono, naende nkeri gotoka raisi isiko ya sobo. Emete nigo egoika chimita 30–35 ase obotambe n’amatina agoika emita eyemo ase obonetu. Kera egesabo ekebwate amagwa amato akobeta atato, kera erimo rire chisentimita 15 goika 20 ase abotambe. Amatunda korwa aekemeri eke nigo are chisentimita 5 goika 9 ne chintetereechire chisentimita 1,5 goika 2,5 ase abotambe.
Ekemeri giepaini ya Khasi nigo okwama ase Himalayaa: Ase rogoro-mocha ya Boindi (amatuko aya asengencho y’okogesaemete ase egetunwa kia Khasi ns egetunwa kia Naga ase ensemo ya Meghaliay na Manipur, China (ase omochie Yunnan), Burma (ase omochie o Myanmar), Thailandi ya rorogo, Laos, Vietnam (ase emechie ya Lai Chau, Lang Son, Cao Bang, Quang Ninh), na Filipino (omochie o Luzon). Chipaini korwa ufilipino nigo kero kende chikorokwa n’erieta Pinus insularis. Ime ya China nabo okonyora egesaku kende gekorokwa Pinus yunnanensis.
Emete y’egesaku eke nigo egotoka ase ebitiro n’emete emaio emiao ekwama ase riroba ribe ri’erengi embariri nabisicha ere n’echumbi iga ya 4.5 na azse aimogete igoro goika chimita 800–2000 rakini mono korwa chimiti 1200 goika 1400. Ase agatigati abwate amache naende are aomo ase omwaka. Embura ere enyinge n’omoika oetaneti 70%.
Ekemeri eke nabo gekonyara koremereria obokendu, korende ekegosira bwanko ekero chigotwara amato. Korende ekero chihosimekwa, bokendu obo mbotakeiri nonye.
Amarieta ande y’ekemeri eke nigo are Pinus khasya, Pinus khasyanus

Welwitscha (Welwitscha mirabilis) nigo kere ekemeri kiamete amatuko amatang’ani amwanyabanto, egekwama ase asinine ase ekengeka ki’enyancha ime ya Namibia na Angola ya maate. Welwitschia maene nigo ore omote korende tori kororekana boigo ekero okororekana ritang’ani. Ekemeri ekegima nigo kebwate ritina erimo rinene ribwate amato abere amanene akwama-aya akororekana buna ebisicha ebinene bieringete bikaba ebigare. Welwitschia ndire ekororekana buna egetunwa ki’eubi.
Ekemeri eke nigo botambe kere ase engaki y’okomera (nonyen’enkaki y, obotobu) – eyio etari gokoreka mono ase ebimeri. Welwitschia n’ekemeri getari koibora gioka, igo ebimeri bibere (egesacha n’egekungu) mbiganeiri korosia entetere. Ebisicha nigo bire buna chichuba (buna biri bie chipaini gose chisikadi)bire gati gati y’amato.
Chikoni chinsubati echikwerusekani ekero chiakinire korusia chinteretere chiabo chire chingusu, echio chigosiaru bwango n’embeo.
Nigo chigotoka ase ekemeri egekoro gia Gnetophyta ebi bire oboiribwang’e ne chikonifa chikorokwa (Pinophyta). Gnetophyta ebwate ebisaku bitato ebing’ao ekero okorigereri okororekana kwabo: Gnetum lianas ebwate amato amororo, Ephedra – ebwate amagwa amona Welwitschia enyene.
Welwitscha nigo yanyorete erieta riaye korwa ase omonyamete korwa Slovenia okorokwa Friedeich Welwitscha oomwaka o 1860. Welwitschia nkwama ere ase ebendera ya Namibia.
Welwitscha nabo ekoigwana bwango n’ase are aomo mono.Tari buna nigo etegemeete embura mono naende nabo ekonyoraamache aisaine korwa ase amare agocha korwa nyancha. Aya n’amang’ana atakeire oinyore ekero okoyosimeka omote o Welwitschia. Esababu enene omote oyo o Welwitschia otari kwama buya n’ekero aobekeire amache amange egereogunda. Igo netakeire chintetere chiasimekea ase omochanga (wchinyeke chibe chimirimita 2–5 ase obogare) ekiagwera amarabaakogacha amache egeka gtari maya ase ogokinna kwaye. Netakeire Welwitschia eumoreru amache n’okorenda okonene gose ebekerwe omoika. Chintetere echikomera ase echuma eyemo. Nabo naende chirasimekwe chibekwe ase etirisa igoro chirigererie maate. Ekero ogosimeka Welwitscha, goika obe omoremereria mono ekiagera ekemeri eke nigo gekwama ng’ora mono nigo ere e dainosa ase ogokwana ekeene. Eise koegwa oborabu obonge moono amo n’amache amange, kemer eke ngekwama gekaokwe ogetige.

Riembe ria Kalimantan (Mangifera casturi) rimanyire buna Kasturi srire rotunda rie chitripiki ang’e chimita 10–30 ase obotambe erigotoka ase asinine ase akorokwa Banjarmasin ase Borneo ya maate (Indonesia). Amatuko aya riasire gosira ekiagera rikonachwa mono. Korende, nabo rikonya gosimekwa aiga asengencho y’amatunda aye agwansa.
Okoren’gana kwe riembe ria Kalimantan (Mangifera casturi) nkori konene mono ekero okoreng’ania n’amatunda ande ye chimbego chia amaembe. Oborito bwaye ebore ang’e chigiramu 50 goika 84. Ekero ritaratoba, nigo rire machani – ekero riatobire – erangi yaye ere maraba gose gochia bure-emwamu naende ribwate risabo rikomesa. Gocherera erangi ya buru. Ogoonchoreria chirangi oko nakwo gokomanyia igoro y’amatunda a M. Casturi. Chikabira isato chia Mangifera casturi- Kasturi,Mangga Cuban na Pelipisan. Erimanyire mono Kasturi eseng’encho ye rimisu riaye. Mangga Cuban na Pelipisan nigo akororwa buna chimbego ching’ao. Pelipisan nigo ribwate rimisu rigiya buna Kasturi eyio ekoorokia buna erirwete korwa Kasturi. Oborigia obonge mbogendererete korimanya mono.
Ime ye ritunda eri nigo rikomachia koarira ase erangi naende rikwara akeigo ne rimisu riansu. Etokobwekani Kasturi me riembe(Mangifera indica),kasturi ndiri gwansa mono rakini ndibwate obwansu obokong’u ne rimisu rikeigo. Ime ye rotunda ria Kasturi eribwate emerande emenge emiya.
Kasturi erianchire mono ase abanto ba Borneo ya maate am one chiamate chiabo. Rimisu riaye erikogokia goika ogotera ogokoro gokarosigwa igoro yaye “Seharum kasturi, seindah pelangi, semuanya bermula.” komineti “O, rimisu rigiya buna Kasturi, rigiya mono buna omokobi nyongo. Obwanchani obo bwachakire esabari.”
Okonacha kw’emete gotaancheri kwagerire omote oyo ngosira okare korwa orosana. Emete emekoro y’amaembe a Kalimantan igo arasire korwa okonacha gotaancheri ekiagere emete yabo ekorwa emenge naende emiya. Emete eye egosimekwa ase ake ake ase emechi ya abanto nyuma y’ebiticha biabo gose emegondo yabo emeke.
Riembe ria Kalimantan ndiri gosimekwa ase emegondo emenene gose ase obonge ime ya Indonesia buna amatunda ande agosimekwa ase chitropiki ekiagera akwama ng’ora. Emegondo emenene ya Kalimantani nigo ekoratoka ase ensemo enke ya Banjar (ensemo enke ya Banjar teri eyemo buna ensemo enke ya Banjarmasin). Abanto ba Mataraman mbatemete gosimeka ase emegondo emeke ase omwaka o 1980 korende rigesa ritang’ani eriarenge omwaka o 2005. Nonye rotunda eri rigotoka ase oboraisi, teri goisaneki banto ekiagere rianchire mono.
Amatumisi y’amatunda n’omote nigo are amake. Nonye emete emekoro kegotwara ritina rietaneti emita eyemo, abanto ba Banjar (egesaku ki’abanto baime na ab’enyancha batorete Borneo ya maate) ebagotumia amatunda oka akiagera omote oye okwama egeka. Eseigo, abanto ba Banjar nigo bagotumia emete emeng’ao gokora ebinto binde. Konyora amatunda nkori raisi ekiagere omote o Kasturi nigo okwama oba omotambe mono naende goika omonto arine ase anene mono konyoikera – amatunda akogwa inse tari amaya mono.
Amatunda aya nabo akoriegwa amatobu gose arosiri buna echamu. Tari koonigwa mono ase chichiro ekiagera abaremi abanyene nigo bakonyaria ataraika chichiro. Ebinto binde bikorosigwa korwa ase amaembe nigo are chipurii,chichamu, echuisi, gose obosuguti (ebisuguti bi’abakoro). Ebinto ebi korende ebire ebikong’u gotoka ekiagera amatunda aya akoriegwa mono naende anchire mono n’abanto ba Banjar. Amatunda aya naende are rigori rinene korende ase abanto ba Banjar, mbari gpkumia ekiagera y’obwansu obonene.

Egesicha Lotus ya Boindi
Lotus ya Boindi (Nelumbo nucifera) nigo ere ekemeri ki’amache ekiya mono n’amato machani agocheng’enena ase amache. Amaoga amabariri agotoka ase amatina amanetu agotira chisentimita chinyinge igoro y’amache.
Amaoga a Lotus ya boindi igo akoirwa buna amachenu mono ekiagere agotumeka na chibuddhist ekero ki’emeyega y’ogosasima. Ekemeri ekegima nigo kere ekiya ase okoria;korende chintetere n’emerio nigo chikoriegwa mono ase maate ya moino ya Asia. Lotus ya boindi nigo ere ekemeri gekwama ase amache buna lily y’amache. Tari bokong’e kwamia ekemeri eke ase amachiko aito; etakeire omanye naki.
Kwamia Lotus ya Boindi, ensemo enkong’u ya isiko nigo egosigikigwa ne risakara rikwara. Eye egwanchera amache aeta raisi naende onye tagoeta bo, ntetere tekomera. Korende, ekero ebekire ime y’amache, neire emiake mekeigo entetere emanye gokina.

Naki okomanya ekero gwasigikiri entetere yaisaneire?
Omonto nabo akomanya ekero entetere yamerire ekero yabekirwe amche ime. Entetere eise gokina ebe kabere buna yare ase chinsa 24, togenderera gosigiki. Onye teraba bo, ogenderere gosigiki, irania entetere ase amache ime ase chinsa 24 chikobwatia, origererie buna eng’ani. Ogenderere bo goika entetere ebe kabere.
Entetere eganetie amache oka…
Ekero gwakorire gosigiki, ineka entetere ase echuba ebwate amache. Riberera riganerreiri asr amache ribe 27°C goika 28°C(nonye naende nabo ekomenta ase amache are riberera 20°C). ase riberera eri, chintetere echikomera bwanko chiakina ase echuma. Rora echibicha ase http://www.victoria-adventure.org/…om_seed.html
Bwanko buna rito ritangani rikooroka, simeka entetere ekinete ase esike gose omochanga inse y’echuba. Amache agwenererete goika chisentimita 30 igoro y’omochanga. Nabo orabeke chinswe amo na lotus ya Boindi.
Ng’ora ng’ora, buna ekemeri kegokina, netake ribaga rinene. Nabo ogosimeka ase egesima ase egeticha, enyomba machani, gose ande onsi ase bokendu bonene botaiyo. Riberera rironge ri’ogosimeka lotus ya Boibdi igo ere gati ya 20°C na 35°C.
Ase eanga yaito, riberera ria inse erire mono korende ekemeri eke nabo gekwama bokong’u botaiyo. Ekero ki’omogaso nabo okoenia Lotus ya Boindi gochia egesima gia isiko, ekero ki’obokendu goika egachu nyomba. Ekero amang’ana abeire bobe mono, nabo ekong’anyigwa gochia ase abwate omoika bw’amache buna lily y’mache.
Enchera endonke yokwami lotus ya Boindi n’ogotumia amagena akobwata kende korwa chirita chia amache 60 gose 80 chikoonogwa chiyuro 10 kera eyemo. Tumia enchera eyebeka chintetere chimerete ime y’esike ase gose omochanga ime y’enyongo y’amaoga omanye kobeka enyongo ime y’amagena. Konyora okwama okuya, ichoria amagena ayio n’amache.
Obuya bw’ogotumia amache nigo bore buna nabo okobeka ase egeticha ekero ki’obokendu gose nyomba mwao. Onye gokobeka nyomba, mbuya ekero obegete ang’e n’etirisa koenekia buna Lotus ya Boindi nkonyora ere omogaso omonge. Ekero ko’omogaso nabo okobeka ase ensemo ya maate nyomba gose geticha. Buna oroche Lotus ya Boindi nabo egosimekwa raisi- nonye nyomba ime.

Rhapidophyllum hystrix
Rhapidophyllum hystrix n’eyemo ye Chipamu chikoremerereia obokendu obonene ase chimbego chie chipamu. Embego n’eyemo yoka ere ase egesaku kia Rhapidophyllum. Igoogosimekwa ase akendu ase chinsemo chia USA ya maate- moino. Korene n’gesio ase okoremeriria kwaye kw’obokendu bore inse buna chidigiri 20 igo yaanchire monoe getich mono imeya Yuropu.
Nigo ere embego y’epamu enkong’u, naende ekwama chimita 1–3 chioka ase obotambe n’amagwa amaya ase ritina. Rhapidophyllum Hystrix igo ere enke ekorusia chimbande raisi, amatina amange akorosia ekemeri ekegare mono. Ase engaki entambe, amatina ayio narosi orosana oronene. Epamu y’esindani teri korosi matina korende ekobi erakine goika chimita 1,2 ase obotambe goika 17,8 ase obogare. Amatina nigo abwate amato amakoro, amatwaro, n’amagwa amatanyerere amatambe. Nigo atirete buya , gose aarare inse ekiagere chikorwanerera oborabu gose ekiriri. Chintetere nigo chigosimekwa ase abwate amache. Ase amiaka 3 ametang’ani. Nigo etakeire chibe are n’obokendu. Epamu y’esindani igo egotaka ase are n’omoika bwa amache naende ebekwe ase omogaso gose ekiriri ementwe omogaso buna egokina. Eekororekana buya ekero chibekire ase ekiriri akeigo. Ebimeri bietaneti emiaka 3 nabo bikogachwa isiko y’egeticha ase omwaka omogima onye komenyete ase riberera ritari goetania chidigiri 10. Buna enkendu, epamu ekoremereria obokendu nigo etakeire gosimekwa ase riroba rieteti amache buya naende ebekwemaate. Omobisa omonene bw’epamu eye tari bokendu korende riroba ribwate amache amange. Ribererea riainse mono amo n’eriroba ribwate amache amange nigo agosaria emerio. Epamu eye nabo ekonyara komenyera obokendu chidigiri –15 goika –20. Riberera ria inse mono rimanyire yamenyerete riarenge chidigiri –28.

Abwo kare kare, mwanyabanto nigo arenge gotaarera amagoro na’maboko, buna getongwa kende gionsi eke-nyamagoro ane. Mwanyabanto nigo arenge omwango kobua egesusu, endo, gose ekeobiria. Amagoro na’maoko nigo arenge aang’e mono ne’bimo binde: abwate chinenko chibwekaine: amareko ne’menyuma; ebigokoro na’maru; embaratero ne’nsanyi; egetinkiro no’koboko. Kera okoboko na kera okogoro nigo kwabwate ebiara bitano ne’bichara bitano, egechara ekemo ase kera ekiara gio’kogoro ne’giokoboko. Ebiara bionsi bitano bia’maboko na’magoro, korwa ekiara ekenene goika egeke, nigo biarobeirie enchera ebwekaine. Ase amatuko aria, ekiara ekeneene gio’koboko nigo kiarenge ang’e ne’biara binde bio’koboko buna ekiara ekeneene gio’kogoro kiarenge ang’e ne’biara binde bio’kogoro. Amagoro na’maboko nigo arenge korokana bwamwabo.
Amagoro na’maboko nigo arenge gokonyana ase okobogoria omobere gochia ande onsi ore gotaka kogenda; echiro, chituka, korina na goika omote gose ebitunwa, ande onsi ase ogotaara kwaganeirie. Nonya na’se amache ime, nigo arenge kobwaterana buya mono gokonya omobere gocheng’enena, goaka ontimbu gose gotibogeria. Nigo asibogete na koigwana ase obwaamate bwabo. Nigo arenge gosaba obokonyi korwa ase ebimo binde buna; eriogi korwa ase omonwa, okoigwa korwa ase ogoto, okonyonka korwa ase emioro, amo no’korora korwa ase amaiso.
Okoigwana na okobwaterana kwabo gokareta emoko ase ebimo binde. Ebimo ebi binde bikaanga korwa ogosemia na obokonyi gochia ase bwamwabo aba babere. Endamwamu ekabatuba gotarora buna amagoro na’maboko naro arenge kobaira ande onsi batagete. Ebimo binde bigachaka koroberia amabe ase amaboko na’magoro.
Oromeme rogasaba ekerengererio korwa ase obongo na rokageikerania abwo abwo. Rogachaka gokumia, ‘maiso marore, igoro ye’chinguru ne’siko ya’maboko na’magoro. Rokarigia komanya ng’a ning’o obwate ekieni ne’siko enene kobua oyonde. Abwo ritang’ani, ’bimo ebi bibere, amaboko na’magoro, tibiarenge gokumia igoro ye’kioyonde abwate gose are gokora korende bono bigachaka gosaba eriogi korwa ase omonwa nabo igo bigachaka goteeba buna nigo bire ebie’ngencho mono ase omobere kobua ebimo binde. Keri keri, ekerengererio eke kegaonchoreria na koba; ning’o ochongororogete kobua oyonde; amaboko akerora ng’a aro na’re ne’ebiara ebinyerere, nabo igo agachaka gokwana na’machaya igoro ye’biara bia’magoro buna bire ebieng’e na ebinetu ebimigi. Biara bia’magoro tibigokirie na ‘nkwana eye. Na birobio bikairaneria ase amachaya igoro yo’bonyerere bwe’biara bia’maboko. Bakaba, bamwabo bachayaine, baankaine! Egento eke gekagenderera ase amatuko amange, goika kero kende kegasaria ogokora emereme ase obomo no’boikeranu. Omoerio oye egaikera ase riborio rie’chinguru: Bikaboria ebimo binde kogayana ring’ana eri.
Oromeme rokarua ekerengererio ng’a babe no’kwamererania. Bonsi bagaancherana buna eke ne’kerengererio ekiya. Korende, obokong’u obomo no’bo: okoamererania oko inkoroki? Ebimo bigachaka korua ogosemia; ebinde bigateeba ng’a bamwabo aba bakinane enyameni. Ebinde bigateeba barwane ne’meyio, gose gotinkana chimbero, korende kera ekemo kie’birengererio ebi gekaangwa ng’a ne’gekong’u goikerania ase ebimo ebi bibere; okogoro gose okoboko. Ase entunde ya kabere, oromeme rogasaba ekerengererio korwa ase obongo, igoro yerichibu ria bwango. Ase amagoro na’maboko, nigo kera ekemo kie’bimo ebi kiarenge koreta okoamererania kwaye. Bwamwabo bagaancherana ne’kerengererio eke.
Okoamererania oko nigo gwakorekanete ase arabirie ime ye rinani, ang’e na rooche. Ebimo bionsi bikebeka ang’e ase kende gionsi gose mobasokano onde bwonsi orachere omobere, ekiagera bono ebimo bio’mobere nigo biarenge kong’usanana. Amaiso agachina are na’ng’e korora kende kebe kerache, korwa ‘nsinyo ende yonsi. Amato agategesia koigwa kariogi kande gonsi korwa ande onsi, emioro ekemiria buya erinde erio etiokerere gotioka kwa gento kende kebe maiso atarore, gose amato ataigwe; oromeme rokaba ang’e gokura na korangeria onye kende kebe kegocha.

Amaboko na’magoro agatiana gwaancherana ase omorembe kende gionsi kerabe; kogechigwa gotaiyo, gose gotianerana, gose koramana, gose gosinyana, gose kogira kende.
Amaboko agatang’ana gosiara obwoba; akaruta egete inse. Okogoro okomo gwo’kobee, gose gwo’korio, gose onsi amo, nigo atakeire kobogoria egete keria korwa inse na gokeruta inse naende. Ase obomo, amagoro agancherana ng’a, ase okobwaterana, atumie ebiara biabo, egere abue. Amagoro agatema kobogoria egete keria, kogesuguma; agatema chinchera chionsi korende tanyareti kobogoria gete keria; nonya na’se okogesukia, nigo agesugetie ake igo. Ebiara bia’maboko bigachia korora iga, bigasaba eriogi korwa ase omonwa. Omonwa ogaseeka, na goseeka, na goseeka. Amaboko, ayio arenge kwaamererania, agesokia ase obwerori, na kweaka endege igoro ye’kieni kiabo, na koimokia egete keria ase chinchera ao ao. Amaboko agatuguta egete keria gochia orosana ime. Bonsi ase obomo, bwamwabo na’batengeri, bakagooka. Amaboko akaorokia obomanyi bonde; agaatanana chinche no’mochere ase egesota kio’mochere; akabeeka eusi ase esindani; akaroisia ebing’userero biokong’usera ebitugi ebirito, akaroisia amatimo na koyaruta aare mono, ebinto ebiara bia’magoro bitare konyara gokora. Amagoro agaikaransa aria na gokumia buna bwamwabo aba abareu bagokora ebinto ase obwororo. Amaboko ya’batengeri agaaka chinkobi ase omogooko no’bomo. ‘Magoro tagokiri nonya aikaransete aria. Ebiara ebinene bia’magoro bikana gochoora ebirondarondi inse ase amaroba, bikona korengereria okoamererani birabue.
Omoerio oye, egaika engaki ya’magoro ne’biara biaye koreta okoamererania konde. Bigateeba ng’a okwabo nigo korabe okworooro. Amaboko nigo atakeire abogorie omobere bwonsi korwa ase aamo gochia aande. “Eye ne’kinano yo’boriri”, ebiara bia’maboko bikarengereria. Kera ekimo kio’mobere gekaba matureka. Amaboko akabwaterera inse. Amaiso akaba ang’e na’maroba, agasinywa korora are ase engencho arenge maurama; amaroba agasoa emioro ime, egachaka goasimora; amagoro ne’biara biaye bigacheng’enena na konenganenga embeo igoro: Nyayo juu, abatengeri bakarangeria, na goteera no’mogooko.

Kera oyomo agatenkera arore inaki emekono na’maboko bigokora. Ebi ne’bimo biarenge kwoorokia obomanyi bwo’gokumia ekero egeke giaetire, bono tibiri gosuka nonya ng’ake. Amaboko achia gosuka ake, achaka korera ase obororo, chinsanyi chigataabataaba, chikaengerwa na gotiga omobere ogwe inse. Amaboko agatimoka na goteema naende. Engaki eye, akaara chinsanyi ne’biara gotarera inse korende tiyanyarekana ase engencho ebiara ebinene bioka nabio biesebererekanete. Bigateema gokora ebiuni korende bigakanigwa ase engencho yarorekanete ng’a biachakire kobwatesigwa na’magoro gokora ebiuni. Ebiara bia’magoro nabirobio bigachaka goseka. Bigasaba eriogi rinetu korwa ase ring’orong’ocho goetera ase omonwa egere bibue ogoseka koria okonyerere kwe’biara bia’maboko. Amaboko agachia koigwa buna agosekererwa, akagechigwa mono ekerage na akanacha ekina kio’moerio kobogoria omobere. Korende tanyareti gosuka nonya ng’ake. Amaboko ne’biara biaye bikarosa na gokwa omoyo. Amagoro akerora na gochenga mono, agaaka chiting’iri, akaminyoka, agacharoka, akamiramira, agacharara, na korenda omobere togwa inse. Abatengeri bonsi bakagoka na gotinera amagoro inse gochengera obobui bwa’magoro. Emekono ekaimokia amaboko abo igoro gokana egento eke, na techieti koinyora ng’a nero yachagete okoamererania oko.
Bonsi amo, nonya na’batengeri, bakarora egento kio’gokumia igoro ye’mekono: ebiara ebinene biria biasebererekanete ekero amaboko are goteema kobogoria omobere, nigo bieatananete ne’biara binde. Abaamererania bagataka goseka korende bakarora egento kende; nonya ekiara ekenene giaeatananete korwa ase ebiara binde, ekagera okoboko tikwaba na ‘nguru, nigo kiare gokoonya ebiara binde kobwata na gotarera egento. Ninki eke? Oboreema bweonchoire koba chinguru chio’kwaagacha!
Okoamererani gati ye’bimo egere goancherana ng’o omobui gokagenderera ase amatuko atano, omobaro bwe’biara ne’bichara ase kera okogoro no’koboko. Korende nonya batemete rioka, tibachieti konyora omobui; kera ekemo kie’bimo ebi; okogoro no’koboko nigo kiarenge gokora buya ase ensemo yaye; kende tikiare konyara getabwatesirie ne’kende.
Oboringori bogachaka: omobere ninki? Bonsi bakaboria, na bakanyora ng’a omobere mbonsi ase obomo; nigo barenge oyomo ime yo’yonde. Kera ekimo nigo kiare konyara gokora emeremo buya egere ebimo bionsi bibe buya.
Erio tikoba ’kwamererania konde ase amatuko agocha, naboigo gotanga gosinyana na gotwomana, ebimo bionsi bigaancherana ng’a, korwa erio, omobere tiga otare gesike-monto, amagoro atache inse bokong’u na’maboko abeere embeo igoro. Omobere okagokera ring’ana eri korende ogaanchera abana abake abake gotaarera amaboko na’magoro egere tibabaisa kweba ase barweete. Ebimo bikabagana emeremo: amagoro abogorie omobere goika ase ogochia, korwa abwo amaboko akore emeremo yo’koroisia gose kobwata na gotarera ebioge. Ekero amagoro ne’chimbaratero bigokora emeremo emerito yo’kobogoria , amaboko asibia na gochena aase na koenekia ng’a endagera yaikeire omonwa. Omonwa, gose amaino aye, ayetakuna na koyesenda goika ase enda ime. Enda yayemigania na koyemita endagera eye yonsi na koimorera emetaro yonsi egere obuya obo bwasebererekanigwa na gosiarerwa gochia ase chinsinyo chionsi chio’mobere. Korwa abwo enda yabogoria eubi gochia ase omotaro bw’eubi, ase omobere okoyeira na koyeumora ase orosana gose mogondo, gose egetii gose yayetindeka amarooba ime koroisia obotoobu. Ebimeria biamera na kobiara amatunda; amaboko ayatwa amatunda ayio na koyabeka omonwa ime. Ee, nabo, oyo no’morobiro bwo’bogima.
Nonya ne’chigosori no’kwegokia nigo kwabaganetwe buna ebwenerete: ogoteera, ogoseka, na ogokwana bigatigerwa omonwa; okominyoka na goaka enkoyo bikaegwa amagoro, na omopira bwa’maboko, ekinano, nechinkundi bigatigerwa amaboko, korende ase ogoikerani aya onsi, amagoro nigo atakeire aminyoke. Ase egosori yo’koniachoka, amagoro oka agatigerwa egetii gionsi. Okobagana oko emeremo gokagera omobere koba ekioma kio’gokumia, kebweete nonya neching’iti chinene ase ogokora na goikerania amang’ana amanene amange na ay’ogokumia.
Korende ebimo bio’mobere bikarora ng’a omoroberio oyo biancheranete nigo ore gocha koreta okong’usanana nonya nabo. Omotwe kore igoro aria nabo ore gocha gwekaga ng’a nigo ore oyo bwengencho kobua amagoro aya’gotacha inse, gose ng’a no’ro omogambi bwe’bimo bionsi, ng’a ebimo bionsi inse yaye, nabasomba bosa. Ebimo bionsi bikabeka chinguru ekerengererio eke ng’a ase ensemo yechinguru, omotwe na bionsi bire inse yaye, nigo bireng’aine. Erio goikerania ring’ana eri, ebimo bikaenekia ng’a obororo no’mogooko o kimo kende gionsi nigo oraigugwe ne’bimo bionsi. Bigatianera omonwa oinyore ng’a ekero ogoteeba ‘eke ne’kiane, keria ne’kiane’, nigo ogokwana buna omobere omogima na tari buna omonwa bene.

Nonya ching’iti chi-nyamagoro ane chiaroche aya, tichiancheranete ogoonchoreria oko. Ogoteera oko tikwabagogetie. Omonwa nigo otongetwe oragere tari oteere. Chikaroisia ekeombe kiabo kiogotaonchoreria obotongi na koramata ase chinchera ne’chimbwa chiabo chitaonchorerie rinde.
Ekero mwanyabanto akoegera korwa ase okobwaterana kwe’bimo, nigo agokoria buya; korende ekero akorora omobere na omotwe buna ebiombe bigokinana esegi, ekemo kere igoro ye’kende, nigo mwanyabanto oyo akoba ang’e neching’iti, bwamwabo baria baangete ogoonchoreria kwa matenena.
Jane Bosibori Obuchi is a writer, a researcher, and a teacher. She has taught in various secondary schools (Mong’oni, Nyankoba, Christ the King Chepterit, Kaptel Boys), and universities including; Baraton, Kabianga, Mount Kenya, Kisii, and Moi. She holds S1 certificate (Bondo TTC), BA in English and Kiswahili (Baraton University), and is currently pursuing a Master of Arts Degree course in Literature (University of Kabianga), Thesis titled: An analysis of Mchongoano Oral Literary Text as a Kenyan Children’s Cultural Production. Her research interest lies in oral literature, children’s literature, language contact, and, language and gender. She has published several articles, including; Gender Biases in the Language of African Music: a case of Classical Compositions of two Kisii Musicians. Her manuscripts in review for publication include; A collection of ekeGusii short stories, Children’s short stories, Latest Diary of a Kenyan (a satire).

1 Narenge omonto oyomo bw'Abafarisai, erieta riaye Nikodemo, omonene bw'Abayahudi: 2 oyo agacha ase Yesu botuko, akamotebia, Rabii, twamanyire ng'a nomworokia ore, kwarure ase Nyasaye: naki omonto onde tari oranyare kobikora ebikone ebi ogokora, tatiga Nyasaye abe amo nere. 3 Yesu akairaneria, akamotebia, Ekeene, ekeene, nagotebirie, Omonto ataiboiri eria kabere, takonyara koborora obonda bwa Nyasaye. 4 Nikodemo akamotebia, Naki aranyare omonto koiborwa kare omogaka? nanyare gosoa enda ya ng'ina eria kabere aiborwe? 5 Yesu akairaneria, Ekeene, ekeene, nagotebirie, Omonto ataiboiri as'amache n'Omoika, takonyara gosoa obonda bwa Nyasaye. 6 Ekeiboire as'omobere nomobere; nekeiboire as'Omoika nomoika. 7 Tokumia ekiagera nagotebia, Nogwenerete koiborwa naende. 8 Embeo iga ekogenda as'erigetie, negeturi kiaye iga ogokeigwa, korende tomanyeti as'ekorua gose as'ekogenda: naboigo na ker'omonto oiboirwe as'Omoika. 9 Nikodemo akamoiraneria, akamotebia, Naki aranyare koba aya? 10 Yesu akairaneria akamotebia, Inee! Aye nomworokia as'Isiraeli, naya toyainyoreti? 11 Ekeene, ekeene, nagotebirie, Eritomanyete nario togokwana, neri toroche twariteba; noborori bwaito timorigwancha. 12 Kerabe nkobatebia amang'ana ense, nainwe timogwancha, naki moranche, kondabatebie amang'ana a igoro? 13 Naende omonto onde tari orinire igoro, tatiga ere oyoikire korwa igoro Omwana-o-mwanyabanto ore igoro. 14 Naende buna Musa aimogetie eng'iti eroro ime, naboigo Omwana-o-mwanyabanto agwenerete aimokererigwe: 15 erinde tasira omonto onde bwonsi oyomwanchire, korende abe nobogima bwa kare nakare. 16 Naki Nyasaye ayianchete ense, goika akarua Omwana oye omomoima, erinde 'monto onde bwonsi oyomwanchire tasira, korende anyore obogima bwa kare nakare. 17 Naki Nyasaye tamotomete as'ense Omwana oye agambie ense; korende ense ekonywe nere. 18 Oyomwanchire takogambigwa; oyotancheti otiekire kogambigwa, ekiagera atariancheti erieta ria Omwana oyomo bweka o Nyasaye. 19 Neke nakio ekina, ekiagera omobaso ochire ense, abanto bagancha omosunte kobua omobaso;
