naki ogokora kwabo kwarenge okobe. 20 Naki kera oyogokora amabe igagechete omobaso, gose tagocha as'omobaso, ogokora kwaye tikobaisa gokanigwa. 21 Korende oyogokora ekeene igagocha as'omobaso, ogokora kwaye kororekane ng'a iga gwakorirwe ase Nyasaye. 22 Nyuma as'aya Yesu naborokigwa baye bakagenda goika ense ya Boyahudi, akabera aroro amo nabarabwo okobatisa, 23 Yohana nere igarenge kobatisa aria Ainon, ang'e na Salim, ekiagera narenge amache amange: abanto bakomochiera bakobatiswa. 24 Naki Yohana konya tarabekwa echela. 25 Nabo, gokaoroka okoamererania as'aborokigwa ba Yohana n'Abayahudi as'amang'ana ogwesibia. 26 Bakamochiera Yohana, bakamotebia, Rabii, ere oyorenge amo naye ng'umbu ya Yorodan, oyio kwaorogetie aye, oyio nere nkobatisare, nabanto bonsi nkomochierabare. 27 Yohana akairaneria, akabora, Takonyara omonto konyora ring'ana rinde rionsi tatiga aegwe korwa igoro. 28 Inwe abanyene mwabaire kirori ng'a natebete, Inche tari Kristo, korende natomirwe gotang'ana asare. 29 Oyore nere omoriakari bw'enyangi nere omonene, korende omosani oye bw'omonene bw'enyangi iga agotenena nakomoigwa, origokera eriogi riaye omonene bw'enyangi: nabo oyo omogoko one oikeranire. 30 Ere nagwenerete amenteke, korende inche nkee. 31 Oyochire korwa igoro oyio igare igoro as'onsi: oyore bw'ense, noyo bw'ense, iga agokwana amang'ana ense: ere oyochire korwa igoro oyio igare igoro as'onsi. 32 Ayaroche nakoyaigwa, naro abereire kirori: gose onde tari oyobwanchire oborori bwaye. 33 Oyobwanchire oborori bwaye obekire ekemanyererio kiaye ng'a Nyasaye nekeene, 34 Naki ere oyotometwe na Nyasaye igakoyakwana amang'ana a Nyasaye: naki Nyasaye tari komoa Omoika as'ekerengo. 35 Tata omwanchire Omwana, omoeire bionsi as'amaboko aye. 36 Oyoramwanche Omwana nare nobogima bwa kare nakare; noyotamoigwereti Omwana takorora obogima, korende nendamwainu ya Nyasaye eramoikaransere.
1 Nabo Omonene agachia komanya ng'a Abafarisai baigure ng'a Yesu okorire aborokigwa abange kobua Yohana, nakobatisa, 2 (Yesu omonyene tare kobatisa, korende naborokigwa baye), 3 akarua Boyahudi akagenda Galili eria kabere. 4 Naende nagwenerete goeta gati ya Samaria. 5 Nabo agaika omochie o Samaria, okorokwa Sukar, ang'e nomogondo oria Yakobo amoete Yusufu omwana oye: 6 naende agwo yarenge ensoko ya Yakobo. Nabo Yesu, konya orosire as'orogendo rwaye, agaikaransa iga as'ensoko. Konya yabaire ang'e chinsa isano nemo. 7 Agacha omokungu o Samaria kobucha amache: Yesu akamotebia, Ing'a amache inywe. 8 Naki aborokigwa baye konya bachire omochie kogora endagera. 9 Nabo oria omokungu bw'Abasamaria akamotebia, Naki yaba aye Omoyahudi korigia amache asende, nainche nomokungu bw'Abasamaria? (naki Abayahudi tibari gosanga n'Abasamaria.) 10 Yesu akairaneria akamotebia, Onye nkwamanya ekeegwa kia Nyasaye, nere ng'o okogotebia, Ing'a amache inywe; anga nkwamosaba ere, nere anga nakoa amache are moyo. 11 Oria omokungu akamotebia, Omonene, tori negento gi'okobuchera nensoko yachire inse mono: ng'ai kwayanyorire amache aya are moyo? 12 Inee! aye nomonene kobua tata oito Yakobo, oyotoete ensoko eye, nere omonyene akanywa amache aya, nabana baye bonsi netugo yaye? 13 Yesu akairaneria, akamotebia, Ker'oyokonywa amache aya narore erang'o naende: 14 korende onde bwonsi oyoranywe amache aria ndamoe inche, takoigwa erang'o kare nakare; korende amache aria ndanyare komoa nabe ime yaye ensoko y'amache, agosoka goika obogima bwa kare nakare. 15 Omokungu oria akamotebia, Omonene, ing'a amache ayio tindora erang'o, gose timbaisa gocha aiga kobucha. 16 Yesu akamotebia, Genda, omorangerie omosacha oo oche nere aiga. 17 Omokungu oria akairaneria akamotebia, tindi nomosacha. Yesu akamotebia, gwakwanire buya, tindi nomosacha: 18 naki kwabaire nabasacha batano; nere oyore nere bono tari omosacha oo: as'ayio gwakwanire ekeene. 19 Omokungu oria akamotebia, Omonene, narorire ng'a nomobani ore. 20 Abatata baito iga barenge gosasima as'egetunwa eke; nainwe iga mogoteba ng'a Yerusalemu naase atogwenerete togosasimera. 21 Yesu akamotebia, Aye omokungu, inyancha, ensa neche, motpmosasime Tata as'egetunwa eke, nonya nase Yerusalemu. 22 Inwe iga mogosasima eki motamanyeti: intwe iga togosasima ekitemanyete: naki ogotoreka gokorua as'Abayahudi. 23 Korende ensa neche, nabono nere, abare nogosaba kw'ekeene nabamosasime Tata as'omoika nekeene: naki Tata iga akobarigia abanto buna abwo bamosasime. 24 Nyasaye n'Omoika, nabwo bakomosasima nebagwenerete komosasima as'omoika nekeene. 25 Omokungu oria akamotebia, Namanyire ng'a ngochare Masihi (okorokwa Kristo): karache ere, natoorokerie onsi. 26 Yesu akamotebia, Inche ngokwana naye, nere. 27 Erio bagacha aborokigwa baye bagakumia ekiagera arenge gokwana nomokungu; korende onde tarenge kobora, Inki okorigia? gose, Naki ogokwana nere? 28 Nabo oria omokungu akayetiga enyongo yaye, akagenda omochie ka, akabatebia abanto, 29 Inchuo, morore omonto ontebirie amang'ana onsi ayanakorire: Inee! oyio tari ere Kristo? 30 Bakaimoka korwa omochie bakamochiera. 31 Agwo nyuma aborokigwa bakamosorora bakabora, Rabii, ragera. 32 Akabatebia, Inche ninde nendagera motayemanyeti inwe. 33 Aborokigwa baye bakaborania, Inee? nomonto omoretera endagera? 34 Yesu akabatebia, Endagera yane ney'ogokora obwanchani bwaye oyontomete, nagokora emeremo yaye. 35 Timori goteba inwe, Yatigaire emetienyi ene, erio riche rigesa? Nainche nabatebirie, Ramokia amaiso aino moyerigererie emegondo, ng'a yatiekire koba emerabu ang'e ase rigesa. 36 Oyo okogesa nkonyorare eng'eria, nagosangereria amatunda as'obogima bwa kare nakare; erinde ere oyogosimeka nere oyokogesa bagoke amo. 37 Naki ring'ana riria, Oyomo osimeka, oyonde ogesa, iga rire ekeene. 38 Inche nabatomete moyagese ayamotechandereti; abande bakorire emeremo, nainwe mwasoire as'emeremo yabo. 39 Naende as'omochie oria Abasaniaria abange bagancha as'engecho y'amang'ana ay'oria omokungu, atebete ng'a, Nantebia amang'ana onsi ayanakorire. 40 Nabo ekero baria Abasamaria bachia komochiera, bakamosorora aikaranse amo nabarabwo: agaikaransa aroro amatuko abere. 41 Abanto abange kobua bagancha as'engecho ye ring'ana riaye; 42 bakamotebia omokungu oria, Bono twanchire, tari ekiagera as'amang'ana ao: naki twaigure abanyene, naende twamanyire ekeene ng'a oyo n'Omekonyi bw'ense. 43 Nyuma as'amatuko ayio abere akaimoka korwa agwo, akagenda Galili. 44 Naki Yesu omonyene atebete, ng'a omobani tari nogosikwa as'ense yaye omonyene. 45 Nabo ekero achia goika Galili bakamwancha, ekiagera baroche amang'ana onsi ayakorete Yerusalemu ekero kie rituko rinene: naki nabarabwo bagenderete rituko rinene. 46 Agaika naende Kana ya Galili, agwo akorete amache akaba edivai. Naende yarenge esagini eyemo, yarenge nomwana omorwaire Kaperinaum. 47 Oyio agachia koigwa ng'a Yesu ochire korwa Boyahudi goika Galili, akamochiera, akamosorora achiche amokonye omwana oye; ekiagera konya oisire gokwa. 48 Nabo Yesu akamotebia, Motarochi ebikone namakumigwa timogwancha nonya ng'ake. 49 Oria esagini akamotebia, Omonene, ika ritang'ani atarakwa omwana one. 50 Yesu akamotebia, Bwatia enchera yao: omwana oo moy'are. Omonto oria akariancha riria ring'ana atebetigwe na Yesu, akabwatia enchera. 51 Goika agachia koba ogoika, abasomba baye bagacha komorotota, bakamotebia, bakabora, Omwana oo moy'are. 52 Erio akababoria amang'ana ensa achagete koba buya. Bakamotebia, Igoro, chinsa isano naibere, esosera yamotigete. 53 Erio ise akainyora ng'a nensa eria eria atebetigwe na Yesu, Omwana oo moy'are: agancha ere, nenyomba yaye yonsi. 54 Neke negekone gia kabere akorete Yesu korwa ekero aruete Boyahudi kogenda Galili.
1 Nyuma as'aya ndiarenge rituko rinene ri'Abayahudi; Yesu agatira kogenda Yerusalemu. 2 Naende aria Yerusalemu as'egesieri kie ching'ondi ndiarenge ritibo rikorokwa as'Ekeibirania Bethesaida, narirorio mbiarengeo ebisoero bitano. 3 Ime as'ebio mbarenge abanto abange abarwaire bakorara, emeuko, chirema, ab'ebimo biabo biomire, baganyete amache aseroke. 4 Naki ekero gete rilaika ngoika riarenge riasoa ase riria ritibo, koyaturubania amache: nabo ere oyore gosoa ritang'ani nyuma as'amache agoturubanigwa, igare kogwena oborwaire bwonsi obwamonyorete. 5 Narenge aroro omonto gete oyorenge noborwaire bw'emiaka emerongo etato netano netato. 6 Yesu agachia komorora oyio oraire, akamanya ng'a obaire engecho eye amatuko amange, akamotebia, Norigetie koba omogima? 7 Oria omorwaire akamoiraneria, Omonene, tindi nomonto okombeka ritibo ime, amache gagoturubanigwa: korende ekero ngochicha inche, omonto onde osoa ritang'ani asende. 8 Yesu akamotebia, Tenena, etweke egesero kiao, ogende. 9 Erio kegima omonto oria akaba omogima, agetweka egesero kiaye, akagenda. Nabo yarenge esabato rituko riria. 10 Abayahudi bakamotebia oria okonyetwe, Rero nesnbato, tari boronge asore gwetweka egesero kiao. 11 Akabairaneria, Ere oyonkora koba omogima nere ontebia, Etweke egesero kiao, ogende. 12 Bakamoboria, Oria ogotebia, Etweke egesero kiao ogende, ning'o? 13 Korende oria ogwenetigwe tamomanyete gose ning'o: naki Yesu erusananetie, ekiagera barenge abanto abange aas'aria. 14 Nyuma as'aya Yesu akamonyora hekalu itne, akamotebia, Rora, kwabaire omogima: tokora ebibe naende, ring'ana rire ribe kobua tiricha gokonyora. 15 Oria omonto akagenda, akabatebia Abayahudi amang'ana ng'a Yesu nere onkorete nkaba omogima. 16 As'ayio Abayahudi bagachaka komochanda Yesu, bakarigia komoita, ekiagera akora aya rituko ri'esabato. 17 Yesu akabairaneria, Tata one ngokorare emeremo nonya ngoika bono, nainche ngokorande emeremo. 18 Nabo ekiagera as'aya Abayahudi bakamenta korigia komoita, ekiagera atasareti esabato yoka, korende amo naya namorogete Nyasaye Tata oye, ogwekora koreng'ana buna Nyasaye. 19 Yesu akairaneria, akabatebia, Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie, Omwana takonyara gokora ring'ana ere bweka, tatiga riria amororire Tata agokora: naki onsi agokora ere ayio naio n'Omwana agokora, 20 Naki Tata amwanchire Omwana, okomworokia onsi ayagokora omonyene: nemeremo emenene kobua eyeiga namworokie erinde inwe monyare gokumia. 21 Naki buna Tata akobibokia ebitondo nakobia obogima, naboigo n'Omwana akobaa obogima abarigetie. 22 Ekiagera Tata tari komogambia omonto onde bwonsi, korende omoire Omwana okogamba gwonsi; 23 erinde bonsi bamosike Omwana, buna bamosigete Tata. Oyotamosigeti Omwana tamosigeti Tata omotomete, 24 Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie, oyokoigwa ring'ana riane, nakomwancha ere oyontomete nare nobogima bwa kare nakare, gose tagoika as'ekina, korende oetire korwa as'amakweri goika as'obogima. 25 Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie, Ensa ngochere, nabono nere, ebitondo biraigwe eriogi ri'Omwana o Nyasaye; nabaria bakorigwa nababe moyo. 26 Naki buna Tata are nobogima ime yaye omonyene; naboigo omoeire n'Omwana koba nobogima ime yaye omonyene: 27 akamoa okobua kw'ogokora ekina ekiagera ere n'Omwana-o-mwanyabanto. 28 Timokumia as'aya: naki ensa ngochere, ekero abanto bonsi bare ase chimbera ime baraigwe eriogi riaye, 29 nabarabwo nabasoke; baria abare gokora amaya as'okobokigwa kw'obogima; nabaria abakorire amabe as'okobokigwa gw'ekina. 30 Inche omonyene tinkonyara gokora kende gionsi: buna nkoigwa, nabo nkogamba: nekina kiane iga kere boronge; ekiagera tindi koborigia obwanchani bwane, korende nobwanchani bwaye Tata oyontomete. 31 Inche kondetebe omonyene, ogoteba kwane tari okw'ekeene. 32 Nare oyonde oyokombera kirori; nainche namanyire ng'a oborori bwaye agonteba nobw'ekeene, 33 Inwe mwatomete abanto ase Yohana, noborori bwaye nekeene. 34 Korende inche tindi konyora oborori korwa as'abanto: korende iga ngokwana aya erinde inwe mokonyeke. 35 Ere igarenge etaya egwoka nakomoreka: nainwe mwanchire koyosasokera omobaso oye ekero egeke. 36 Korende oborori nde naborobwo nobonene, kobua boria bwa Yohana: naki emeremo eria naetwe na Tata inyekore, emeremo eyio eyio nayekorire, yambereire kirori ng'a Tata nere ontomete. 37 Nere Tata ontomete obaire kirori asende. Eriogi riaye timwanya korigwa kero kende gionsi, gose ekieni kiaye timorakerora; 38 naende ring'ana riaye timori narirorio ime yaino: naki inwe timwancheti ere oyotomirwe nere. 39 Iga mokorigiarigia mono amariko, ekiagera mokagete ng'a inwe more nobogima bwa kare nakare ime yaye, nayio naro are kirori asende; 40 ko mwangire gocha asende, monyare koba nobogima. 41 Tindi konyora obonene as'abanto. 42 Korende nabsmanyire inwe ng'a timori nobwanchani bwa Nyasaye ime yaino. 43 Inche nachire as'erieta ria Tata one nainwe timori konyancha: oyonde karache as'eiieta riaye omonyene, namomwanche oyio. 44 Naki moranyare gwancha inwe abamokoenana obonene inwe as'inwe, nobonene boria bokorua ase Nyasaye ore bweka timori koborigia? 45 Timokaga ng'a inche nimbasoere ase Tata: nare oyokobasoera, nere Musa, oyomosemeretie inwe. 46 Naki onye mwamwanchete Musa, anga mwanyancha inche; ekiagera nere origete amang'ana ane. 47 Korende motayancheti amariko aye, naki morayanche amang'ana ane?
1 Nyuma as'aya Yesu akagenda ng'umbu y'enyancha ya Galili, nero enyancha ya Tiberia; 2 Omoganda omonene okamotunyana, ekiagera baroche ebikone abakorerete abarwaire. 3 Yesu akarina egetunwa, agaikaransa agwo amo naborokigwa baye. 4 Naende epasaka, rituko rinene ri'Abayahudi, yarenge ang'e. 5 Nabo Yesu agachia koramokia amaiso aye, akarora omoganda omonene ogocha asare, akamotebia Filipo, Ng'ai tokogora emegati, aba banyare koria? 6 Iga aborete aya erinde amoteme: naki amanyete omonyene ekiarakore. 7 Filipo akamoiraneria, Emegati ye chidinari chimia ibere tekobaisana, ker'oyomo anyore omoke bwoka. 8 Oyomo bw'aborokigwa baye, Anderea, momura omwabo Simon Petero, akamotebia, 9 Naraa omosae, oyore nemegati etano y'engano ne chinswe ibere: korende ebi inki as'abanto abange buna iga? 10 Yesu akabora, baikaransie abanto. Mbwarenge aroro obonyansi obonge aase aria. Nabo abasacha bagaikaransa, omobaro obo chilifu isano. 11 Yesu akayebogoria emegati; gasesenirie, akabagabera abaikaransete: naboigo nachiria chinswe koreng'ana buna barigetie. 12 Kobachia koigota, akabatebia aborokigwa baye, Sangereria ebisamunye biatigaire, 'gento tigesira. 13 Nabo bakabisangereria, bagaichoria ebitonga ikomi nabibere as'ebisamunye bi'emegati etano y'engano, ebiatigarete as'abwo bariete. 14 Ekero abanto baria, bachia korora egekone akorete Yesu, bakabora, oyo ekeene nomobani oria ochire as'ense. 15 Nabo Yesu, akamanya ng'a mbarigetie gocha komoira erinde bamokore omoruoti, akerusanania, akagenda naende egetunwa, ere bweka. 16 Egachia koba mogoroba, aborokigwa baye bagatirimboka gochia 'nyancha; 17 bakarina obwato ime bagachaka kwamboka enyancha kogenda Kaperinaum. Naende omosunte konya obaire, na konya Yesu tarabachichera. 18 Enyancha egachaka koimoka, as'engecho y'embeo enyinge yagusete. 19 Nabo kabang'usire obwato chimaili isato gose inye, bakamorora Yesu okogenda igoro as'enyancha, ogoika ang'e as'obwato: bakairoka. 20 Akabatebia, Ninche, timoiroka. 21 Bagancha komosoyia obwato ime: erio kegima obwato bogaika ense barenge kogenda. 22 Inkio yaye omoganda oteneine ng'umbu y'enyancha bakarora ng'a obwato bonde tibwarenge aroro, tatiga boria obomo basoete aborokigwa baye, naende ng'a Yesu tasoete as'obwato boria amo naborokigwa baye korende naborokigwa baye bagendete boka. 23 (Korende amato ande agacha korwa Tiberia ang'e naas'aria bariete emegati ekero Omonene asesenetie): 24 ekero omoganda ochia korora ng'a Yesu tari aroro, nonya naborokigwa baye, barabwo abanyene bagasoa amato ime, bakagenda Kaperinaum bakomorigia Yesu. 25 Goika bagachia komorora ng'umbu as'enyancha, bakamotebia, Rabii, indi gwachete aa? 26 Yesu akabairaneria, akabatebia, Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie, Iga mokondigia, tari ekiagera mwaroche ebikone, korende ekiagera mwariete eria emegati, mokaigota. 27 Timoyekorera endagera eyegosareka, korende endagera ekobao goika obogima bwa kare nakare, Omwana-o-mwanyabanto aranyare kobaa: naki oyo nere obegetwe ekemanyererio na Tata, engecho yaye, Nyasaye. 28 Nabo bakamotebia, Ninki togokora tonyare koyekora emeremo ya Nyasaye? 29 Yesu akairaneria, akabatebia, Eye nero emeremo ya Nyasaye, momwanche ere oyotomirwe nere. 30 Bakamotebia, Mbikone ki gwakorire erinde torore twanche? 'Meremo ki ogokora? 31 Abatata baito mbariete manna as'eroro ime; buna yarigetwe, Nabaete omogati korwa igoro barie. 32 Yesu akabatebia, Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie, Tari Musa obaete omogati oria oruete igoro; korende n'Tata one okobaa omogati bw'ekeene okorua igoro. 33 Naki omogati o Nyasaye noria ogoika korwa igoro, nakoyea ense obogima. 34 Nabo, bakamotebia, Omonene, amatuko onsi otoe omogati oyio. 35 Yesu akabatebia, Inche nomogati bw'obogima: ere oyogocha asende takoigwa enchara naende, nere oyoranyanche takoigwa erang'o nonya ng'ake. 36 Korende nabatebirie ng'a mwandorire ko timonyancheti. 37 Bonsi Omonene akong'a nabache asende; nere oyogocha asende tinkomotuguta isiko nonya ng'ake. 38 Naki ting'igeti korwa igoro erinde nkore obwanchani bwane, korende obwanchani bwaye oyontomete. 39 Naende obwanchani bwaye Tata oyontomete nabw'obo, ng'a ase bonsi ang'eire tinsiria egento nonya nekemo, korende mbabokie ase rituko ri'omoerio. 40 Nobwanchani bwaye oyontomete nabw'obo, ng'a ker'oyokomorigereria Omwana nakomwancha, nabe nobogima bwa kare nakare; ninche nimobokie ase rituko ri'omoerio. 41 Abayahudi bakamwemurunganeria, as'engecho atebete, Inche nomogati oigete korwa igoro. 42 Bakabora, Oyo tari Yesu, omwana o Yusufu, ntobamanyete ise na ng'ina? Naki akobora oyo, Naikire korwa igoro? 43 Yesu akairaneria, akabatebia, Timwemurungania inwe as'inwe. 44 Omonto onde tari oranyare gocha asende, atang'usiri na Tata oyontomete: nainche nimobokie ase rituko ri'omoerio. 45 Nerikire as'ababani, Na bonsi naborokererigwe na Nyasaye. Kera oyokoigwa nakweorokereria ase Tata, igagocha asende. 46 Tari ng'a omonto omororire Tata, tatiga ere orure ase Nyasaye, oyio nere omororire Tata. 47 Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie, Ere oyoranyanche inche nare nobogima bwa kare nakare. 48 Inche nomogati bw'obogima. 49 Abaiso baino mbariete manna eroro ime, naende bagakwa. 50 Oyo nomogati oikire korwa igoro, erinde omonto orayorie, tagokwa. 51 Inche nomogati bw'obogima oigete korwa igoro: omonto kararie omogati oyio, nabe moyo goika kare nakare: nomogati ndarue inche nomobere one, as'engecho y'obogima bw'ense. 52 Erio Abayahudi bakaamererania barabwo ase barabwo, bakabora, Naki omonto oyo aranyare gotoa intwe omobere oye toyorie? 53 Yesu akabatebia, Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie, Motayorieti omobere oye Omwana-o-mwanyabanto na koyanywa amanyinga aye, timori nobogima ime yaino. 54 Oyokoyoria omobere one nakoyanywa amanyinga ane nare nobogima bwa kare nakare: nainche nimobokie rituko ri'omoerio. 55 Naki omobere one nendagera y'ekeene, namanyinga ane nekenyugwa ki'ekeene, 56 oyokoyoria omobere one nakoyanywa amanyinga ane igagoikaransa ime asende, nainche ime yaye. 57 Buna Tata are moyo antomete, nainche inde moyo as'engecho ya Tata; koreng'ana ere oyorandie, nabe moyo as'engecho yane. 58 Oyio nomogati oikire kojwa igoro: tari buna abaiso baino bariete manna, bagakwa: oyorarie omogati oyio nabe moyo kare nakare. 59 Amang'ana aya iga ayakwanete esunagogi, kare kworokereria aria Kaperinaum. 60 Nabo abanto abange as'aborokigwa baye bagachia koigwa aya, bakabora, Ring'ana eri nerikong'u; ing'o oranyare korigwa? 61 Ko Yesu akamanya as'omoyo oye ng'a aborokigwa baye bariemurunganeirie ring'ana eri, akabatebia, Ring'ana eri ndiabagochirie? 62 Naki erabe rende, komoramorore Omwana-o-mwanyabanto okorina aria aas'arenge ritang'ani? 63 Omoika noro okobeka obogima; omobere togwenereti gento: amang'ana nabatebirie nomoika, naende nobogima. 64 Korende mbare abande as'egati yaino batancheti. Naki Yesu amanyete korwa omochakano mbarabi abatancheti naende ning'o oranyare komorua. 65 Akabora, As'engecho eye nabatebirie, ng'a omonto onde tari oranyare gocha asende, tatiga oeirwe na Tata one. 66 As'engecho y'aya abange as'aborokigwa baye bakairana nyuma, tibamotunya naende. 67 Erio Yesu akabatebia ikomi nababere, Nainwe morigetie kogenda? 68 Simon Petero akamoiraneria, Omonene! togende ase ng'o? Aye nore namang'ana obogima bwa kare nakare. 69 Naintwe twanchire, naende twamanyire ng'a aye naye Omochenu o Nyasaye. 70 Yesu akabairaneria, Inee! timbachoreti inwe ikomi nababere, noyomo oino nekerecha? 71 Iga amotebete Yudas, omwana o Simon Omoisikariota, ekiagera oyo nere oranyare komorua: nere noyomo bw'ikomi nababere.
1 Nyuma as'aya Yesu akaba ogotara ase Galili: naki tarigetie gotara ase Boyahudi, ekiagera Abayahudi iga barenge korigia komoita. 2 Naende rituko rinene ri'Abayahudi, rituko rinene ri'ebigutu, iga riarenge ang'e, 3 Abamwabo bakamotebia, Imoka korwa aiga ogende Boyahudi, aborokigwa bao nabarabwo banyare koyerora emeremo yao eyogokora. 4 Naki omonto onde tari ogokora ring'ana bobisi, naende ere omonyene narigetie komanyekana. Kogokora aya, eorokie as'ense. 5 Naki nonya nabamwabo tibamwanchete. 6 Yesu akabatebia, Tikeraika ekero kiane; korende ekero kiaino botambe nkere ang'e. 7 Ense tekonyara kobagecha inwe; korende iga ekongecha inche, ekiagera inche nkoyeteba ng'a emeremo yaye nemebe. 8 Tira inwe mogende ase rituko rinene: inche tingotira kogenda ase rituko eri; ekiagera ekero kiane tikeraika. 9 Agachia gokora kobatebia aya, agaikaransa ase Galili. 10 Goika ekero abamwabo bachia gotira, erio nere agatira kogenda ase rituko rinene, tari maiso marore korende ase bobisi. 11 Nabo Abayahudi bakamorigia ase rituko erio bakabora, Ng'ai are oyio? 12 Gokaba okwemurungania okonene as'emeganda as'engecho yaye: abande bakobora, Igare omonto omuya; nabande bakobora, Taibo, korende igagosiria emeganda. 13 Korende omonto tari omwatorete maiso marore ekiagera as'okobairoka Abayahudi. 14 Goika egachia koba gati gati ye rituko rinene Yesu agatira, agasoa hekalu ime akorokereria, 15 Abayahudi bakamokumia, bakabora, Naki amanyete obong'aini, nere tarasoma? 16 Yesu akabairaneria akabora, Okworokereria kwane tari okwane, korende nokwaye ere oyontomete. 17 Omonto karanche kobokora obwanchani bwaye, namanye amang'ana okworokereria oko, ng'a kwarure ase Nyasaye, gose ninche ngweteba omonyene. 18 Ere oyogwekwana bweka omo nyene iga akorigia obonene bwaye omonyene: korende ere oyokorigia obonene bwaye oyomotomete, oyio noyo bw'ekeene, nonya ime yaye tibori obobe. 19 Oyo obaete amachiko tari Musa? korende tari oyomo oino okorete amachiko? Naki mokorigia kong'ita? 20 Emeganda ekairaneria, ekabora, Nore nekerecha: ning'o okorigia gogoita? 21 Yesu akairaneria, akabatebia, Nakorete omoremo oyomo, nainwe mwensi mwakumirie. 22 Ekiagera as'aya Musa abaete okwaroka, (tari ng'a iga kwaruete ase Musa korende ase chisokoro chiaino); nainwe rituko ri'esabato iga mokomosara omonto. 23 Gaki onye omonto ogasarwa rituko ri'esabato, ogochika kwa Musa tigochagosareka; naki mokombea ekiagera namokora omonto koba omogima kegima rituko ri'esabato? 24 Timogamba ekina as'engecho y'ekieni, korende kora ekina kere kia boronge. 25 Erio ensemo y'abanto ba Yerusalemu bakabora, Oyo tari ere bakorigia komoita? 26 Ani! iga agokwana maiso marore gose tibari komotebia ing'ana? Bori abanene bamanyire ng'a nere Kristo? 27 Korende oyo twamanyire ase arure, korende Kristo karache, onde tari oramanye as'akorua. 28 Erio Yesu akaaka eriogi riaye ase hekalu, okworokereria, okobora, Inche mwamanyire, aase narure mwaamanyire: naende tinchicheti as'inche omonyene, tatiga ere oyontomete noyo bw'ekeene, motamomanyeti inwe. 29 Korende inche namomanyire; ekiagera narure asare, nere ontomire. 30 Gaki bakarigia komobwata: korende onde tari oramborete okoboko kwaye erinde amobwate ekiagera ensa yaye konya teraika. 31 Abanto abange as'emeganda bakamwancha; bakabora, Karachiche Kristo, inee! nakore ebikone ebinge mono kobua ebiga akorire oyo? 32 Abafarisai bakayeigwa emeganda bakwemurungania as'engecho yaye; Abafarisai nabakuani abanene bagatoma abarendi erinde bamobwate. 33 Erio Yesu akabora, nkere ekero egeke inde amo nainwe, erio ningende asare ere oyontomete. 34 Namondigie korende timokonyora; naase inde inche, timokonyara gocha. 35 Nabo Abayahudi bagatchania barabwo ase barabwo, Oyo ng'ai aragende goika intwe titonionyora? Nagende as'Ogwatananeka kw'Abayunani nakoborokereria Abayunani? 36 Ing'ana ki erio akwana, Namondigie korende timokonyora, naase inde inche, inwe timokonyara gocha? 37 Nase rituko ri'omoerio, rituko riria rinene, Yesu agatenena. agakwana neriogi, okobora, Omonto karabe nerang'o, tiga ache asende any we. 38 Oyonyanchire inche buna amariko agoteba, chindoche chi'amache obogima namorue as'enda yaye. 39 Ring'ana eri igarikwanete as'engecho y'Omoika, ekiagera baria abamwanchire nabayonyore nyuma, naki Omoika Omochenu konya torarugwa; ekiagera Yesu konya taraimokererigwa igoro. 40 Nabo abanto abange as'omoganda bagachia koigwa amang'ana ayio, bakabora, Oyo ekeene nomobani oria. 41 Abande bakabora, Oyo nere Kristo. Korende abande bakabora, Inee, Kristo iga ararue Galili? 42 Okorika tikori goteba ng'a Kristo igagocha as'okoibora gwa Daudi, naende ase Bethilehemu, agachie karia aikaransete Daudi? 43 Eriogogasoa as'emeganda ogwatananeka as'engecho yaye. 44 Ensemo yabo bakarigia komobwata; korende omonto taramborete okoboko kwaye erinde amobwate, 45 Baria abarendi bakabachiera abakuani abanene n'Abafarisai; nabarabwo bakabatebia, Naki motamoreta? 46 Baria abarendi bakairaneria, Tarakwana omonto onde bwonsi buna oyo agokwana. 47 Erio Abafarisai bakabairaneria, Inee! inwe nainwe mwang'ainekire? 48 Ning'o as'abanene bamwanchire, gose as'Abafarisai? 49 Korende emesangerereko eyio etamanyete amachiko baragererigwe. 50 Nikodemo akabatebia (noria omochierete botuko, ekiagera noyomo obo), 51 Inee! ogochika gwaito nkonacherware omonto ekina gotoramoigwa ritang'ani nakomanya eki akora? 52 Bakairaneria, bakamotebia, Naye Galili kwarua? Rigia, orore ng'a korua Galili taorogete omobani. 53 Bakagenda ker'omonto 'nyomba mwaye.
1 Korende Yesu akagenda as'egetunwa kie Emezeituni. 2 Mambia chuni agasoa naende hekalu ime, abanto bonsi bakamogendera; nere agaikaransa akaborokereria. 3 Abariki n'Abafarisai bakareta omokungu obwatetwe as'ogotomana; kabamobekire gati gati, 4 bakamotebia, Omworokia, omokungu oyo igabwatwa ogotomana, gagokora bo. 5 Nabo as'amachiko a Musa iga atochigete kobaaka amagena abanto buna abwo: gaki naki aye ogoteba? 6 Bagateba ring'ana eri bakomotema banyore enchera bakomosoera, Korende Yesu agekumba, akarika nekiara kiaye inse. 7 Nabarabwo bakamenta komoboria, akagororoka, akabatebia, Ere oyotari nebibe as'egati yaino abe oyo bwe ritang'ani komoruta rigena. 8 Agekumba naende, akarika, nekiara kiaye inse. 9 Nabarabwo, bagachia koigwa, bagasoerwa nebirengererio biabo, bagasoka oyomo oyomo bagachaka korwa as'abagaka goika as'ab'omoerio; agatigara Yesu bweka, noria omokungu oteneine gati gati. 10 Yesu akagororoka tamorora omonto tatiga oria omokungu, akamotebia, Omokungu, ng'ai bare baria abagosoeri bao? Onde tari ogokogambia? 11 Akamotebia, Onde tari, Omonene. Yesu akamotebia, Ninche tingokogambia; Genda; korende tokora ebibe naende. 12 Yesu agakwana nabarabwo naende, akabora, Inche nomobaso bw'ense: oyogontunyana takogenda as'omosunte, korende nabe omobaso bw'obogima. 13 Erio Abafarisai bakamotebia, Aye igo kwebera kirori omonyene; noborori bwao tibori obw'ekeene. 14 Yesu akairaneria akabatebia, Nonya ngwekwana inche omonyene, oborori bwane nobw'ekeene, ekiagera namanyire ase narure, nase nkogenda; korende inwe timomanyeti ase narure gose ase ngochia. 15 Inwe iga mokogamba as'engecho y'omobere; inche tindi komogambia omonto. 16 Naende ninsakogamba, okogamba kwane nokw'ekeene, naki tari inche bweka, korende inche na Tata oyontomete. 17 Naende as'amachiko aino iga arikire, ng'a oborori bw'abanto babere nobw'ekeene. 18 Inche ninche ngwekwana omonyene, nere Tata oyontomete igagoteba oborori asende. 19 Erio bakamotebia, Ng'ai are Iso? Yesu akairaneria, Inche timomanyeti, nonya Tata timomomanyeti, onye momanyete inche, anga mwamomanyire na Tata one. 20 Amang'ana aya igakwanete Yesu okworokereria ase hekalu, as'enyomba y'emonga: omonto tari omobwatete, ekiagera ensa yaye konya teraika. 21 Yesu akabatebia naende, Inche nkogendande, nainwe namondigie, namokwe as'ebibe biaino: aase nkogenda inche, inwe timokonyara gocha, 22 Abayahudi bakabora, Inee? igareite, ekiagera akobora, Aase nkogenda inche timekonyara gocha? 23 Akabatebia, Inwe naba inse; Inche noyo igoro: inwe nabe ense eye; Inche tindi oyo bw'ense eye, 24 As'ayio nabatebia ng'a namokwe as'ebibe biaino: naki motancheti ng'a inche nere, namokwe as'ebibe biaino. 25 Nabo bakamotebia, Naye ng'o? Yesu akabatebia, Ring'ana erio erio nakwanire nainwe korwa omochakano. 26 Ninde namang'ana amange ngokwana nakogamba as'engecho yaino: korende ere oyontomete noyo bw'ekeene; nainche aya naigure asare, naro ngokwana as'ense. 27 Tibainyora ekiagera abatorera Tata. 28 Erio Yesu akabatebia, Ekero mwatiekire komoimokia Omwana-o-mwanyabanto, erio namomanye ng'a inche nere, naende ng'a tindi gokora ring'ana inche omonyene, korende buna Tata anyorokereretie, nabo ngokwana. 29 Nere oyontomete iga are amo nainche; Tata tantigeti inche bweka; naki inche ngokora amatuko onsi aya akomogwenera. 30 Kagokwana aya, abange bakamwancha. 31 Nabo Yesu akabatebia Abayahudi baria bamwegenete, Komoraikaranse ase ring'ana riane, erio more aborokigwa bane b'ekeene; 32 naende namomanye ekeene, nakerokio ekeene nakebasibore. 33 Bakamoiraneria, Iga tore okoiborwa kw'Ibrahimu, na titoraba abasomba b'omonto kero kende gionsi; ko naki ogoteba, Ng'a namosiborwe? 34 Yesu akabairaneria, Ekeene ekeene; nabatebirie, ker'oyogokora ebibe, nomosomba bw'ebibe, 35 naende omosomba tari komenya 'nyomba botambe, korende omobiare iga akomenya amatuko onsi. 36 Gaki Omwana karabasibore namobe abasibore ekeene, ekeene. 37 Namanyire ng'a iga more okoiborwa kwa Ibrahimu; korende iga mokorigia kong'ita ekiagera ring'ana riane tiriri ime as'emioyo yaino. 38 Aya narorire ase Tata naro ngokwana: nainwe naboigo ayamwarorire as'iso oino, naro mogokora. 39 Bakairaneria, bakamotebia, Tata oito nere Ibrahimu. Yesu akabatebia, Onye mwarenge abana ba Ibrahimu, anga mwakora emeremo yaye Ibrahimu. 40 Korende bono morigetie kong'ita, omonto oyobatebirie ekeene keria naigure ase Nyasaye; Ibrahimu takorete iga. 41 Inwe iga mokoyekora emeremo y'iso oino. Bakamotebia, Intwe titoiboiri as'ogosaria; iga tore na tata oyomo, nere Nyasaye. 42 Yesu akabatebia, Onye Nyasaye narenge iso oino, anga mwanyanchete inche: naki narure ase Nyasaye naende nachire; gose tinchicheti as'inche omonyene korende nere ontomire. 43 Naki motainyoreti amang'ana ane aya ngokwana? Nekiagera motakonyara korigwa ring'ana riane. 44 Inwe nab'iso oino saitani, nokorengereria kw'iso oino nakwo mwanchete gokora. Ere igarenge omoiti korwa omochakano, gose tatenenete as'ekeene, ekiagera ekeene tikeri ime yaye. Kagokwana oborimo, igagokwana ayare aya ye omonyene: naki are omonyaborimo, naise bw'obwo. 45 Nainche, ekiagera ngokwana ekeene, timori konyegena. 46 Ning'o oino ogonteba ng'a ninde nebibe? Kongokwana ekeene naki inwe motakonyegena? 47 Oyore o Nyasaye iga akoyaigwa amang'ana a Nyasaye: as'ayio inwe timori koigwa, ekiagera inwe timori aba Nyasaye. 48 Abayahudi bakairaneria bakamotebia, Titori gokwana buya intwe: ng'a aye igore Omosamaria, naende nore nekerecha? 49 Yesu akairaneria, Inche tindi nekerecha; korende iga nasigete Tata one, nainwe timonsigeti. 50 Nainche tindikoborigia obonene bwane: nare oyokorigia nakogamba. 51 Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie, Omonto kararibwate ring'ana riane, takorora amakweri nonya ng'ake. 52 Nabo Abayahudi bakamotebia, Bono twamanyire ng'a nore nekerecha. Ibrahimu okure, nababani; naye igogoteba, Omonto kararibwate ring'ana riane, takoigwa amakweri nonya ng'ake. 53 Aye nomonene kobua tata oito Ibrahimu, nere okure? Naende nababani bakure: naye bwekora obe ng'o? 54 Yesu akairaneria, Kondebake inche omonyene, obonene bwane tari gento: oyokombaka n'Tata one; mokobora inwe ng'a Nyasaye oino; 55 nainwe timomomanyeti; korende inche namomanyire; kondatebe ng'a timomanyeti nimbe omorimo buna inwe: korende namomanyire naende ring'ana riaye naribwatire. 56 Ibrahimu iso oino igagogete anyare korirora rituko riane; akarora akagoka. 57 Abayahudi bakamotebia, Otaraba nemiaka emerongo etano, n'Ibrahimu kwamororire? 58 Yesu akabatebia, Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie, Ritang'ani Ibrahimu ataraba, Inche nao nare. 59 Erio bakabogoria amagena bamorute: korende Yesu akebisa agasoka korwa ase hekalu ime.
1 Agachia goeta akamorora omonto, omouko korwa okoiborwa kwaye. 2 Aborokigwa baye bakamoboria, bakobora, Rabii, ning'o okorete ebibe, nomonto oyo, gose nabamoibori baye, goika akaiborwa omouko? 3 Yesu akairaneria, oyo takorete ebibe nonya nabamoibori baye; korende nemeremo ya Nyasaye eorokigwe asare. 4 Nengwenerete inyekore emeremo yaye oyontomete ekero ore omobaso: obotuko ngochabore, atanyare omonto gokora emeremo. 5 Ekero inde as'ense, inche nomobaso bw'ense. 6 Agachia gokora gokwana aya, agatwa amate inse, agakora etintira as'aria amate, akamoaka omouko amaiso as'etintira eria, 7 akamotebia, Genda bwesibie ase ritibo ria Siloam (ogoonchorwa kwaye, Oyotomirwe). Erio akagenda agesibia, akairana, okorora. 8 Nabo abagisangio baye, nabaria abamoroche kare ekero arenge omouko, bakabora, Inee! oyo tari ere oria orenge gosaba, oikaransete? 9 Abande bakabora, Nere: abande bakabora, Yaya, igagwekaine nere. Ere omonyene akabora, Ninche ere. 10 Nabo bakamotebia, Amaiso ao naki aramokigwa? 11 Ere akairaneria, akabora, Omonto okorokwa Yesu okorete etintira, akang'aka amaiso ane, agantebia, Genda goika ritibo ria Siloam, bwesibie; nabo nkagenda ngesibia, nkanyora okorora. 12 Bakamotebia, Ng'ai are oyio? Akabora, Timanyeti. 13 Bakamoira oria orenge omouko ritang'ani as'Abafarisai. 14 Bono iga riarenge rituko ri'esabato ekero Yesu akorete etintira nakomoramokia amaiso. 15 Erio Abafarisai nabarabwo bakamoboria naende buna anyorete okorora. Akabatebia, Iga abeka etintira igoro as'amaiso ane, ngesibia, na bono narorire. 16 Erio abande b'Abafarisai bakabora, Omonto oyo taruete ase Nyasaye, ekiagera tayebwateti esabato. Abande bakabora, naki aranyare omonto omonyene ebibe gokora ebikone buna ebi? Gokaba ogwatananeka egati yabo. 17 Gaki bakamotebia oria omouko eria kabere, Aye naki okobora asare, ekiagera, akoramokia amaiso? Akabora, Igare omobani. 18 Erio Abayahudi tibancha amang'ana aye ng'a igarenge omouko, naende anyarete korora, goika bakabarangeria abamoibori baye oria onyorete okorora, 19 bakababoria, bakabora, Oyo nere omwana oino mogoteba ng'a iga aiboretwe omouko? Naki akora orora bono? 20 Abamoibori baye bakairaneria, bakabora, Twamanyire ng'a oyio nomwana oito, naende ng'a iga aiboretwe omouko: 21 korende buna arora bono, titomanyeti; gose ning'o omoramokia amaiso titomanyeti: ere nomonto omogima, moborie omonyene, nekwanere. 22 Abamoibori baye iga bakwanete 'aya as'okoiroka Abayahudi: naki Abayahudi konya babwatanire ng'a omonto oramoorokie ng'a nere Kristo, aserigwe korwa as'esunagogi. 23 Nero engecho yagerete abamoibori baye bakabora, Ere nomonto omogima, moborie. 24 Erio eria kabere bakamorangeria omonto oria orenge omouko, bakamotebia, Moe Nyasaye obonene: intwe twamanyire ng'a omonto oyio nomonyene ebibe, 25 Erio oria akairaneria akabora, Onye ere nomonyene ebibe timanyeti: namanyire ring'ana erimo, inche iga narenge omouko, korende bono narorire. 26 Bakamotebia naende, Naki agokorerete? Naki akoramogetie amaiso? 27 Akabairaneria, natiekire kobatebia, ko timoigweti: naki morigetie koigwa eria kabere? Inwe nainwe morigetie koba aborokigwa baye? 28 Erio bakamorama, bakabora, Naye omworokigwa oye; korende intwe iga tore aborokigwa ba Musa. 29 Intwe twamanyire ng'a Nyasaye igare gokwana ase Musa: korende as'oyo titomanyeti as'arure. 30 Oria omonto akairaneria akabatebia, Ring'ana eri nerio ogokumia, ng'a inwe timomanyeti as'arure, nere ondamokirie amaiso. 31 Twamanyire ng'a Nyasaye tari kobaigwa abanyene ebibe: korende omonto karabe omosasimi Nyasaye, nagokora obwanchani bwaye, oyio nere akoigwa. 32 Korwa omochakano teraigugwa ng'a omonto oyaramokirie amaiso omouko oiboretwe engecho eye. 33 Onye oyo taruete ase Nyasaye, anga takonyara gokora gento. 34 Bakairaneria, bakamotebia, Aye iga kwaiboretwe as'ebibe bioka, naye ngotworokereriore intwe? Bakamosokia isiko. 35 Yesu akaigwa ng'a bamosokirie isiko; akamorora, akabora, Aye kwegenire Omwana o Nyasaye? 36 Nere akairaneria, akabora, Ning'o Omonene, nyare komwegena? 37 Yesu akamotebia, Kwamororire naende nere ogokwana naye nere oyio. 38 Akabora, Nanchire Omonene; akamosasima. 39 Yesu akabora, Inche nachire ense eye as'ekina, erinde abatari korora barore; nabarabwo abakorora babe emeuko. 40 Ensemo y'Abafarisai abarenge amo nere bakaigwa aya, bakamotebia, Inee naintwe iga tore emeuko? 41 Yesu akabatebia, Onye mwarenge emeuko, anga timori nebibe: korende bono iga mogoteba, Nkororatore: gaki ebibe biaino biaikaransire.
1 Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie, Oyotasoeti as'egesieri ki'obueri bwe ching'ondi, korende arinere aande, oyio nomoibi naende nomouri. 2 Oyogosoa as'egesieri nomorisia bwe ching'ondi. 3 Omorendi iga akomoigorera oyo; neching'ondi iga chikomoigwa eriogi riaye: nere igagochirangeria ching'ondi chiaye as'amarieta abo, igagochiira isiko. 4 Gagochirusia isiko ching'ondi echire echiaye, igagochitang'ana; neching'ondi iga chikomotunyana: naki chiarimanyire eriogi riaye. 5 Omogeni tichikomotunyana nonya ng'ake, korende iga chiramotame; ekiagera tichirimanyeti eriogi ri'abageni. 6 Omoreng'anio oyo Yesu akabatebia; korende barabwo tibayamanyete amang'ana ayio abatebetie. 7 Erio Yesu akabatebia naende, Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie, Ninche egesieri gie ching'ondi. 8 Bonsi abantang'anerete nabaibi, nabauri: korende ching'ondi tichiabaigwete. 9 Ninche nde egesieri: omonto gagosoa as'inche, nakonyeke, nasoe, nasoke, nanyore oborisia, 10 Omoibi tagocha, tatiga aibe, anyenye, asarie; inche iga nachete babe nobogima, nababe naborobwo obonge. 11 Inche ninche omorisia omuya: omorisia omuya igakobeka obogima bwaye as'engecho ye ching'ondi. 12 Omonto orikire, naende tari ere omorisia, ekiagera ching'ondi tichiri chiaye, gakoyerora esese y'orosana egocha, ochitiga ching'ondi, otama: nesese y'orosana yachisakora, na gochiserebania. 13 Ere igagotama ekiagera nomonto orikire, gose tarengerereti amang'ana e ching'ondi. 14 Inche ninche omorisia omuya; nechire chiane nachimanyire, nechire chiane chiamanyire, 15 buna Tata amanyete, nainche namomanyire Tata; nobogima bwane nabobekire as'engecho ye ching'ondi. 16 Naende ching'ondi chinde mbwate, chitari chie riicho eri; nachirochio nabo engwenerete gochireta, neriogi riane nachirigwe; nachibe riicho erimo nomorisia oyomo. 17 As'ayio Tata nanyanchete, ekiagera nabekire obogima bwane, erinde inyare kobobogoria naende. 18 Tari omonto okonduseria, korende ninche nabobekire omonyene. Ninde nokobua kobobeka naende ninde nokobua kobobogoria naende. Ogochika oko iga nakonyorire ase Tata one, 19 Erio gokaba naende ogwatananeka as'Abayahudi, as'engecho y'amang'ana aya. 20 Abange babo bakabora, Nare nekerecha, naende nebarimo; naseki mokomoigwa? 21 Abande bakabora, Amang'ana aya tari ay'omento omonyene ekerecha. Inee! ekerecha nakenyare koyaramokia amaiso emeuko? 22 Ndiarenge rituko rinene ri'ogosibigwa aria Yerusalemu; nekero ki'obokendu. 23 Na Yesu igarenge gotara hekalu ime, as'egora ya Sulemani. 24 Erio Abayahudi bakamoetanana, bakamotebia, Ngoika ririri oratoichanerie emioyo yaito? Onye naye Kristo, totebie maiso marore. 25 Yesu akabairaneria, Nabatebirie, nainwe timori gwancha: emeremo eye ngokora as'erieta ria Tata one, nero ekombera kirori. 26 Korende inwe timori gwancha ekiagera timori ase ching'ondi chiane. 27 ching'ondi chiane iga chikorigwa eriogi riane, nainche nachimanyire, nachirochio iga chigontunya: 28 nainche nachieire obogima bwa kare nakare; na chirochio tichigosira nonya ng'ake, nonya nomonto tagochitaboria korwa as'okoboko kwane. 29 Tata one oching'eire nomonene kobua bonsi; nonde takonyara gochitaboria korwa as'okoboko kwa Tata. 30 Inche na Tata nobomo. 31 Erio Abayahudi bagachora amagena naende, erinde bamoake. 32 Yesu akabairaneria, Emeremo emiya emenge naborokirie eruete ase Tata; as'emeremo eyio nereri mokong'akera amagena? 33 Abayahudi bakamoiraneria bakabora, As'emeremo emiya titogokoakera amagena, korende nas'okorama; ekiagera aye, ore omonto, ogwekora omonyene ng'a naye Nyasaye. 34 Yesu akabairaneria, Tarikiri as'amachiko aino, ng'a inche natebete, Inwe iga more chinyasaye? 35 Onye obarogete baria chinyasaye abacheretwe nering'ana ria Nyasaye (namariko takonyara gosareka), 36 Inee! iga mogoteba asare, ere Tata asibetie akamotoma as'ense, Nkoramare: ekiagera nateba, Inche n'Omwana o Nyasaye? 37 Onye tindi koyekora emeremo ya Tata one timonyancha. 38 Korende kondayekore, nonya timonyancheti inche, yianche eria emeremo; monyare komanya nagwancha ng'a Tata igare ime yane, nainche ime ase Tata, 39 Bakarigia eria kabere komobwata: akarua as'amaboko abo. 40 Akagenda naende ng'umbu ya Yorodan goika aas'aria Yohana are kobatisera ritang'ani; agaikaransa agwo. 41 Abanto abange bakamochiera, bakabora, Yohana takorete egekone kende gionsi: korende onsi ayatebete Yohana as'omonto oyo igare ay'ekeene, 42 Abange bakamwancha agwo.
1 Nabo omonto gete narenge omorwaire, erieta riaye Lazaro o Bethania, omonto bw'omochie o Mariamu na Maritha mosubati omwabo. 2 Nere Mariamu oria omoagete Omonene amaguta, nakamotinyia amagoro aye as'etukia yaye, naki momura omwabo Lazaro igarenge omorwaire. 3 Nabo baria basubati bamwabo bagatoma omotomwa asare, bakobora, Omonene, ere oyobwanchete orwarire. 4 Yesu agachia koigwa, akabora, Oborwaire obwo tari obw'amakweri, korende nas'obonene bwaye Nyasaye, erinde Omwana o Nyasaye abakwe as'obwo. 5 Nere Yesu igamwanchete Maritha, na mosubati omwabo, na Lazaro. 6 Erio agachia koigwa ng'a nomorwaire, agaikaransa amatuko abere aas'aria arenge. 7 Erio nyuma as'aya akabatebia aborokigwa baye, Togende Boyahudi naende. 8 Baria aborokigwa bakamotebia, Rabii, moisonde Abayahudi iga barenge korigia gokoaka amagena: naye nkogendore aroro naende? 9 Yesu akairaneria, chinsa chi'omobaso tichiri ikomi naibere? Omonto karagende 'mobaso tari kogochwa, ekiagera ayoroche omobaso bw'ense eye. 10 Korende omonto karagende botuko, igakogochwa, ekiagera omobaso tori ime yaye. 11 Akayakwana aya: erio nyuma as'aya akabatebia, Lazaro omosani oito orarire; korende nkogendande inyare komotura. 12 Baria aborokigwa baye bakamotebia, Omonene, onye orarire nagwene. 13 Korende Yesu igakwanete amang'ana amakweri aye: nabarabwo bagakaga ng'a iga agokwana amang'ana okorara chitoro. 14 Erio agwo Yesu akabatebia maiso marore, Lazaro okure. 15 Nainche nagokire as'engecho yaino ekiagera ntarenge aroro, erinde monyare gwancha; korende togende asare, 16 Nabo Thomas, okorokwa Didumo akabatebia aborokigwa bamwabo, Togende naintwe, tokwe amo nere. 17 Erio agachia goika Yesu, akamonyora otiekire koba embera amatuko ane. 18 Bethania iga yarenge ang'e na Yerusalemu, orogendo rwe chimaili ibere; 19 nabanto abange as'Abayahudi bagacha ase Maritha na Mariamu, erinde babaremie as'engecho y'oyomwabo. 20 Nabo Maritha agachia koigwa ng'a Yesu ochire, akagenda komorotota: korende Mariamu igaikaransete nyomba ime. 21 Erio Maritha akamotebia Yesu, Omonene onye naa kwarenge, momura ominto anga takwete. 22 Korende nonya mbono namanyire, ng'a kende gionsi oramosabe Nyasaye, Nyasaye nakoe. 23 Yesu akamotebia, Oyomino naboke naende. 24 Maritha akamotebia, Namanyire ng'a naboke as'okobokigwa kwe rituko ri'omoerio. 25 Yesu akamotebia, Inche nokobokigwa nobogima: oyonyanchire inche, nonya ogokwa, nanyare koba moyo. 26 Naendeker'oyore moyo nakonyancha inche tagokwa nonya ng'ake. Inee! gwanchire aya? 27 Akamotebia, Ee, Omonene: Inche nanchire ng'a aye naye Kristo, Omwana o Nyasaye, oria ogocha ense. 28 Naende gakwanire aya, akagenda, akamorangeria mosubati omwabo, Mariamu, bobisi, akabora, Omworokia ochire, ngokorangeriare. 29 Nere agachia koigwa, akaimoka bwango, akamochiera. 30 (Na Yesu konya taraika omochie ime, korende igarenge aria aria aase riaumeranete na Maritha.) 31 Erio baria Abayahudi barenge amo nere nyomba ime, abakomoremia, bagachia komorora Mariamu buna aimoka bwango nagosoka, bakamotunyana, bagakaga ng'a igakogenda oboina erinde arere aroro. 32 Erio Mariamu, agachia goika aria aas'arenge Yesu, akamorora, akagwa as'amagoro aye, akamotebia, Omonene, onye naa kwarenge, anga oyominto takwete. 33 Erio Yesu agachia komorora okorera, nabaria Abayahudi bachete amo nere bakorera, agasogwa nobororo as'omoyo oye, agaichana. 34 Akabora, ng'ai mwamobekire? Bakamotebia, Omonene, nchuo orore. 35 Yesu akaiyeria amariga. 36 Erio Abayahudi bakabora, Rora buna amwanchete! 37 Korende abande bakabora, Inee! oyoyaramogetie amaiso oria omouko, tanyarete komogwenia oyo takwa? 38 Nabo Yesu oichanete naende as'omoyo oye, agaika oboina. Naborobwo iga bwarenge rikuruma, naende rigena ndiabegetwe igoro yaye. 39 Yesu akabora, Ritigerie rigena. Maritha, mosubati omwabo, oria okwete, akamotebia, Omonene, otiokire bono: naki obaire egetondo amatuko ane. 40 Yesu akamotebia, Tingotebeti ng'a koranche noborore obonene bwa Nyasaye? 41 Nabo bakarirusia riria rigena. Yesu akaramokia amaiso aye igoro, akabora, Tata, nakoiraneirie ng'a mbuya mono ekiagera okong'igwa. 42 Nainche namanyete ng'a iga okong'igwa amatuko onsi: korende as'engecho y'omoganda oyo oetanaine, ngakwana aya, banyare gwancha ng'a naye gwantomete. 43 Erio gakwanire iga, akaaka eriogi rinene, Lazaro, soka isiko. 44 Agasoka oria okwete, oboirie egetambaa amagoro namaboko; obosio bwaye boboirie egetambaa. Yesu akabatebia, Mosansore, momotige agende. 45 Nabo abange as'Abayahudi abachete ase Mariamu nakoyarora ayakorete Yesu, bakamwancha. 46 Korende abande babo bakagenda as'Abafarisai, bakabatebia ayakora Yesu. 47 Abakuani abanene n'Abafarisai bagasangerereka ritongo, bakabora, Ninki togokora, naki omonto oyo agokora ebikone ebinge. 48 Gatoramotige iga, abanto bonsi nabamwanche; n'Abarumi nabache, nabarusie aase aito negesaku giaito. 49 Omonto oyomo asebare, Kaifa, oyorenge omokuani omonene omwaka oria, akabatebia, Inwe timomanyeti kende gionsi. 50 Gose timorengerereti ng'a negwenerete omonto oyomo akwe as'engecho y'abanto aba, ng'a egesaku tigesira ekegima. 51 Naende eri takwanete as'omoyo oye omonyene, korende ekiagera arenge omokuani omonene omwaka oria, akabana ng'a Yesu nakwe as'engecho y'egesaku keria; 52 gose tari as'engecho y'egesaku keria gioka, korende amo naya abasangererie abana ba Nyasaye abatananekire babe abamo. 53 Nabo korwa rituko riria bagakora ekina banyare komoita. 54 Yesu tatarete naende ase maiso marore as'egati y'Abayahudi, korende akarua aria akagenda aase ang'e neroro, goika omochie okorokwa Efuraim; agaikaransa aroro amo naborokigwa baye. 55 Naende epasaka y'Abayahudi iga yarenge ang'e: abange bagatira korwa chinse chionsi kogenda Yerusalemu ritang'ani as'epasaka, erinde besibie. 56 Nabo bakamorigia Yesu, bagatebania barabwo ase barabwo, bagotenena ase hekalu, Naki moroche? Tagocha nonya ng'ake ase rituko eri? 57 Bono abakuani n'Abafarisai bakarua ogochika ng'a omonto karamomanye aas'are, arete amang'ana, banyare komobwata.
1 Nabo Yesu amatuko atano narimo ritang'ani ri'epasaka agaika Bethania, agwo aas'arenge Lazaro, oria okwete obogetigwe nere. 2 Bakamokorera endagera aria: Maritha akamokorera; korende Lazaro igarenge oyomo ase baria baikaransete as'endagera amo nere. 3 Erio Mariamu akabogoria ekerengo ki'eratili eyemo y'amanukato, aye rigori rinene, akamoaka Yesu amagoro, akayatinyia amagoro aye netukia yaye: enyomba egaichora rimisu ri 'amaguta aria. 4 Korende Yudas Omoisikariota omwana o Simon, oyomo bw'aborokigwa baye, oyoramorue, akabora, 5 Naki amaguta aya atagorua chidinari chimia isato, nakoegwa abataka? 6 Iga akwanete aya, tari ng'a igarengereria abataka; korende nekiagera arenge omoibi, naende obwate esanduku ye chishilingi, nagochirusia echiabekire aroro. 7 Erio Yesu agateba, Motige agache aya ase rituko ri'ogotindekwa kwane, 8 Naki abataka more nabarabwo amatuko onsi amo nainwe; korende timori nainche amatuko onsi, 9 Nabo omoganda omonene bw'Abayahudi bakamanya ng'a ere nao are aria: bagacha, tari as'engecho yaye Yesu yoka, korende bamorore Lazaro, ekiagera amobogetie korwa as'ogokwa: 10 Abakuani abanene bagakora ekina bamoite Lazaro nere; 11 naki as'engecho yaye abange b'Abayahudi bakagenda, bakamwancha Yesu. 12 Rituko ria kabere abanto abange abaricherete rituko rinene, kobachia koigwa ng'a Yesu ngochare Yerusalemu, 13 bakabogoria chinsagia chi'amakendo bagasoka isiko kogenda komorotota, bakaaka eriogi, Hosana: Osesenigwe oyochire as'erieta ri'Omonene, omoruoti o Isiraeli. 14 Yesu akanyora emori y'etigeri akayerina; buna yarigetwe, 15 Toiroka, enyaroka ya Zayoni: rigereria, Omoruoti oo ochichire igaikaransete igoro as'emori y'etigere. 16 Amang'ana aya aborokigwa baye tibainyora agwo ritang'ani; korende Yesu agachia kobakwa, erio bakainyora ng'a narikeire aya naende ng'a mbamokorerete aya. 17 Nabo bakamoorokia omoganda abarenge amo nere ekero amorangeretie Lazaro korwa as'oboina ime nakomobokia. 18 As'engecho eyio omoganda okagenda komorotota, naki baigure ng'a okorire egekone eke. 19 Erio Abafarisai bagatebania barabwo ase barabwo, Mwarorire ng'a timokonyara gokora gento; ense yagendire komotunyana ere. 20 Naende mbarenge Abayunani batai bake ase barabwo abanto abatirete kogenda gosasima as'ekero kie rituko rinene; 21 barabwo abwo bakamogendera Filipo o Bethisaida o Galili, bakamoboria, bakobora, Omonene, ntorigetie komorora Yesu. 22 Filipo akagenda, akamotebia Anderea: erio Anderea na Filipo bakamotebia Yesu. 23 Yesu akairaneria, akabora, Ensa yaikire, abakwe Omwana-o-mwanyabanto. 24 Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie, Euyeke y'engano etagweti as'ense ekwe iga egoikaransa ero yoka; korende kerakwej iga ekwama okwama okonge. 25 Oyoranche obogima bwaye nabosirie; oyorabogeche obogima bwaye as'ense eye nabogache goika obogima bwa kare nakare. 26 Omonto karankorere, antunyane; inche asende, nao nomosomba one aranyare koba; naende omonto karankorere, Tata namosike. 27 Bono omoyo one oichanire; ninki ngokwana? Tata, onkonye nensa eye. Korende as'engecho y'ayio nayeikeire ensa eye. 28 Tata, oribake erieta riao, erio rigacha eriogi korwa igoro, rigoteba, Naribakire, nainche nandibake naende. 29 Nabo abanto batenenete ang'e bakaigwa, bakabora, ng'a kwabaire okogukura: abande bakabora, Rilaika rigokwana nere. 30 Yesu akairaneria, akabora, Eriogi eri tiribeti as'engecho yane, korende as'engecho yaino. 31 Bono ekina gi'ense eye nkere: bono omonene bw'ense eye natugutwe isiko. 32 Nainche kondaimokererigwe igoro as'ense, nimbang'use bonsi asende. 33 Agakwana aya, erinde aorokie amakweri ki aranyare gokwa. 34 Erio omoganda okameiraneria, Twaigure as'amachiko ng'a Kristo iga akobao goika kare nakare: naye naki okobora ng'a nemogwenerete Omwana-o-mwanyabanto aimokererigwe igoro? Oyo Omwana-o-mwanyabanto nere ng'o? 35 Yesu akabatebia, Omobaso igore amo nainwe ekero egeke. Genda ekero more noria omobaso, omusunte tocha kobabua: nere oyokogenda omosunte ime tamanyeti aas'akogenda. 36 Ekero more nomobaso, yuanche omobaso, monyare koba abana b'omobaso. Ayio akwanete Yesu, akagenda akebisa nabarabwo. 37 Nonya okorete ebikone ebinge as'amasio abo, tibamwanchete: 38 erinde riikeranigwe ring'ana riria ri'omobani Isaya aritebete, Omonene, ning'o oyanchire amang'ana aito? Naende okoboko kw'Omonene kwamanoirwe nang'o? 39 Naki as'engecho eye tibanyara gwancha, naki Isaya atebete naende, 40 Obaukoirie amaiso, okorire chinkoro chiabo chinkong'u; Tibacha korora as'amaiso abo nakomanya ase chinkoro chiabo, Beenchore, Mbagwenie. 41 Amang'ana ayio akwanete Isaya ekiagera akarora obonene bwaye; agatora amang'ana aye. 42 Korende nonya nabo as'abanene abange bakamwancha; korende ekiagera as'engecho y'Abafarisai tibaorogetie, tibacha korusigwa as'esunagogi: 43 naki mbabwanchete obonene bw'abanto kobua obonene bwa Nyasaye. 44 Yesu akaaka eriogi akabora, Oyonyanchire inche, tanyancheti inche, korende noyontomete. 45 Nere oyondigereirie inche, omorigereirie ere oyontomete. 46 Inche nachire imbe omobaso as'ense, erinde ker'oyonyanchire, taikaransa omosunte ime. 47 Naende omonto karaigwe amang'ana ane, ko tayabwata, inche tinkomogambia: ekiagera tincheti kogambia ense, korende nyekonye ense. 48 Oyoranyange inche otancheti amang'ana ane, nare noyoramogambie: ring'ana riria nakwanete, nario riranyare komogambia rituko ri'omoerio. 49 Naki inche tinkwaneti ase inche bweka omonyene; korende nere ontomete, engecho yaye Tata, onchikire aya ngoteba naende ayst ngokwana. 50 Nainche namanyire ng'a ogochika kwaye nobogima bwa kare nakare: nabo aya ngokwana inche buna Tata antebetie, nabo ngokwana.
1 Goika ritang'ani rie rituko rinene ri'epasaka, Yesu akamanya ng'a ensa yaye yaikire akorua as'ense eye kogenda ase Tata, akaba akabancha abanto baye as'ense, akabancha goika omoerio. 2 Ekero ki'endagera, Saitani gatiekire komobeka Yudas omwana o Simon Omoisikariota, omoyo bw'okomorua, 3 Yesu akamanya ng'a Tata omoeire bionsi amaboko aye, naende ng'a igaruete ase Nyasaye, naende nkogendare ase Nyasaye, 4 akaimoka korwa as'endagera, akabeka ensemo chianga chiaye; akabogoria egetambaa, akeboyia. 5 Erio akabeka amache as'esani 3 agachaka kobasibia aborokigwa amagoro abo, nakoyatinyia na keria egetambaa keria eboeretie. 6 Naboagaika ase Simon Petero. Oyo akamotebia, Omonene! Aye ngonsibiore amagoro ane? 7 Yesu akairaneria, akamotebia, Ayangokora inche, tokoyamanya bono; korende noyamanye nyuma. 8 Petero akamotebia, Togonsibia amagoro ane nonya ng'ake. Yesu akamotebia, Ntagosibeti, tori nensemo amo nainche. 9 Simon Petero akamotebia, Omonene tari amagoro ane oka, korende nonya namaboko nomotwe one. 10 Yesu akamotebia, Oyotiekire gwesibia tari nokorigia tatiga ogwesibia amagoro, korende obaire omochenu omobere bwonsi; nainwe more abachenu, korende tai mwensi. 11 Naki amomanyete oyogocha komorua, as'ayio agareba, Timori abachenu imwensi. 12 Nabo ochia gokora kobasibia amagoro abo, nagochibogoria chianga chiaye, nagoikaransa naende, akabatebia. Mwamanyire eki nabakorera? 13. Inwe iga mokondoka Omworokia, naende Omonene: naende inwe mbuya mokobora; naki naboigo inde. 14 Nabo onye inche, inde Omonene naende Omworokia, nabasibirie amagoro aino, nebagwenerete inwe nainwe gosibania dmagoro. 15 Naki nabaire ekiorokererio erinde ayio nabakorera inwe, nainwe moyakore. 16 Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie, Omosomba tari omonene kobua omonene oyej gose omotomwa tari omonene kobua ere oyomotomete. 17 Korhorayamanye ayio, more negesio komorayakore. 18 Tindi gokwana asemore imwensi: nabamanyire aba nachorire: erinde okorika konyare goikeranigwa, Oyokoria omogati amo nainche oimokereiri egetingiro kiaye igoro asende. 19 Korwa bono nabatebirie ritang'ani ataraoroka, erinde gakooroka, monyare gwancha ng'a inche nere. 20 Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie, Ere oyokomwancha onde bwonsi oyo ngotoma, onyanchire inche; nere oyokonyancha inche omwanchire ere oyontomete. 21 Agachia gokora gokwana aya, Yesu agaichana as'omoyo oye, akaoiokia, agakwana, Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie, Oyomo oino nandue. 22 Aborokigwa bakarigererania, bagasinywa komanya gose ning'o atora. 23 Narenge aroro oyomo bw'aborokigwa baye, oyobweegegete Yesu egekuba kiaye, oyo Yesu anchete. 24 Nabo Simon Petero akamosima, akamoboria, Totebie ning'o atora? 25 Ere akamweegeka buna arenge as'egekuba kia Yesu, akamoboria Omonene ning'o? 26 Erio Yesu akairaneria, Nomonto oria ngotongereria egesamunye nakomoa. Akamotongereria egesamunye akamoa Yudas, omwana o Simon Omoisikariota. 27 Naende nyuma ase keria egesamunye Saitani akamosoa. Erio Yesu akamotebia, Ayogokora, yakore bwango. 28 Tarenge omonto ase baria baikaransete as'emesa oyemanyete engecho yagera amotebia iga. 29 Naki abande, ekiagera Yudas are koyebogoria esanduku, bagakaga ng'a Yesu igakomotebia, Gora ebitorigetie ase rituko rinene; gose ng'a abae abataka egento. 30 Nabo oyo, kanyorire keria egesamunye, agasoka bwango: naende iga bwarenge botuko. 31 Erio oyio gasokire, Yesu akabora, Bono obakirwe Omwana-o-mwanyabanto, naende Nyasaye obakirwe ime yaye. 32 Na Nyasaye namobake ime yaye omonyene, nerio kegima namobake. 33 Abana abake, nkere ekero egeke inde amo nainwe. Namondigie: naende buna nabatebetie Abayahudi, Ng'a aase ngochia inche, inwe timokonyara gocha; bono nabatebirie nainwe. 34 Ogochika okoyia nabaire, mwanchane; buna nabanchete inwe, nainwe mwanchane boigo. 35 Iga abanto bonsi nabamanye ng'a naborokigwa bane more, komorabe nobwanchani inwe as'inwe. 36 Simon Petero akamotebia, Omonene, ng'ai okogenda? Yesu akamoiraneria, Aase ngochia, tokonyara gontunya, bono, korende nontunye nyuma. 37 Petero akamotebia, Omonene, naseki ntanyare gogotunyana bono? Nimbobeke obogima bwane as'engecho yao. 38 Yesu akamoiraneria, Inee! obogima bwao nobobeke as'engecho yane? Ekeene, ekeene, nagotebirie, etuoni tekogweya goika gwankanire ara gatato.
1 Timoichana emioyo yaino: mwanche ase Nyasaye mwanche n'asende. 2 As'enyomba ya Tata nere nobomenyo obonge; onye taibo, anga nabatebia; nkogendande kobaroseria aase. 3 Kondagende kobaroseria aase, ninchiche naende, nimbaroisie asende; erinde asende inche, nainwe mobeo. 4 Naende aase nkogenda inche, mwayemanyire enchera. 5 Thomas akamotebia, Omonene, titomanyeti aas'ogochia, naki torayemanye enchera? 6 Yesu akamotebia, Ninche inde enchera, naende ekeene, naende obogima: omonto onde tagocha ase Tata tatiga asende. 7 Onye mwamanyete inche, ang'a mwamomanyete naende Tata: korwa bono mwamomanyire, naende mwamororire. 8 Filipo akamotebia, Omonene, tworokie Tata, atoisane. 9 Yesu akamotebia, Nabaire amo nainwe amatuko aya onsi naye tomanyeti, Filipo? Oyondorire inche, omororire Tata; naki ogoteba aye, Tworokie Tata? 10 Tibwancheti ng'a inche igonde ime ase Tata, na Tata ime yane? Amang'ana nkobatebia inche, tindi gokwana inche bweka: korende Tata ore ime asende iga akoyekora emeremo yaye. 11 Inyancha ng'a inche igande ase Tata, naende Tata ime yane: gose nabo inyancha ekiagera as'emeremo emenyene. 12 Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie, Oyoranyanche inche, emeremo ngokora inche nere nayekore; nakore naende emenene kobua eye, ekiagera nkogendande ase Tata. 13 Naende komorasabe kende gionsi as'erieta riane, ekio nangekore, Tata abakwe ime as'Omwana. 14 Komorasabe kende gionsi as'erieta riane, ekio nangekore, 15 Komoranyanche namoyabwate amachiko ane. 16 Naende inche nimosabe Tata, nere nabae Omokonyi onde, aikaranse nainwe goika kare nakare, 17 Omoika bw'ekeene; ense etanyare komwancha; naki tibamorochi, nonya nkomomanya korende inwe mwamomanyire; naki aikaransete asemore, nere nabe ime yaino. 18 Tinkobatiga inwe chintakana; ninchiche asemore. 19 Nkere ekero egeke ense etandore naende; korende inwe mwandorire, ekiagera inche moy'onde, nainwe namobe moyo. 20 Ase rituko riria namomanye, ng'a inche igande ime ase Tata, naende nainwe ime yane, nainche ime yaino. 21 Oyore namachiko ane, nakoyabwata, ere nere onyanchete: nere oyonyanchete nanchwe na Tata one, nainche, nimwanche, nakweorokia asare. 22 Yudas akamotebia (tari ere Omoisikariota), Omonene, naki yaba, ng'a origetie kweorokia asetore, gose tari as'ense? 23 Yesu akamoiraneria akamotebia, Omonto karanyanche, naribwate ring'ana riane; naende Tata one namwanche, naintwe natoche asare, natokore obomenyo bwaito asare. 24 Oyotanyancheti, tayabwateti amang'ana ane: naende ring'ana mwaigure tari eriane korende neriaye Tata ontomete. 25 Aya nabatebirie, kong'ikaransete asemore. 26 Korende Omokonyi Omoika Omochenu, oyo Tata aratome as'erieta riane, ere naborokererie onsi, naende kobainyoria onsi ayanabatebirie. 27 Omorembe nabatigeire: omorembe one nabaruereire: tari buna ense ekorua, nabaruereire. Timoichana emioyo yaino gose timoba nobwoba. 28 Mwaigure ng'a inche nabatebetie, Nkogendande, naende ngochande asemore. Onye mwanyanchete, anga mwagogete, ekiagera nkogendande ase Tata naki Tata nomonene kobua inche. 29 Na bono nabatebirie ritang'ani ataraba, erinde akoba mwanche. 30 Tingokwana nainwe amang'ana amange naende, naki omonene bw'ense ochire: korende tari nagento asende; 31 korende ense emanye ng'a nimwanchete Tata, naende buna Tata anchigete, nabo ngokora, Imoka, togende aria.
1 Ninche inde omosabibu bw'ekeene, naende Tata one nomoroseria. 2 Ker'orosagia ime asende rotameti, igakororusia: na ker'orokwama arosibia erinde romente kwama. 3 Inwe mwaikire koba abachenu as'engecho ye ring'ana nabatebia. 4 Ikaransa ime yane, nainche ime yaino. Buna orosagia rotanyare kwama rwoka oronyene, rotaikaranseti ime as'omosabibu; naboigo nainwe, motaikaranseti ime yane. 5 Inche nomosabibu; nainwe nechinsagia: Oyogoikaransa ime yane, nainche ime yaye oyio name mono: naki motari nainche timokonyara gokora kende gionsi. 6 Omonto ataikaranseti ime yane, igagotugutwa isiko buna orosagia, bwoma; ochisangereria, ochituguta omorero, chiayia. 7 Komoraikaranse ime yane, namang'ana ane karaikaranse ime yaino, namosabe kera ekimorigeti, naende namokorerwe. 8 As'ayio abakwe Tata one, mwame mono; nainwe namobe aborokigwa bane. 9 Buna Tata anyanchete inche, nainche nabanchire inwe; ikaransa as'obwanchani bwane. 10 Komorayabwate amachiko ane, namoikaranse as'obwanchani bwane; buna inche nabwatete amachiko a Tata one, nagoikaransa as'obwanchani bwaye. 11 Aya nabatebirie, erinde omogoko one obe ime yaino, naende omogoko oino oikeranigwe. 12 Ogochika kwane nakwo oko, mwanchane, buna nabanchete inwe. 13 Tari oyore nobwanchani obonge kobua obo, obw'omonto akobeka obogima as'engecho y'abasani baye. 14 Inwe iga more abasani bane, komorakore aya nabachikire. 15 Tinkobaroka naende abasomba; naki omosomba tamanyeti eki agokora omonene oye: korende inwe nabarokire abasani; naki onsi aya naigure ase Tata naborokirie. 16 Tari inwe mwanchorire inche, korende ninche nabachorire inwe, nababekire mogende mwame, okwama kwaino goikaranse: erinde rionsi mogosaba Tata as'erieta riane, igarabae. 17 Aya nabachikire, monyare gwanchana. 18 Ense kerabageche, mwamanyire ng'a yangechire inche etarabagecha inwe. 19 Onye mwarenge ab'ense, anga ense yancha ayare ayaye; korende ekiagera inwe timori ab'ense, naki inche nabachorire inwe korwa as'ense, ekiagera ense yabagechire. 20 Rinyore riria ring'ana nabatebetie, Omosomba tari omonene kobua Omonene oye. Onye banchandete inche, nababachande inwe nainwe; onye baribwatete ring'ana riane nabaribwate neriaino. 21 Korende aya onsi nababakorere as'engecho y'erieta riane, ekiagera tibamomanyeti oyontomete. 22 Onye machete gokwana nabarabwo, anga tibarenge nebibe: bono tibari nogotamera as'ebibe biabo. 23 Oyongechire inche, omogechire na Tata one. 24 Onye ntakorete emeremo asebare atakoreti omonto onde, anga tibabete nebibe: bono batororire inche na Tata one naende batogechire. 25 Korende riikerane ring'ana eriarigetwe as'ogochika kwabo, Iga bangechete bosa. 26 Korende gagocha Omokonyi, oyondabatomere korwa ase Tata, Omoika bw'ekeene okorua ase Tata, ere nambere kirori. 27 Naende inwe mwensi mwabaire birori, ekiagera korwa omochakano mwarenge amo nainche.
1 Amang'ana aya nabatebirie timocha kogochwa. 2 Nababaserie korwa chisunagogi: nabo, ensa yachire, igarakage ker'omonto karabaite ng'a omokoreire Nyasaye ekeng'wanso. 3 Naende ayio nababakore, naki tibamomanyeti Tata nonya ninche. 4 Korende nabatebirie aya, erinde kegocha ensa eria, moyainyore buna inche nabatebetie. Aya timbatebeti korwa omochakano, ekiagera narenge amo nainwe. 5 Korende bono nkogendande as'ere oyontomete; gose onde tari oyomo oino okomboria, Ing'ai ogochia? 6 Korende ekiagera nabatebirie aya ogoichana gwaichoire emioyo yaino. 7 Korende inche nabatebirie erire ri'ekeene; nebagwenerete inwe inche nyimoke: naki ntaimogeti, Omokonyi tagocha asemore; korende kondagende, nimotome asemore. 8 Naende gatiekire gocha ere, nayekanie ense as'amang'ana ebibe, naende oboronge, naende ekina: 9 as'amang'ana ebibe, ekiagera tibanyancheti inche; 10 as'amang'ana oboronge, ekiagera nkogendande ase Tata, gose timokondora naende. 11 As'amang'ana ekina, ekiagera omonene bw'ense eye ogambigwe. 12 Ninde nayande amange atigarete nkobatebia, korende timokonyara koyaremereria bono. 13 Korende ogocha ere, Omoika bw'ekeene, nobarae as'onsi ayare ay'ekeene; naki tagokwana ayare ayaye ere; korende onsi ayaranyare koigwa nayakwane: naende amang'ana agocha nabatebie engecho yaye. 14 Ere nambake inche: naki nabogorie as'ayare ayane, nabayaorokerie. 15 Onsi ayare naro Tata nayane; as'ayio ngateba ng'a nabogorie as'ayare ayane, nabayaorokerie. 16 Nkere ekero egeke, nainwe timokondora naende; nkere ekero egeke namondore, naki nkogendande ase Tata. 17 Nabo abande b'aborokigwa baye bagatebania, Ring'ana ki eri agoteba, Nkere ekero egeke nainwe timokondora; naende nkere ekero egeke morandore: ekiagera nkogendande ase Tata? 18 Nabo bagateba, Ing'ana ki eri agoteba, ng'a nkere ekero egeke? Titomanyeti eri agokwana. 19 Yesu akamanya ng'a mbarigetie komoboria, akabatebia, Eri nario mokoborania inwe as'inwe, erio natebire, Nkere ekero egeke nainwe timokondora, naende nkere ekero egeke naende morandore? 20 Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie, Inwe namorere, nakweng'ereria, korende ense negoke: inwe namoichanigwe, korende ogoichana kwaino nagoonchoke koba omogoko. 21 Omokungu okogonkia, igare nogoichana ekiagera ensa yaye yaikire; korende gatiekire kogonkia omwana, tari koboinyora naende obororo, ekiagera as'omogoko bw'okoiborwa omonto as'ense. 22 Nabo nainwe bono iga more nogoichana: korende nimbarore naende, nemioyo yaino negoke, nomogoko oino onde tari orabaure. 23 Ase rituko riria timokomboria ring'ana. Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie, Komoramosabe Tata ring'ana as'erieta riane nabae. 24 Goika rero timosabeti ring'ana as'erieta riane; saba, namonyore, omogoko oino obe oikeranete. 25 Aya nayakwanire nainwe as'emereng'anio: ensa neche, tingokwana nainwe naende as'emereng'anio, korende nimborokie maiso marore amang'ana a Tata. 26 Ase rituko riria namosabe as'erieta riane: tinkobatebia, ng'a nimbasabere Tata; 27 naki Tata omonyene iga abanchete inwe, ekiagera inwe mwanyanchire inche, mogancha ng'a inche iga naruete ase Tata. 28 Naruete ase Tata, na bono nachire as'ense: naende, nayetigire ense, nkogendande ase Tata. 29 Aborokigwa baye bakabora, Rora, bono igogokwana maiso marore, gose tori gokwana omoreng'anio onde bwonsi. 30 Bono twamanyire ng'a kwamanyire onsi, torigeti omonto akoborie: as'ayio twanchire ng'a iga kwaruete ase Nyasaye. 31 Yesu akabairaneria, Iga mwanchire bono? 32 Rora, ensa neche, nabo, yatiekire gocha, namwatananeke, ker'oyomo ase mwaye, namontige inche bweka: korende ninche tari inche bweka, ekiagera Tata igare amo nainche. 33 Aya nabatebirie, monyare koba nomorembe ime yane. As'ense namonyore emechando: korende remia emioyo; inche nayebuire ense.
1 Amang'ana ayio ayakwanete Yesu; akaramokia amaiso aye korigereria igoro, akabora, Tata, ensa eria yachire; mobake Omwana oo, erinde Omwana nere akobake aye: 2 buna kwamoete okobua igoro ase ker'oyore nomobere, erinde onsi aya kwamoeire, abae obogima bwa kare nakare. 3 Nobogima bwa kare nakare nobo, bakomanye aye, Nyasaye bw'ekeene bweka, naende Yesu Kristo kwamotomete. 4 Inche nakobakire as'ense, emeremo eria kwang'ete gokora nayekorire. 5 Na bono Tata, ombake inche amo naye, as'obonene boria narenge nabwo amo naye ritang'ani ense etaraba. 6 Erieta riao nabaorokeirie abanto baria kwang'ete korwa as'ense: iga barenge abao, okabang'a inche; naende ring'ana riao baribwatire. 7 Bono bamanyire ng'a onsi aya kwang'ete igarure asore: 8 naki amang'ana kwang'ete nabaeire barabwo; bakayabwata, bakamanya ekeene ng'a iga narure asore, bagancha ng'a naye gwantomete. 9 Inche nabasabeire barabwo: tindi koyesabera ense, korende barabwo aba kwang'aire; naki barabwo nabao: 10 naende onsi ayare ayane nayao, nayare ayao nayane: nainche nabakirwe ime yabo. 11 Nainche tindi naende as'ense ime, ko aba mbare as'ense ime, nainche ngochande asore. Tata Omochenu obarende as'erieta riao baria kwang'ete, babe obomo, buna intwe. 12 Ekero narenge amo nabarabwo as'ense, iga nare kobarenda as'erieta riao baria kwang'ete: iga nabaritete, gose nonya noyomo obo tari oyosirire, tatiga oria omwana bw'ogosira: amariko anyare goikeranigwa. 13 Na bono ngochande asore; naya nayakwanire as'ense ime, erinde babe nomogoko one oikeranigwe ime yabo. 14 Inche nabaeire ring'ana riao; nense yabagechete, ekiagera barabwo tari abanto b'ense, buna ninche ntari oyo bw'ense. 15 Tinsabeti obarusie korwa as'ense, korende obarende noria omobe. 16 Barabwo tari ab'ense, buna ninche ntari oyo bw'ense. 17 Obasibie as'ekeene: ring'ana riao nario ekeene. 18 Buna gwantomete inche ime as'ense, nainche naboigo nabatomire barabwo as'ense ime. 19 Nas'engecho yabo nesibirie, erinde nabarabwo basibigwe as'ekeene. 20 Gose tari barabwo boka nasabeire, korende nabarabwo abaranyare gwancha as'engecho ye ring'ana riabo; 21 bonsi babe obomo; buna aye, Tata, ore ime asende, nainche ime yao, erinde naba babe obomo ime yaito; ense enyare gwancha ng'a naye gwantomete. 22 Nobonene boria kwang'ete nabaeire barabwo; babe obomo, buna intwe tore obomo; 23 Inche ime yabo, naye ime yane, banyare goikerana babe obomo; erinde ense emanye ng'a naye gwantomete, okabancha barabwo, buna kwanyanchete inche. 24 Tata, abwo aba kwang'ete, nindigetie babe amo nainche asende; banyare koborigereria obonene bwane kwang'ete: naki nkwanyanchete ritang'ani okobekwa oboroso bw'ense. 25 Tata omonyene oboronge, ense tiyakomanyete, korende inche nakomanyete; naba bamanyire ng'a naye gwantomete; 26 nabaorokeirie erieta riao, naende nimboorokie; erinde obwanchani boria kwanyanchete inche bobe ime yabo, nainche imbe ime yabo.
1 Yesu gakwanire amang'ana aya, akaimoka naborokigwa baye kogenda ng'umbu y'akaroche Kedron, aas'omogondo orenge, agasoa, ere naborokigwa baye. 2 Yudas nere, oria omoruete naamanyete aas'aria: naki Yesu are kogenda aroro ebiro ebinge amo naborokigwa baye. 3 Nabo Yudas gatiekire konyora omoganda bw'abasigari, naende abasomba baruete as'Abakuani abanene, n'Abafarisai, akagenda aroro nechitaya nebieri, nebinto bi'esegi. 4 Nabo Yesu, okomanya onsi ayaranyare komonyora, akaoroka, akabatebia, Ning'o mokorigia? 5 Bakamoiraneria, Yesu Omonazereti. Yesu akabatebia, Ninche ere. Yudas nere oyomoruete igateneine amo nabarabwo. 6 Nabo ochia kobatebia, Ninche ere, bakairana nyuma, bakagwa inse. 7 Akababoria eria kabere, Ning'o mokorigia? Bakabora, Yesu Omonazareti, 8 Yesu akairaneria, natiekire kobatebia ng'a ninche ere: nabo komokondigia inche batige aba bagende: 9 erinde riikeranigwe riria ring'ana akwanete, Aba kwang'ete tinsireti nonya noyomo obo. 10 Nabo Simon Petero narenge nomoro, akayong'usa, akamoaka omosomba bw'omokuani omonene, akamonacha ogoto kwaye kw'okorio. Noria omosomba erieta riaye igare korokwa Maliko. 11 Erio Yesu akamotebia Petero, omoro oo yoiranie ekerende kiaye: egekombe ang'aire Tata, tinkenywera? 12 Oria omoganda nomonene bw'esegi, nabaria abasomba b'Abayahudi bakamobwata Yesu, bakamosiba. 13 Bakamoira as'Anna ritang'ani; naki arenge ise biara Kaifa, oria orenge omokuani omonene omwaka oria. 14 Na Kaifa nere obaete Abayahudi amang'ana ng'a negwenerete omonto oyomo akwe as'engecho y'abanto. 15 Simon Petero akamotunyana Yesu nomworokigwa onde. Oria omworokigwa iga amanyekanete nomokuani omonene, agasoa amo na Yesu egora ime y'omokuani omonene; 16 korende Petero agatenena gesieri isiko. Nabo oria omworokigwa onde omanyegete nomokuani omonene, agasoka agakwana nomoiseke ore korenda egesieri, akamoreta Petero ime. 17 Erio oria omoiseke orenge omorendi egesieri akamotebia Petero, Aye naye oyomo obo bw'aborokigwa baye omonto oyo? Ere akabora, tari inche. 18 Na baria abasomba nabasikari iga barenge bateneine, baroisirie omorero bw'amakara; naki embeo yarenge; bakaba ngwotabare omorero; Petero nere, iga arenge amo nabarabwo, ogwota omorero. 19 Erio omokuani omonene akamoboria Yesu amang'ana as'aborokigwa baye, namang'ana okworokereria kwaye. 20 Yesu akamoiraneria, Inche nakwanire nense maiso marore: inche amatuko onsi iga narenge kworokereria ase chisunagogi nase hekalu, aase basangereregete Abayahudi amatuko onsi; gose ase bobisi tintebeti ring'ana. 21 Naseki okomboria? baborie baria baigwete eke nakwanete nabarabwo: barabwo bamanyire aya nabatebetie. 22 Gachia gokwana amang'ana aya, oyomo bwa baria abasomba otenenete ang'e akamoaka Yesu oroe, okobora, Igakomoiraneria iga omokuani omonene? 23 Yesu akamoiraneria: Onye nakwanire amabe, yaorokie aria amabe: korende onye nakwanire amaya, ninki okong'akera? 24 Nabo Anna akamoira osibire ase Kaifa omokuani omonene. 25 Na Simon Petero igarenge oteneine, ogwota omorero. Bakamotebia, Aye naye tori oyomo bw'aborokigwa baye? Ere agakana, akabora, Tari inche. 26 Oyomo bw'abasomba b'omokuani omonene, nomoamate bw'oria onachetwe ogoto na Petero, akabora, Inche tinakoroche ime as'omogondo amo nere? 27 Petero agakana naende; erio kegima etuoni ekagweya. 28 Erio bakamoira Yesu korwa ase Kaifa goika enyomba enene y'ekegambero; ekaba egokiamoka; korende barabwo abanyene tibasoa ime as'ekegambero, tibabaisa gocha kobekwa eubi, korende bayerie epasaka. 29 Erio Pilato akabasokera isiko akabora, Mang'ana ki mwareta as'omonto oyo mokomosoera? 30 Bakairaneria, bakamotebia, Onye oyo atarenge omonto omobe, anga titwamoreta asore. 31 Erio Pilato akabatebia, Moire inwe, momogambie as'ogochika kwaino. Abayahudi bakamotebia, Intwe titori neribaga goita omonto: 32 erinde ring'ana riaye Yesu riikeranigwe, eriakwanete, okoorokia ng'a makweri ki aranyare gokwa. 33 Erio Pilato agasoa ekegambero naende akamorangeria Yesu akamotebia, Aye naye omoruoti bw'Abayahudi? 34 Yesu akairaneria, Naye gwatebire omonyene, gose nabanto bande bagotebirie amang'ana ane? 35 Pilato akairaneria, Inee? Inche n'Omoyahudi? Egesaku kiao nabakuani abanene nabwo bakoreta asende: Ninki gwakorire? 36 Yesu akairaneria, Oboruoti bwane tibori obw'ense eye: onye oboruoti bwane bwarenge as'ense eye anga abasomba bane mbandwanerera, tinyara kobekwa as'amaboko Abayahudi: korende bono oboruoti bwane tibori obwaa. 37 Erio Pilato akamotebia, Aye nomoruoti rende? Yesu akairaneria, Aye kwaborire ng'a inche nomoruoti. Inche iga naiboretwe as'engecho y'aya, nas'engecho y'aya ngacha as'ense, erinde mbe kirori as'ekeene. Ker'oyore oyo bw'ekeene igakorigwa eriogi riane. 38 Pilato akamoboria, Ekeene ngento ki? Gakwanire ring'ana eri akabasokera Abayahudi eria kabere, akabatebia, Inche tindochi bobe bonde asare. 39 Korende more nengecho, erinde mbasiborere omonto oyomo as'ekero ki'epasaka; nabo, morigetie mbasiborere Omoruoti bw'Abayahudi? 40 Erio bakaaka egeturi eria kabere, bakabora, Tari oyo, korende Baraba. Nere Baraba igarenge omouri.
1 Erio Pilato akamoira Yesu, akamoaka chinkini. 2 Abasigari bagatwang'a egutwa y'amagwa, bakamobekera 'motwe, bakamobeka eanga embariri; 3 bakamochiera, bakabora, Mbuya ore Omoruoti bw'Abayahudi! bakamoaka chindoe. 4 Pilato akaoroka naende isiko akabatebia, Rora, inche namoretire asemore, monyare komanya ng'a tindochi bobe bonde asare. 5 Erio Yesu agasoka isiko, obegete egutwa eria y'amagwa, neria eanga y'oboruoti embariri. Pilato akabatebia, Rora, Omonto oyo! 6 Erio baria abakuani abanene naende abasomba bagachia komorora, bakaaka eriogi, bakobora, Mobambe, mobambe, Pilato akabatebia, moire inwe, momobambe; naki inche tindochi obobe asare. 7 Abayahudi bakamoiraneria, Intwe ntore nogochika, naende as'ogochika okwo nagwenerete akwe, ekiagera agwekora koba Omwana o Nyasaye. 8 Erio Pilato agachia koigwa ring'ana erio, akaba nobwoba kobua; 9 agasoa as'ekegambero, akamotebia Yesu naende, Ing'ai okorua aye? Korende Yesu tamoa okoiraneria konde. 10 Erio Pilato akamotebia, Tori gokwana nainche? Tomanyeti ng'a ninde nokobua gokobamba naende ninde nokobua gogosibora? 11 Yesu akamoiraneria, anga tori nokobua konde gwonsi, onye otaeiri korwa igoro: as'ayio ere oyombegete amaboko ao nare nebibe ebinene kobua. 12 Korwa agwo Pilato akarigia komosibora: korende Abayahudi bakaaka eriogi bakabora, Koramosibore oyo tori omosani o Kaisari: ker'oyogwekora koba omoruoti igare ao na Kaisari. 13 Erio Pilato, ochia koigwa amang'ana aya, akamoreta Yesu isiko, agaikaransa igoro as'ekerogo ki'ekina, aase akorokwa Atichire namagena, naende as'Ekeibirania, Gabbatha. 14 Nigo yarenge Okwerosia kw'epasaka: naende iga yarenge chinsa isano nemo. Akabatebia, Abayahudi, Rora, omoruoti oino! 15 Korende barabwo bakaaka eriogi, Morusie, morusie, mobambe. Pilato akabatebia, Imobambe omoruoti oino? Abakuani abanene bakairaneria, titori nomoruoti tatiga Kaisari. 16 Erio agwo akamobeka amaboko abo abambwe. Nabo bakamobwata Yesu: 17 agasoka bwebogoreretie omosalaba oye, goika Aase akorokwa ekeore, as'Ekeibirania akorokwa Golgotha: 18 bakamobamba aroro, amo nabande babere, oyonde ensemo noyonde ensemo, na Yesu gati gati. 19 Pilato akarika ekemanyererio, agakebeka igoro as'omosalaba. Iga kiarigetwe, Yesu Omonazareti, Omoruoti bw'Abayahudi. 20 Nabo okorika okwo mbasomete abange as'Abayahudi; naki aase aria abamberetwe Yesu igarenge ang'e nomochie; nakorokwo iga kwarigetwe as'Ekeibirania, Ekerumi, n'Ekeyunani. 21 Erio abakuani abanene n'Abayahudi bakamotebia Pilato. Torika, ng'a Omoruoti bw'Abayahudi; korende, ng'a igarenge kobora ng'a, Inche omoruoti bw'Abayahudi. 22 Pilato akairaneria, Aya narikire narikire. 23 Erio abasigari kobamobambire Yesu, bakabogoria chianga chiaye, bagakora chinsemo inye, ase ker'omosigari ensemo yaye; nero eganchwa: naende eganchwa eria tiyasonetwa, iga yakoretwe yonsi korwa igoro. 24 Nabo bagatchania, Titoyetandora, korende toyekorere obomera, torore gose neyang'o ekoba; okorika goikerane gogoteba, Mbatananete chianga chiane, Naende eganchwa yane bayekorerete obomera. Naboigo bakorete abasigari. 25 Korende as'omosalaba oye Yesu bagatenena ng'ina, naende oyomwabo ng'ina, Mariamu o Kiliopa, na Mariamu Magidali. 26 Erio Yesu ochia komorora ng'ina, naende oria omworokigwa anchete otenenete ang'e akamotebia ng'ina, Omokungu, rora, omwana oo! 27 Nyuma akamotebia omworokigwa, Rora, nyoko! Erio korwa ensa eria omworokigwa oria akamoira bwoye. 28 Nyuma as'aya Yesu, akamanya ng'a onsi atiekire gokorwa, okorika goikeranigwe, akabora, Ninde nerang'o. 29 Nkiarenge aroro egento geichire chinkama, erio bakabeka egetonto geichire chinkama, igoro ase husopo, bakamobekera omonwa. 30 Erio Yesu ochia kochinyora chinkama, agateba, yaerire: agatureka omotwe, agatwekamo. 31 Erio Abayahudi, ekiagera n'Okwerosia, emebere teikaransa igoro as'omosalaba rituko ri'esabato (naki rituko ri'esabato eria iga riarenge rituko rinene), bakamosaba Pilato, amagoro abo abunwe, erusigwe. 32 Erio abasigari bakagenda, bakamobuna amagoro oyo bwe ritang'ani, naende oyo okabere oyobambetwe amo nere. 33 Bagachia komochiera Yesu, bachia korora ng'a otiekire gokwa, tibamobuna amagoro; 34 korende omosigari oyomo ne ritimo akamobeta rikere, akarua bwango amanyinga namache. 35 Nere oyoroche akaorokia, naende okoorokia kwaye nekeene, nere omanyire ng'a igagokwana ekeene, erinde inwe monyare gwancha. 36 Naki aya akaoroka okorika goikerane, Tirikonyara kobunwa riuga riaye. 37 Naende, okorika konde iga gokobora, Nabamorigererie ere oyobabetete. 38 Nyuma as'aya, Yusufu bw'Arimathaya, nere igarenge omworokigwa o Yesu, korende bobisi (naki abairogete Abayahudi), akamosaba Pilato ribaga ayorusie omobere oye Yesu: Pilato akamoa ribaga. Erio akagenda akayorusia omobere oye. 39 Akagenda Nikodemo nere, oria omochierete botuko agwo ritang'ani, akareta ebinto bisang'ananirie manemane n'uudi (ebinto bi'ogotioka) oborito bwaye chiratili emia eyemo. 40 Erio bakayobogoria omobere o Yesu bakayoboa egetambaa ki'egatani, amo naria amaguta amanukato, buna yarenge engecho y'Abayahudi as'ogotindeka, 41 Naende aase aria abamberetwe norengeo omogondo; na ime as'omogondo oboina oboyia konya botarabekwa 'monto onde ime yaye. 42 Agwo ekiagera n'Okwerosia kw'Abayahudi, bakamobeka Yesu; ekiagera boria oboina bwarenge ang'e.
