1 Bono ase rituko rie ritang'ani ri'echuma Mariamu Magidali akagenda oboina kobogokiamoka, otarasira omosunte, akarirora rigena riarusigwe oboina. 2 Erio akagenda bwango goika ase Simon Petero, nas'omworokigwa oria onde bwanchetwe na Yesu, akabatebia, Bamorusirie Omonene oboina ime korende titomanyeti ase bamobeka. 3 Petero agasoka, akagenda amo nomworokigwa oria onde, bakabwatia enchera kogenda oboina. 4 Bakagenda ne chimbero bonsi babere: oria omworokigwa onde akagenda bwango kobua Petero, akaba oyo bwe ritang'ani goika as'oboina; 5 agatung'ama, akabirora ebitambaa bibekire; korende tasoa. 6 Erio agacha Simon Petero, akamotunya, agasoa oboina; akabirora ebitambaa bibekire, 7 na keria egetambaa ki'omotwe oye, tikiabekire amo nebitambaa binde, korende iga kiaringire, kebekire ao gioka. 8 Erio agwo agasoa omworokigwa oria onde orenge bwe ritang'ani goika oboina, akarora, agancha, 9 Naki konya tibarainyora okorika, ng'a nemogwenerete koboka korwa as'amakweri. 10 Erio aborokigwa baria bakagenda soba ka. 11 Korende Mariamu igateneine isiko, ang'e noboina okorera; nabo, gakorera, agatung'ama, akarigereria ime as'oboina; 12 akarora amalaika abere, barenge nechianga chindabu, baikaransete, oyomo as'omotwe, naende oyomo as'amagoro, agwo aas'obegetwe omobere o Yesu. 13 Nabarabwo bakamotebia, Omokungu, inki okorera? Akabatebia, Ekiagera bamorusirie Omonene one, korende timanyeti ase bamobeka. 14 Ochia gokwana aya, ageonchora gochia nyuma, akamorora Yesu oteneine, tamanya ng'a Yesu. 15 Yesu akamotebia, Omokungu, ninki okorera? Ning'o okorigia? Ere, agakaga ng'a nomorendi bw'omogondo, akamotebia, Omonene, onye naye kwamoira, ntebia aase kwamobeka, ninche nimorusie. 16 Yesu akamotebia, Mariamu, Ere ageonchora, akamotebia as'Ekeibirania, Raboni (ogoonchora kwaye, Omworokia). 17 Yesu akamotebia, Tonkuna; naki tindagenda ase Tata one: korende genda as'abaminto, obatebie, Nkogendande ase Tata one na Tata oino, ase Nyasaye one na Nyasaye oino. 18 Mariamu Magidali akagenda akabatebia aborokigwa amang'ana ng'a omororire Omonene, naende ng'a omotebirie aya. 19 Ekaba mogoroba ase rituko riria rie ritang'ani ri'echuma, nebisieri kobiasiekirwe aase agwo aborokigwa barenge, ekiagera as'okoiroka Abayahudi, agacha Yesu, agatenena gati gati, akabatebia, Omorembe obe asemore. 20 Gakwanire aya, akaborokia amaboko aye nerikere riaye. Erio aborokigwa bakagoka kobachia komorora Omonene. 21 Yesu akabatebia eria kabere, Omorembe obe asemore: buna Tata antomete, naboigo nabatomire inwe. 22 Gakwanire aya, akabautera omoika akabatebia, Monyore Omoika Omochenu: 23 bande bonsi morarusie ebibe barusigwe; naende bande bonsi morasiekere, basiekeirwe. 24 Ko Thomas, oyomo bw'ikomi nababere okorokwa Didumo, tarengeo amo nabarabwo ekero achete Yesu. 25 Erio aborokigwa bande bakamotebia, Twamororire Omonene. Korende ere akabatebia, Ntarochi amaboko aye nebimanyererio bi'emesumari, nakobeka ekiara as'ebiorokererio bi'emesumari, nakobeka okoboko kwane rikere riaye ime, tingwancha nonya ng'ake. 26 Nyuma y'amatuko atano natato aborokigwa baye mbarenge aroro ime eria kabere, na Thomas amo nabarabwo. Yesu agacha, ebisieri bisiekire, agatenena gati gati, akabora, Omorembe obe asemore. 27 Erio akamotebia Thomas, Reta aiga ekiara kiao, orore amaboko ane; korete okoboko kwao, obeka ase rikere riane: toba oyotancheti, korende oyo bwegenete. 28 Thomas akairaneria, akamotebia, Omonene one, na Nyasaye one. 29 Yesu akamotebia, Ekiagera kwandora, gwanchire: mbare negesio abataroche ko begenire, 30 Nabo mbire ebikone binde ebinge akorete Yesu as'amasio aborokigwa baye, bitarikiri as'ebuku eye: 31 korende ebi biarikirwe monyare gwancha ng'a Yesu nere Kristo, Omwana o Nyasaye; naende as'ogwancha mobe nobogima as'erieta riaye.
1 Nyuma as'aya Yesu akeorokia naende as'aborokigwa baye, as'enyancha ya Tiberia; nere iga eorogetie iga. 2 Simon Petero, na Thomas okorokwa Didumo, na Nathaniel o Kana ya Galili, nabana na Zebedi, nabanto bande babere as'aborokigwa baye, barenge amo. 3 Simon Petero akabatebia, Nkogendande koruba chinswe. Bakamotebia, Naintwe natogende amo naye. Bagasoka, bakarina obwato ime; nobotuko boria tibanyora gento. 4 Goika bogachia goikia mambia, Yesu agatenena engegu: korende aborokigwa tibamanya gose ng'a Yesu. 5 Erio Yesu akabatebia, Abana, more neki mokoria? Bakamoiraneria,Yaya. 6 Akabatebia, Kerute ekeonga ensemo y'okorio y'obwato, nainwe namonyore. Erio bakaruta, korende tibanyara gokeng'usa as'engecho y'obonge bwe chinswe. 7 Omworokigwa oria Yesu anchete akamotebia Petero, Nere Omonene. Erio Simon Petero, agachia koigwa ng'a n'Omonene, akeboyia eanga yaye (ekiagera arenge getirianda), akeruta enyancha ime. 8 Aborokigwa bande bagacha as'obwato (naki tibarenge are as'ense enyomo, ang'e chifuti chimia isato), bakagekurura ekeonga geichire nechinswe. 9 Erio kobachia goika engegu, bakarora omorero bw'amakara aroro, naende enswe ebekire igoro yaye, nomogati. 10 Yesu akabatebia, Reta aiga ensemo ye chinswe echimwarubire bono, 11 Erio Simon Petero akarina obwato ime, agakeng'usa ekeonga goika engegu, geichire chinswe chinene, emia namerongo etano naisato: nonya chiarenge chinyinge buna iga, ekeonga tigiatandogete. 12 Yesu akabatebia, Inchuo morie. Korende omonto onde ase baria aborokigwa tarenge oyorigetie komoboria, Aye ning'o? mbamanyete ng'a n'Omonene. 13 Yesu akagenda akayobogoria omogati, akabaa, nechinswe boigo. 14 Eke nekero kia gatato Yesu arorekanete naborokigwa baye nyuma y'okoboka korwa as'amakweri. 15 Erio kobakorire okoragera, Yesu akamotebia Simon Petero, Simon o Yohana, nonyanchete kobua aba? Akamotebia, Ee, Omonene, aye kwamanyire ng'a ningwanchete. Akamotebia, Risia chimanwa chie ching'ondi chiane. 16 Akamotebia, eria kabere, Simon o Yohana, nonyanchete? Akamotebia, Ee, Omonene aye kwamanyire ng'a ningwanchete, Akamotebia, Risia ching'ondi chiane. 17 Akamotebia eria gatato Simon o Yohana, Nonyanchete inche? Akamotebia, Omonene aye kwamanyire onsi; kwamanyire ng'a ningwanchete. Yesu akamotebia, Risia ching'ondi chiane. 18 Ekeene, ekeene, nagotebirie, Gakwarenge omosae, iga kwarenge kweboyia, kwagenda aase origetie; korende korabe omogaka, norambore amaboko ao, noyonde nagosibe, akoire as'otarigeti. 19 Agakwana eri as'okworokia amakweri ki aramotogie Nyasaye. Erio gakorire gokwana aya, akamotebia, Ntunyana. 20 Petero ogweonchora, akamorora omworokigwa oria bwanchetwe na Yesu ogotunya; nere oria bweegegete gekuba kiaye ekero ki'okoria endagera ya mogoroba, nagokwana, Omonene ning'o orakorue? 21 Petero ochia komorora oyio, akamotebia Yesu, Omonene, noyo rende? 22 Yesu akamotebia, Kondarigie oyo aikaranse goika nchiche ninki erakogwenere? Aye ontunye inche. 23 Erio ring'ana eri rigasarera as'abamwabo ng'a omworokigwa oria tagokwa: korende Yesu tamotebetie, tagokwa; korende, Kondarigie aikaranse goika inchiche nki erakogwenere? 24 Oyo noria omworokigwa oyaroche aya, naende origete aya; naende twamanyire ng'a oborori bwaye nobw'ekeene. 25 Nare naende ayande amange ayakorete Yesu, naro kararikwe erimo erimo, iga ngokaga ng'a nonya nense yonsi tegoisana chibuku echiranyare korikwa.

EKANISA IGO ERE YENGENCHO ENENE MONO
Ekero chinko chibekire amo, igo chikoyia noborabu obonene mono. Beka oroko rokoyia ase riraba rire nobokendu nomorero oye igo okorima naende obe ekegenga, chinko chinyinge nigo chigwoka buya. Ase omobwekano oyo: igo ere obogima obokong'u mono ekero ogotema komenya obogima bwegekristo aye bweka.
Igo ere buya mono kegima ekero mokobwaterana nabakristo bande baria bamomanyete Yeso Kristo buna omotoria obo (Abaibirania 10:25)
Goika ogende ekanisa eria abanto begenete buna Ebibilia nering'ana riobomaene ria Nyasae, naende ase Yeso Kristo agotogigwa buna nomwana O Nyasae.

Aya amwabo aya:
Magokoro nigo agoteba nga konyora Omosongo ataraika Gusii, kera enyomba ase Abagusii yabwate omogambi. Nigo magokoro agoteba ng'a Omongeresa nigo aigete ase erwenyi ya seito Gusii ase omwaka 1893. Ekero ekio kio ogoika nka Gusii, abagambi ba Abagusii nigo barenge buna ekobwatia:
1.Bonchari: Omogaka Okongo nere orenge omorwoti aaria Bonchari yaito ekero Omosongo agoika Gusii.
2.Bogirango Irianyi (South Mugirango): Omogaka Kereu nere orenge kogamba Bogirango Irianyi yaito ko Omosongo agoika Gusii.
3.Bomachoge: Omogaka Nyamosi nere obete omorwoti o Bomachoge yaito ase engaki eyio.
4.Bobasi: Omogaka Nchore nere orenge kogamba aaria Bobasi yaito ase engaki eyio.
5.Nyaribari: Omogaka Nyamwamu nere orenge kogamba ase Nyaribari yaito ko Omosongo agoika Gusii.
6.Bogirango Sugusu (North Mugirango): Omogaka Ndubi nere orenge kogamba aaria Bogirango Sugusu yaito.
7.Bogetutu (Kitutu): Ase ekenyoro kie Enda y' Enchogu, omogaka Angwenyi ominto nere orenge omorwoti aaria Bogetutu yaito ko Omosongo agoika Gusii.
Korende obogambi bwo omogaka Angwenyi aaria Bogetutu needs special attention. Ase ki? This is because at the time, omogaka Angwenyi nigo arenge kogamba in the entire area ya Getembe (Bosongo) eyio Omosongo arierete obote, naende atagete koira. Tari igo rioka, Baba nigo agoteba buna Omosongo nigo arierete Gusii yonsi obote.
"Nigo Omosongo arierete Gusii yonsi obote" Magokoro baba ominto, Omongina Kwamboka Mireri, Ichuni, Kisii County: Picture na PETRONILLA OGOTI, Mwanyagetinge.com/2011
Ense ya Gusii entobu
Omongeresa nigo aigete Getembe akanyora ense entobu, naende ebwate embeo engiya. Nonya nabo igo, akanyora nga tari ere Omosongo omotangani goika Gusii. Yaya. Konyora Omojeremani oikire Gusii before him. Bono, Omongeresa akanyora ng'a kumbe konyora Omojeremani otang'anire goika Bosongo (eyio naende ekorokwa Getembe).
Ogosakora kwa Nyabitabo
Buna baba agoteba, Omongeresa amo no Omojeremani bakarwana esegi. Korwa abwo, Omojeremani agatama gochia Tanzania (eyio yarenge korokwa Tanganyika at the time). Ekero eke, abanto bagasakora ebinto biokoriera endagera. Engaki eyio ekarokwa engaki ye Enyabitabo.
Engaki eyio, omogaka narenge aroro ore korokwa Gasuko, oyio orenge Omosoba (Suba) naende omokirimani bwo Omongeresa. Gasuko agatebia Omongeresa buna omogaka Angwenyi nere ore kogamba ase ensemo eyio ya Getembe.
Nche tinkogamba ne ritoto!
Omongeresa agataka bagambe na Angwenyi korende Angwenyi akaanga buna takogamba ne ritoto! Gasuko akaebereria Angenywi ekero Omongeresa abegete eema yaye bweri gati! Omogambi Angwenyi agasoka na kogamba no Omongeresa ore korokwa Nyarigoti.
Omogambi Angwenyi akabekerwa rirangeti ribariri buna a uniform. Nyuma ye emetienyi etano Angwenyi agateba nga natagete gotigera omwana oye obogambi bwa Getembe. Gati ya abana bo omogaka Angwenyi abamura mbarengeo babere.
Abamura bo omogambi Angwenyi: Ooga no Onsongo
Omomura omonene nere orenge korokwa Ooga. Omomura onde omokogoti nere ore korokwa Onsongo. Angwenyi nigo atagete Onsongo agambe, korende Gasuko nigo atagete Ooga. Gasuko agatebia Ooga buna ise ochorire Onsongo agambe, korende nabo bagoonchora obogambi obo magega yo okorwa chiombe emerengo ene.
Abakungu emerongo ene: Chiombe emerongo ene.
Ooga narenge na abakungu emeronge ene. Akarusia engombe eyemo korwa kera ase omokungu mpaka chigaisana akaa Gasuko. Ekero Nyarigoti are kobekera omogambi egutwa omosangererekano okarangerigwa na Angwenyi.
Gasuko ongainire Nyarigoti
Kera oyomo namanyete buna Onsongo nkobekerwa arenge egutwa. Nyarigoti ga koboria gose abanto mbanchete Ooga, abanto basungusia emetwe. Gasuko akamanya kongaina Nyarigoti buna ogosungusia omotwe nakwo ogwanchera Ooga agambe! Ooga akabekerwa ekerauni kio oborwoti. Angwenyi agaichana na koigwa bobe, korende egesaku kio Ooga gekaragererwa misi.

Chinyomba chio Omogusii:
Aya amwabo aya:
Ntwaroche nga aaiga Egesumu (Kisumu), nao ng'ina Mogusii [ omongina Nyakomisaro oyio naende orenge korokwa Nyakomogendi ] asirerete. Ase boigo, ntwatebetigwe buna omwana o Mogusii okorokwa Orechi (Enswe ase Ekegere), nao anyoreretwe aaiga Egesumu.
Ase okogenderera gotebigwa omogano oyo oito, temanyekanetie gose Orechi ere nigo atigarete aaiga Egesumu ase okonganya konde gwaito, na gotwara ororeri rwaye aroro, gose nigo asirerete aroro.
Erieta "Kisumu" n' rie Ekegusii. Twaikire Downtown, City Of Kisumu [Egesumu]. Tiga tosike omochie o Kisumu. Aaaiga nao esokoro yaito enene, Mogusii asirerete. Ase boigo, aaiga nao ng'ina Mogusii, [ magokoro oito omonene Nyakomisaro, oyio naende ore korokwa Nyakomogendi ] asirerete.
Ase okogenderera n' omogano oyo oito, nigo togotebigwa buna abamura ba Mogusii baria banganyete korwa Egesumu nigo barenge batano na babere. Orechi ere tari gokwanwa ase achiete. Bono nigo togotebigwa ng'a Mogusii narenge ne chinyomba isano na ibere buna ekobwatia.
Chinyomba echio nigo chire:
[I]. Mogusero: Mosinto Omogusii omomura omonene, nigo arenge korokwa Mogusero. Mogusero nigo aiboretwe n' omongina Mokeira Bwari, oyio orenge oyomo bw abangina batano b' Mogusii. Omomura oyo Mogusero nere otang'ete komena egesero mogondo! Komenta nayio, Mogusero nere naende togotebigwa orenge korokwa Sereti.
Abana b' Mogusii nigo barenge buna ekobwatia:
Ase okounenkia omogano oyo oito, temanyekanetie gose Mogusero ere nayorete enyomba yaye buna Monyaribari gose Mobasi, konyora atarasira gose nigo asirete bogesi. Nonya nabo igo, ekero tokobwatia abana ba Mogetutu, Abagusero mbareo.
Omwana oyo o' Mogetutu okorokwa Mogusero nabo erabe ng'a nigo nigo aetwe erieta ria ise moke [ Mogusero oyio konyora osiriore magega ].
[II]. Omogetutu: Ase abana ba Mogusii baria baigete kwamboka korwa Egesumu gocha ase ebitunwa bia Gusii na gochia motwe, Mogetutu nere omomura omonene. Omogetutu gose Mogetutu Mw' Nyakundi ere nigo arogetwe iga korwa ase omongina Mogoisera oyio otamete.
Bono Mogoisera nigo arenge otare konyora bamura. Ekabetereria ng'a omongina Mogoisera [ mosubati omwabo Gichana ] goika anywome omoiseke oyio oramonyorere omwana. Ekero omosubati oyo anyora omwana, akamonengeta ng'a " Na aganto g' Enkundi...Agatutu". Omwana oyio akarokwa Mogetutu Mwanyakundi.
[III]. Mogirango: Mogirango ere nigo arogetwe iga ase engecho y' omongina Bwoisera ore koanga koria engo koyaitirwe. Omongina oyo ere nigo are kogira na gokana pi pi pi buna takoria engo. Gachia konyora omwana bakamoroka buna Gendabu Mw' Mogirango Okogira Engo. Bono aba bakarokwa Abagirango gose "Bakogira engo".
[IV]. Monyaribari: Nyaribari amagenga rende barabuo ninki barokeretwe iga? Abamura ba Nyaribari abagaka na abana babo kibare kogenda esegi yo oroari rwa Sigisi na Gusii nigo bare gotanga Mosigisi taira chiombe chia Gusii bakarokwa Nyaribari Amangenga.
[V]. Mobasi: Ababasi nigo baitete eng'era na koyebasa korwa omogongo rika bare koyenyenya korwa ritana. Bakarokwa Ababasi.
[VI]. Momachoge: Abamachoge rende? Omwana omoiseke Bwoisera akagenda Bomachoge rinani ime. Buna togotebigwa, eng'oge ekamonyoria omwana akarokwa Machoge Osweta Ngoge.
[VII]. Monchari: Bonchari na abana b' omosubati o Mogusii orenge korokwa Kebenchari. Omosubati oyo Kebenchari nigo asogete Bogere, korende magega yaye akairana nka Gusii. Ororeria rw' Kebenchari narwo rokorokwa Abanchari.

Konyora Omosongo atarareta echae Kericho, intwe Abagusii konyora twaikire aroro.
Imomanyete inga Abasigisi na abaminto? Ingai erieta ria Kabianga riarwete? Esegi yo Osao Sao (diarrhea) rende? Ase e semesta ya rero, ingoitona tore omochakano bwe erieta Kabianga, Gamama amo ne Esegi yo Osao Sao buna yare.
Buna ebisaku binde ebinge, Abagusii nigo twarenge konganya na korigia ase agiya ase obomenyo.
Kabianga
Ase okona konganya, Omogusii nigo aigete na komenya aaria an'ge na Kericho. Nigo twabebekaine na Abanyamato gose Abasigisi. Korende ebisaku ebi bibere mbiamenyete na morembe nonya ne entune eyemo.
Nigo bare koiberana etugo, barwara botambe ne chingaki chie ebiro chikaba chimbe. Tari igo rioka. Ndagera ekaba terikwama. Ebinto bikaba biangire aiga ase bamenyete. Nario erio Omogusii atebete inga Kabianga rende, titokorwa aaiga.........
Bakarwa abwo ase ensemo eyio Kabianga aiga na koyaroka erieta erio (Kabianga) na kogenda gochia Ikonge, Metamaywa na Keroka gochaka komenya korende. Ase okonganya korwa Kabianga, Omogusii agatamboka oroche rware korokwa Emogori rakini ase rero rero rokorokwa Isonto. Morembe tochia koba aiga.
Abasigisi bakaba bagooncherera Omogusii. Aiga nao ebiranya bia abakoro biarigetigwe egere gokonya Omogusii korwa ase omobisa. Abagaka abakoro bagatebigwa inga goika babeke ebiranya ebi na koganya ababisa bache.
Abasigisi bagachaka esegi korende Abagusii bakaemotia. Abasigisi bagatirimboka inse batagete goita Abagusii. Abagusii bakaeboia buna abanyamato. Bakamanya kobarongera chinsinyo chiosi na kobabeka gati.
Osao Sao
Gaki bagaita emeganda ya Abasigisi enamba etare kobareka abwo ase oroche rwe Emogori impaka rokaba amanyinga oka. Abagere baria bamenyete ase ensemo ya Sondu bagakumia na goteba buna esegi yasairi Abasigisi.
Ekio nakio kiagerete esegi eye ekarokwa esegi yo Osao Sao. Tari igo rioka. Abasacha abange ba Bosigisi nigo baitetwe. Sigisi ekaba etabwati abasacha gekogera nigo baitetwe ekero gie esegi eyio yo Osao Sao na Abagusii.
Renta Abamura Ebisore Korwa Gusii Na Gamama
Abamura ebisora korwa Gusii bagachi Sigisi na kobiaria abakungu ba Bosigisi. Korwa ase engaki eye, nario bono Omosigisi achagete korangeria Omogusii okomoroka Gamama engencho yaye oyo obiareti mama. Impaka rero nabo Omosigisi akorangeria Omogusii inga Gamama. Ase boigo intobwate a town ekorokwa Kabianga. Nabo magokoro atebete igo impaka naende ase esemesta yende.

Aya amwabo aya:
Abagambi Ba Abagusii Ekero Omosongo Aigete Nka Gusii
Ase orogendo amo n' okong'anya gwaito, Abagusii ntwaigete ase tokwebaka amarieta y' ching'iti ao ao. Ase okoboria, ntoratebigwa buna ninki kiagerete tokeebaka iga. Ninki gose? Mbuya ki twaroche ase chingiti echi ekagera tokeebaka amarieta abo? Buna togotebigwa, Abagusii mbebagete amarieta ayio akobwatia:
(I). Ababasi nigo bebagete, Enchage (Zebra ase Ekenyamorero). Komenta nayio, nigo togotebigwa buna Omobasi n' omongaini! Omobasi nere oorogeti Omogusii buna eng'ombe ekobaswa korwa ebigoti! Abagusii bande nigo barenge konyenya eng'ombe korwa omogongo! Nonya nabo igo, abande nigo bagoteba buna Ababasi nigo babasete eng'era korua omogong'o rika rie ritana, erio bakarokwa Ababasi!
(II). Abagirango. Engo (leopard ase Ekenyamorero). Omogirango nigo agirete koria engo. Oyo nere naende omomura okabere ase Omogusii, naende okorokwa Omogirango Omosweta!
(III). Abanyaribari. Aba nabwo naende bamanyire buna Abasweta ((Baboon ase Ekenyamorero). Komenta nayio, naende bamanyire buna Abanyaribari Amang'eng'a! Aba nabwo bagatangire esegi ko yatindiire korwa Bomanyi, buna togotebigwa. Tari igo rioka. Omonyaribari nere obarete, gose kobaga Omogusii bwensi ase abeta ritangani. Abagambi bari babarete Abagusii ritangani nao barwete Nyaribari.
(IV). Abamachoge. Tari Abanyaribari boka barenge kweroka Abasweta. Abamachoge nabarabwo nigo bebagete Abasweta (Baboon ase Ekenyamorero).
(V). Abanchari. Engubo. Omonchari nere Engubo Y' Ndiba chia Bokendu! Engubo nigo yanchete komenya aase amache amakendu ime. Ntwe ntomanyeti gose eke nakio kiagerete Abanchari bakeeroka erieta eri.
(VI). Abagetutu. Aba nabwo Abasweta abatang'ani (Baboon ase Ekenyamorero). Omogetutu nere omomura omonene. Oyo nere naende okorokwa Enda Y' Enchogu nyabana bange!

Rituko erimo, Nyamisanchu agaita moibori omwabo mbaka agatweka mo. Omogaka bwo omochi oyo akaba na amayianda ase ogosira kwo omorugi oye. Omogaka oyo akaba gakorenda oboina bwa nyagosira gekogera nigo abakoro bare kwegena buna monto tagokwa agende pi.
Nigo begenete inga inkoboka are nyuma ya amatuko atano. Nyamisanchu tachia kogokigwa na okorendwa kwo oboina. Akaenga amarwa, na ekero amarwa aya ayiete, agatebia omogaka oye agende gotimoka gakonya kwegokia na amarwa ere arende oboina.
Omogaka akagenda na gotiga Nyamisanchu arende oboina. Karendete, ribusi rikabusi amaroba. Nyamisanchu korora aya, akarigia enyimbo na gochwata embera igoro kagoteba, "monto okwa osira, motienyi okwa oboka, chitunda isato".
Amaroba agakira tagenderera kobusia. korwa erio amakweri agacha buna amaroba aya are kobusia nyagosira otagete koboka Nyamisanchu akamochwata tachia koboka, amakweri agachera Mwanyagetinge korwa erio.

Aya amwabo aya:
Abwo kare kare, omogaka oyomo narengeo na mokaye, ase ekenyoro kia Bomariba. Bono omogaka oyo nigo arenge korokwa Mogire. Na mokaye nigo arenge korokwa Nyaboke. Mogire na mokaye, omongina Nyaboke nigo barenge n’ bana batano. Abamura babere ne chinyaroka isato.
Ekero enyaroka enkogoti yarenge emiaka etano, enchara enene egaateka ase ekenyoro eke kia Bomariba. Embura ekaba engaki etambe etari gotwa, n' morakera ogacha omotindi kegima. Ase boigo, chindooche chionsi chikooma pi, n' emete ne ebimeri bikooma.
Komenta nayio, etugo ekarea bobe mono mbaka ekang’ea gokwa mono. Abanto ba Bomariba bagachandeka kegima, ase enchara kobaita. Ase engaki eye, chingige nachirochio chigaacherera abamenyi aba ba Bomariba. Bono chingige echi nachirochio chikamenta emechando ase emechando ende.
Ko obokongu bwaba obonge, ogosemeria gokaera ase abamenyi aba. Bono bakaganya ogokwa ekiagera baganyete embura ase amatuko amange goika bakarosa. Bono omogaka oyo Mogire agachandeka kerage ase eng’encho arenge n’ eamate enene, eyio arenge korageria.
Bono egasi yaye nigo yarenge ogotimoka gwoka.
Ase boigo, kera oyomo ase abanto baye, natageta aigote. Bono omogaka Mogire akarosa korigeria eamate yaye. Akaba tari kogenda gotwara erinde anyore kende arentere eamate yaye eche koria. Nyaboke agachia komosegeta agende buna abagaka bande bare kogenda korigeria chiaamate chiabo, Mogire ere akaanga pi, kagotimoka abwo ase enka yaye.
Mogire akaba gakobera nyomba, na Nyaboke ogenda korigeria abana endagera. Bono abana aba ba Mogire nigo bare korora buna abaise ba abasani babo bare kogenda korigia endagera ya abana babo, babaretera baria.
Abana aba nabarabwo bakagania ng'a ise omwabo nere agende kobarigeria endagera ekiagera ng’ina tare korenta endagera ekobaisana. Engaki eyemo, Nyaboke akaba kagosiria ogosemeria gw’ okorageria eamate eye yaye.
Bono agatiana ng'a tarageria omogaka oyo oye Mogire otare korwa nyomba, oganyererete arenterwe endagera na Nyaboke, omanya goansa koinagera. Bono omogaka oyo Mogire nigo amenyete saiga mwaye.
Bono ng'ai mwaira amabere n' obonyansi bwakabucha iga? Mabere tarengeo akonywegwa. Emete amo n' obonyansi biakinire aaria Bomariba. Picture na special correspondent, Bomariba. Gusii.com files.
"Ndagera tiyarengeo, ekoriegwa" Nyaboke.
Nyaboke agachaka korosia endagera, na koyebisa. Nigo arenge koria n’ abana baye, takoirera Mogire kende aaria saiga mwaye. Nyaboke akaba kagotoma omomura oye gochia ase ise amenyete saiga na komotebia ng'a ndagera yarenge ekoriegwa!
Bono Mogire akaba gakorara nchara ase amatuko atari make. Mogire agachaka gotwara chitang’utang’u buna nigo bare komong’aina. Bono akagenda ase abagisangio baye na kobatebia aya y’ okoba n' nchara ase amatuko amange.
Abagisangio baye koigwa igo, bakamotebia buna eamate yaye nigo ekomong’aina. Mogire akagechigwa kerage na gotiana gokora egesiomba gochia ase omorugi oyo oye. Engaki eye embura egachaka gotwa kemonyiriro.
Korwa abwo, ekaba enyinge n’endagera egachaka gosaboka. Ase boigo, obonyasi bokaama. Bono chiombe chikanyora endagera chikori, n' amabere akabucha mono. Mogire bono nere akagoka ekero eng’ombe yaye yaiyeretie emori!
"Ayie! Timosaria na goturutumba ekemira. Bakungu mbatakeiri koria amabere y’ eng’ombe, emori etaramera amaino a igoro!" Mogire.
Koyaiyeria emori, Mogire agatebia omorugi oye buna ase ekemira kiabo, bakungu mbatakeiri koria amabere y’ eng’ombe, emori etaramera amaino a igoro!
Akamotebia buna takoyariera, ase eng'encho araturutumbe ekemira. Obwango obo nabwo Nyaboke ainyorete buna are gokorera Mogire engaki eri enchara yabetete inse aaiga Bomariba. Kare n' amarimu, Nyaboke akaimoka rituko riare kobwati rimaambia echuni n’ abana baye bari bare abake na kogenda sobo boiborwa.
Gaaika sobo boiborwa, agatebia ise aya Mogire atagete komokorera. Bono Nyaboke akarara abwo sobo kabere. Rituko ria gatato, ise n’ abasani baye bakaimoka kwagachia gochia o Nyaboke erinde bagayane aya Mogire atagete gokora.
Mogire na Nyaboke oye baanchanire na komenya n' omorembe
Mogire akagoka korora Nyaboke oiranire korende ageekora koigwa bobe buna Nyaboke achiete sobo. Bono abagaka bagaikaransa na koyakwanera aya are gocha goetani eamate eye ya Mogire na Nyaboke. Omoerio oye Mogire agaancherana gotiga mokaye tanywa amabere y’ eng’ombe na koaberana korwa ase onsi aria konyora aetire. Eeamate ya Mogire egatigara kemenyete n’ omogoko n’ omorembe korwa erio.

Omoruoti bw'semi abwenererete gochora omorai orache magega yaye ekero akure.
Omoruoti naareganeti ekeragerio ekenene mono na eng'ana nere atagete kobamanyia. Ase igo bakagende chinsanganio chiosi chiorosana.
Ekero omotienyi omesete, Omoruoti Engo agacha na gotenena gatigati yabo. Ching'iti chiosi chigakira kiri na gotegerera omoruoti akuane.
Kegoteba, "Karwoa nchira ng'ete. Ninche omonene bwenererete koba eruoti."
Ritimo rikagwa inse kobara goika kane. Enchogu ekaigwa obororo egachaka gotinera amagoro inse. Omoruoti Engo akamotebia, "Nkwarenge neribaga riago."
Aseigo Enchogu ekagenda.
Ebeche egacha kegoteba, "Karwa nchera yane. Karwa nchera yane. Niche kochia koba omoruoti. ninche bwate ekeonwa ekenene. Ninche omokong'u. Nibwenererete koba omoruoti."
Ritimo rikagwa inse goika kobara isanonemo. Ekaigwa obororo. Ekabea na koeruta ebuse embeo igoro.
Engo ekamotebia, "Beche okoruta nigo kware rimo rioka. Ribaga riao riaerire." Ebeche ekagenda.
Chinsa echio bakaigwa eriogi korwa magega yabo. Ekero barigereretie magega bagaichana keria baroche.
Egana ekaira ritimo ekarisira gochia igoro. Ekang'usa okoboko gochia igoro, ekaminyoka gochia bosio, egacharoka igoro, ekaruta ritimo gochia rire igoro.
"Rimo! Kabere! Gatato! Kane! Gatano! Gatanorimo! Gatanokabere! Obee!" Egana ekarera.
Egana ekabea. Ekaigwa obororo ekang'ea goonchokanana, gekoemurukania na gotamereria amang'ana amange.
Korende Omoruoti Engo akamotebia, "Yaya, nigo okonyora ribaga erimo rioka." Ase igo Egana ekagenda.
Ekero ching'iti chinde chiaigwete amang'ana aye, chionsi chigachaka goseka.
Ekaeyana, ekabuatoka ritimo egatuora, "Gatano omente gatano ni ikomi." Ritimo rikagwa inse.
Omoruoti Engo atateba, "Eee, Engabi! Isano omente isano neenchera yogoika ikomi. Chichera nechinyinge chiokobara goika ikomi."
Erwarenerero tiyarenge yokonyora eng'iti enene gose eyebuate chinguru kobua echinde. Erwano eyarenge yokonyora eng'iti eng'aini kobua chionsi. Naboigo Engabi yabete Enting'ana ekero Engo yakwete.

CHINGORO CHIEMETEYESTIMA CHIATICHIRE,NGOROBEKANA TORE ABAMENYI BA OMORUNGA NYAMIRA
Written by Hyline Major on February 12, 2022
Abamenyi bensemo ya omorunga enchoro west mugirango ekaunti ya Nyamira nigo baboririe abarai bensemo eyio gosoa gati erio kobakonya konyora chinguru chiomorero echi babeire batabwati ase egeka egetambe bono
Bakoragwa na oyokabeire omocansora bwensemo eyuo Keneth Gisemba nigo abamenyi abwo batebire buna nonya ekampani yokobaga chinguru chiomorero gika ensmeo eyio na korema chingoro chiokobeka emete yestima bono nigo yairire egeka egetambe getambokero getaraimokigwa na chingoro echio chiachakire goticha
Bono nigo bagosereiri korobekana onye getambokero tikeri gochia koimokigwa ase obwango

Engoko Ne’Kebaki
Wiehan de Jager
Abwo kare, engoko ne'kebaki nigo bamenyete amo nomorembe nechinyoni chionsi pi. Nigo barenge gokora ebinto biabo amo.
Rituko erimo, enchara egacha ase ense. Ekebaki kegatara are sana korigia endagera. Gekairana kerosete sana. "Goika kobe neng'encho ende engusu gotara." ekebaki kegateba.
Ekero babogete korwa chitoro chingiya, engoko ekaba nokogania okuya. Egachaka koarigania amarionya yechinyoni chiria chionsi konyora chiakure. "Tiga toyasone amo igoro yamarionya aya aito are mobere. Nabo eyio eragere ogotara gwaito kobe okogusu."
Ekaba buna ekebaki keria nakio gioka kiabwate esindani yogosona, igo kegatang'ana gochaka gwesonera amarionya mobere oye Ake igo gekanyara gotambururuka are nechimbaba ibere, kegatiga engoko eria nse garia.
Engoko eria ekarosa gosona egatiga esindani eria igoro yekabati nakogenda riko koroseria abana baye endagera. Rakini chinyoni chiria chinde konyora chiarorire ekabaki keria gekoiruruka are. Chikaboria engoko echikonye n'esindani eria erinde chirosie chimbaba chiabo nachirochio. Nabwo abwo chinyoni chiria chikairuruka igoro ase rire.
Ekero enyoni eria yomoiso yairanatie esindani eria yasabete, engoko eria tiyarengeoo, konyora yasokire ake. Igo ebichuchu biengoko eria bikaira esindani eria bigachaka gochiesa nero. Ekero biarosete nomochieso oria, bigatiga esindani eria ase amaraba ime.
Emarogoba eyio, ekebaki gekairana. Gekaboria esindani eria erinde kenyare gosonerera amarionya konyora achakire korua ekero ki'orogendo rwaye. Engoko eria ekarigererIa ekabati igoro. Ekarigia chikoni, isiko keorori, gotatiga teyenyoreti sindani eria.
"Gaki ing'a rituko erimo rioka inkorigerie esindani," Engoko ekaebereria ekebaki. Erinde onyare gosonerera amarionya ao nakonyara kaoiruruka korigia endagera yende.
"Ero bono nakoire rituko erimo rioka, "ekebaki kegateba. "Inyore timokonyora sindani eyio, goika ong'akane n'egechuchu kiao ekemo." Ekero ekebaki giachete rituko rikobwatia, gekanyora engoko eria kegendererete gokura nse ase omochanga okoba sindani tiyarenge kororekana ande. Igo ekebaki kegaika nse bwango gekabogoria egechuch ekemo gekaira.
Korwa abwo nonya mbono, ekebaki ekero kegoeta, nigo gekonyora engoko kegokura nse korigia esindani eria yasirete. Kera ekero omorengari bw'echimbaba chiekebaki ogoeta, nigo engoko ekoagama ebichuchu biaye. "Ama korwa ase aasioku na ase eroro." Nabirobio biaraneria: "Titori bariri. Tiga tominyoke."

Amatoke A'Baba
Catherine Groenewald
Omogondo o'baba nigo orenge kororekana buya – nigo obwate amaemba, obori, n'emiogo. Korende ekiya ase bionsi pi biria barengeoo namataoke Nonya baba obwate abana abange, nigo namanyete buna ninche anchete ase abachokoro baye bonsi. Nigo anarete kondangeria gochia mwaye. Naende ontebia obobisi bwaye bokeboke. Nonya nigo obobisi obomo mbore atatagete gontebia: nabwo mboria bwa'se arenge gotoberia amatoke aye.
Rituko erimo inkarora egekabu ki'amakendo kebekire ase omogaso isiko mwa'baba. Ekero namoboretie buna negiaki, richibu nanyorete ndiria buna: "Ekio negekabu kiane kiogokorera ebikone" Ensemo y'egekabu keria amagoma y'eritoke narengeoo anarete gonchoreria kera rituko. Inkarengereeria inkamanya komoboria, "Amagoma aya nayaki?" Richibu naende nanyorete ndiria buna, "Aya na amagoma ane y'ogokorera ebikone."
Inkagoka rende korigereria magokoro, amagoma aria amo n'egekabu keria ki'amakendo. Korende baba agantoma ing'ende komokorera egasi gete. "Gaki, baba tiga indore buna okorosia." "Tiga konyogerera omwana oyo, kora buna ogotebigwa," agantebia kare buna oyobeete. Inkaminyoka ebirundo ebinene gochia gokora egiatagete.
Ekero nairanete, inkanyora baba gainkaransete isiko riaye korende gekabu keria amd n'amagoma aria tibiarengeoo. "Baba ing'ai kwaira egekabu keria, ing'ai amagoma aria are, naende ing'ai." Richibu nanyorete ndiria buna, "Noo bionsi bire ase ane yogokerera ebikone." Inkaigwa bobe sana.
Amatuko abere agaeta, na baba agantoma inchie komwoyeria akanyimbo kaye agatereire korwa enyomba yaye y'okorara. Yaani buna nasoete nyomba iga, inkaigwa rimisu ri'amatoke amatubo. Ase erumu eria yaime, noo egekabu keria ki'ababa kiogokerera ebikone biaye kiarengegetubire buya n'oborangeti obonene obogotu. Inkaimokereria oborangeti boria igoro ake igo nagotiokerera rimisu riria rigiya.
Eriogi ria'baba rigantaborora ekero andangeretie, "Ninki ogokora imabwo? Kora bwango ondetere enyimbo yane." Inkairana bwango nenyimbo yaye. "Ninki ogosekere?" akamboria. Okoboria gokagera inkainyora buna nigo naichanete ase okomanya koria ase abisete amatoke.
Rituko rikobwatia ekero baba achete minto gokwania mama, inkaminyoka gochia nyomba mwaye korigereria amatoke aria naende. Inkanyore egesabo ekemo konyora giatobire. Intatabora ritoke erimo nakobisa eyanga yane ime. Inkakuneka egekabu keria naende nagosoka. Ingaeta isuku nyuma yenyomba eria inkariria. Nigo riarenge gwansa sana, ase obogima bwane konyora tindaria itoke rigwansa igo.
Rituko riria riarenge kobwatia, baba noo arenge mogondo oye akwaa ching'eni. Inkechobanesia na korigereria amatoke aria. Bono konyo ange onsi atobire. Ingasinywa gotiga kobogoria make, ingatabora amatoke ane. Ingasonsogoria ng'oora gochia ase omorangu, inkaigwa baba kagokora isiko. Inkanyara tu kobisa amatike aria eyanga yane ime nakomoetania gochia isiko.
Rituko riarenge kobwatia nigo riarenge rituko riechiro. Nigo baba arenge koira amatike aye echiro koonia. Tichieti koayerera kogenda mwaye ituko erio. Korende tinyareti komoina ngaki tambe.
Emarogoba eyio ekero narangeretiwe na mama, tata na magokoro, inkamanya ninki bandangereria. Obotuko obwo ekero naraire, inkamanya tinkoirorera koiba naende, ebe korwa ase magokoro gose onde bwensi.

Okobokigwa No’omochakano
Engaki yo ogokwa no kobokigwa abanto abange ngochengera bare nakogokera okobokigwa kwo omotori oito omonene, Yeso Kirisito (Tito 2:13). Ase bare, eri nario rituko rinene rio amotimoko ase ekarenda yegekirisito.1 Amangana yo kobokigwa naro amangana yengencho mono ase obokeresito: Kobokigwa gotaiyo titobwati komanya ase ogotorigwa gwaito korwa ase ebibe biaito (1 Abakorinto 15:12–18).
Ebimanyererio ebitangani
Okobokigwa nigo kore ase ringana, naboigo ase ebimanyire mono, mbiri bioka gose ebimanyererio ebitanganitobwate bia abakeresito biokorikwa igoro you okobokigwa. Ebio esiko ekogenda gochi 1 Abathesaloniki; ekemo kiomochakano bwo amarube a Paulo, ayio arigetwe AD 50.2 Emiaka chirifu ibere nyuma yogokwa kwa kirisito. Omoganda norengeo bwabanto abwo bare koiranerania nga ere nabogetigwe korwa ase amakweri, naboigo akaagacha oboroso obuya ase amangana aya; naboigo amangana buna aya tari koba botuko. Korende enchiri ngoteba ere. Nonya ne miaka chiribu nyuma yebikoro ebio bigotebererwa (sirika AD 30–33), genda magega ase amangana a kare gose ase ogobwatia ogokoro.3 Naboigo amangana aya a kare tabwati amangana amange ayio are rirube riengencho ria Paulo. Ekio naki gekogera twateba nga ngogenda ere magega mono ogochaka ogotangani okuo kwabwatetu nakogachwa.4
“Ringana rio okobokigwa gwa kristo ne ringana rie engencho mono gochi ase abakeresito:Kobokigwa gotaiyo,Nto bwati gosemeria gwo okoborigwa kwe ebibe biaito (1 Abakorinto 15:12–18)”.
Ekanisa entangani
Okobokigwa ngoteberera kore ase chinchera inye (gwachagete AD 67–855) ngotebwa bire buna nigo bire ebiogotantania, korende ebinge bioogatantani mbirio ao nainde buna torakagere ase chingencho echi inye chingao chie egento emaiaka emenge nyuma yo okoba. Nigo bire ne binto ebinge buna nongo orosetie omoganda bwa abakungu abwo bachiete ase rikuruma, nga amaraika na abere arenge ao gose nerimo nakogenderera. Ebinge bie ebi mbiri bio ogotantani, buna bitamentiri aroro, ase ekio orokererio; ekemo ngetebe rimo nga riraika riakwanete, naboigo ekeorokererio ekende getebe nga’ amaraika nonsi akwanete. Nebe ogotantania onye ekeo rokererio gegoteba riraika erimo rioka.
Nkorenta ere engencho nga abasacha baarigete baarigete amangana aya nabo barainyore amangana amangao nonya gakororekana amangana amange ase otebia kwabo kwe ebinto biakorekanete. Teri korenta engencho goteba nga’ ase engencho ya abakungu bare ase erisiti, Kobokigwa ngokorekaneti bi.6
Naboigo, okobokigwa kwo obobui ngaange kware koba ase enchera etakageire ase emeganda emetangani ya abayaudi bare gocha goteba rikuruma ritabwati kende. Abayaudi abatangani mbaegenete mono igoro yo obogima nyuma yobonde, abande mbaegenete okobokigwa, nabende tibaegenete (buna abasadusesi (Mathayo 22:23). Nabande mbaegenete nga mbande babo bara bokigwe; korende onde tari ase abayuda baegenete nga’omonto oyomo narenge gochi kobokigwa nyuma ya onde bwensi. Eke nakio kiagerete abaorokigwa batabwate bomanyi bonde bwenshi igoro yeki yeso are goteba ekero abanete ogokwa kwaye naboigo nokobokig.
Ebimanyererio bio okobokigwa gwa kristo gochia ase aba orokigwa baye
Ebimanyererio mbireo nga,krwa omochakano bwe orogendo rwa abakristo, Okobokigwa gwa kristo ngwatumegete gosomia keria abaorokigwa baye baraetere ase okobokigwa. Ase 1 Abathesaloniki 4:13–18, Paulo nkorwa are ekemanyererio igoro yo okobokigwa; Ntwegenete nga yeso nakwete naboigo akaboka naende naboigo ntwegenete nga nyasae narente na yeso baria bakwete amo nere. Igo okobokigwa kwa yeso nkoba kore engencho yo okobokigwa kwa abakeresto ekero arache. Ase abaibiribi Philippians 3:20–21, nkomanya tore nga okobokigwa kwe emebere yaito nebe buna oria o yeso kristo.
